jobDescription:

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer for Snap’s People Team. This person will be a trusted business partner who brings together technical expertise, business acumen, and analytical rigor. They will work closely with engineering, People Science, business leaders, and HR leadership to lead business intelligence and analytics engineering initiatives, design scalable data solutions, deliver meaningful insights, and enable data-informed decision-making.


What you’ll do:


  • Lead complex, high-impact business intelligence and analytics engineering initiatives from problem definition through delivery.
  • Translate ambiguous business needs into clear technical and analytical approaches, working with stakeholders to define requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and prioritize solutions.
  • Independently own your workflow and delivery, using sound judgment to prioritize work, manage timelines and dependencies, address risks or blockers, and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Design and architect reliable, scalable data pipelines, data models, and self-service analytics solutions using tools such as SQL, Python, BigQuery, Airflow, Visier, Looker, and Posit.
  • Own key data products or systems end-to-end, including technical design and architecture, quality, reliability, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct rigorous analysis and translate complex findings into clear insights and recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve data quality, reduce manual work, and build more scalable solutions.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members, contribute to team standards and best practices, and help foster a culture of learning and high-quality execution.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:


  • Advanced SQL and Python skills, with experience designing and building reliable data pipelines, models, and analytics solutions, and the ability to leverage AI-assisted development and analytics tools responsibly; and willingness to adopt new technologies as needs evolve.
  • Deep understanding of the data ecosystem, including data warehouses, dimensional and semantic modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, analytics layers, visualization tools, and self-service data products.
  • Demonstrated ability to design reliable, scalable data architectures and improve data quality, performance, maintainability, and operational resilience.
  • Ownership and accountability, with the ability to independently navigate complex or ambiguous problems, make sound technical and architectural decisions, manage priorities across multiple workstreams, and drive work forward with limited direction.
  • Experience applying analytical and statistical methods, including descriptive analysis, regression, correlation, time series analysis, and hypothesis testing, using tools such as Python or R.
  • Business acumen and experience translating business questions into clear metrics, analytical requirements, data solutions, and actionable insights, with careful attention to scope, consistency, and interpretation.
  • Ability to lead through influence and communicate complex technical and analytical concepts clearly across executives, business partners, analysts, and technical teams.
  • Strong judgment and commitment to data quality, privacy, security, governance, and the responsible use of People data.

Minimum Qualifications: 


  • BS/BA degree in a technical field (e.g., computer science, mathematics) or a research-based social science field (e.g., public policy, sociology).
  • 6+ years of relevant experience in business intelligence engineering, analytics engineering, data engineering, quantitative analysis, or a related field or a Master’s degree in a technical field + 5+ year of post-grad experience; or a PhD in a related technical field + 2+ years of post-grad experience
  • 6+ years of experience with SQL or similar query languages and development experience in at least one object-oriented or scripting language (Python, Java, Scala, etc.); Python preferred.
  • 3+ years of experience designing and building dashboards, reports, and other end-user analytics solutions using data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, Visier, Posit, or similar platforms.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • MA/MS in a technical and/or research-based field.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform and data technologies such as BigQuery and Airflow.
  • Experience working in an agile development environment and collaborating across technical and business teams.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git.
  • Experience working with People data, including workforce and Talent Acquisition data, and familiarity with People analytics platforms such as Visier.

The Trust & Safety (T&S) Team plays an important role in protecting our Snapchatters from content that violates our terms of service or Community Guidelines — while constantly embodying our values of Kind, Smart, and Creative. The T&S team helps create a safe platform experience so that all of our users around the world are empowered to enjoy their experience on our platform, every day. We take great pride in our work as digital first responders and hope you would consider joining us. 


We’re looking for a Lead to join our Trust & Safety Global Operations & Enablement team which works cross-functionally with our Policy, Legal, Product, and Engineering teams to keep Snapchatters safe on our platform.  While this role will serve as a key Lead within our Trust & Safety Global Operations team, as Snap’s regulatory footprint has expanded, this role includes supporting the implementation of legal and regulatory compliance matters, as well as policy. . This role requires a skilled and unflappable decision maker who has a passion for ideating and developing safety workflows in order to improve the experience for Snapchatters everywhere. 


You’ll become a subject matter authority in multiple domains by owning projects from beginning to finish and facilitating cross-team communication with our Global Safety Partners  to help keep Snapchatters safe. 


This is a people manager role, with a team that will be based in NY, though you should expect to lead and coordinate across timezones (e.g. London, NYC, LA) as part of a global, matrixed operating model. 


Due to the nature of Trust & Safety work, you should be willing and able to work with sensitive issues and content that may be considered offensive or disturbing. Our team has carefully devised measures and support in place to ensure wellness for all our team members.

What you’ll do:

  • Provide leadership and guidance for a growing team of T&S Specialists by becoming a subject matter expert in our workflows
  • Enhance our operational workflows by identifying focus areas and implementing improvements
  • Liaise with our global safety partners and further strengthen those relationships 
  • Use data to influence decisions and highlight emerging issues impacting users
  • Anticipate risks, manage escalations and balance business needs versus technical constraints
  • Handle time-sensitive inquiries from users or other key stakeholders, both internal and external, and drive an end to end resolution
  • Deliver key projects within the Safety roadmap, incorporating execution, training, data assessment and presentation of results to stakeholders
  • Regularly identify opportunities to enhance internal processes and improve efficiency, while driving longer-term scalable automated solutions
  • Closely follow industry trends to help develop Snap’s thought leadership and T&S operation
  • Be willing and able to work with sensitive issues and content that includes but is not limited to child exploitation, graphic violence, self-harm,and others, which may be considered offensive or disturbing 

Knowledge, skills, & abilities:

  • Proven leadership capacity with the ability to attract, motivate, develop and retain talent
  • Experience reviewing sensitive content with a meticulous attention to detail
  • A track record of identifying gaps and solutions, and implementing new processes – from a policy, operations, and/or tooling perspective
  • Strong analytical skills, including working with large data sets to solve business problems, and providing practical business insights via data visualization software (Advanced EXCEL, Looker, Tableau, etc.)
  • Prior experience interacting with regulatory bodies, NCMEC or law enforcement
  • Great judgment in complex situations and ability to problem-solve, both independently and with peers or management
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience working with product and engineering teams to launch tools and solutions that improve trust across a platform or product
  • Contribute to the development of Trust & Safety’s scalable enforcement guidance by collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Product, Operations, Trust, Legal, and Communications.
  • Analyze enforcement, product, market, and other relevant data to refine policy and enforcement guidance, while proactively identifying risk areas and emerging integrity challenges.
  • Demonstrate the ability to deeply analyze complex issues and identify actionable decisions that can be scaled across manual and automated moderation systems.
  • Strong investigative skills coupled with a curiosity that leads to identifying and understanding root causes
  • Proven ability for strategic and critical thinking, demonstrating strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of the big picture and the value of both perspectives.
  • A proven track record of effective leadership with the ability to independently manage a portfolio of complex issues, end to end
  • Comfort with ambiguity and rapidly shifting scope — this role's boundaries move as the team's and Snap’s needs grow
  • Working experience with the product development lifecycle within technology, regulations, and/or industry landscape.
  • A passion for Snapchat, online safety, and creativity!

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of relevant experience 
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 1+ years working directly with product and engineering teams
  • 1+ years of Trust & Safety, Legal, or Regulatory and Compliance,  experience a plus, but not required 
  • 1+ years experience in operations, implementation, product management or other relevant roles, with a focus on policy issues and collaboration with global operations.

SMC GTM Architect team is the engine driving growth across Snap's small-customer business. We’re looking for a Senior Manager to join the SMC GTM Architect team at Snap Inc! In this role, you’ll design, prototype, and scale the systems that power growth across Snap’s advertiser business, translating central product and engineering capabilities into repeatable GTM workflows and measurable business outcomes

What you’ll do:

  • Define and evolve the long-term vision for acquisition, activation, retention, and growth across Snap’s advertisers

  • Architect the orchestration layer connecting CRM, BigQuery, Ads APIs, and other data platforms to enable unified account context and cross-system coordination

  • Leverage experimentation infrastructure to run, measure, and learn from tests rapidly, safely, and at scale

  • Build the personalization backbone that delivers relevant product recommendations, optimizations, and workflows to advertisers at the right moment

  • Develop a multichannel communications engine that coordinates timely, contextual outreach across in-product, email, and partner surfaces while balancing advertiser experience with measurable impact

  • Establish a unified signals foundation that brings together behavioral, contextual, and performance data to power personalization, targeting, and decisioning

  • Drive operational excellence through automation by building tools, APIs, and reusable triggers that reduce manual work and accelerate decision-making

  • Serve as the technical bridge across Sales, Growth, Business Intelligence, Finance, Product, and Engineering, translating GTM objectives into scalable systems, KPIs, and measurable business outcomes

  • Recruit, coach, and scale a team of technically fluent builders while fostering a culture of ownership, experimentation, and measurable impact

  • Present roadmap, adoption, and business outcomes to executive stakeholders and iterate based on outcomes and ROI

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

  • Knowledge of the digital advertising lifecycle, including campaign setup, bidding, optimization, measurement, and the advertiser journey from acquisition through monetization

  • Strong technical foundation in Python and SQL, with the ability to build systems that integrate with CRM platforms, BigQuery, cloud services, Ads APIs, and other data platforms

  • Ability to translate technical capabilities into measurable revenue, productivity, or cost improvements

  • Ability to design scalable systems for experimentation, personalization, multichannel communications, signals, and automated decisioning

  • Ability to partner effectively across Sales, Growth, Business Intelligence, Finance, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Strong business judgment and executive communication skills, including the ability to communicate roadmaps, adoption, ROI, and business outcomes

  • Hands-on operating style with a focus on practical solutions, clear ownership, rapid execution, and simplified complexity

  • Commitment to high standards for testing, observability, data hygiene, and continuous iteration

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • 12+ years of experience designing and deploying automation systems

  • 2+ years of experience in people management or technical leadership, including leading technical teams or large-scale programs

  • Experience building and shipping production applications or working prototypes

  • Experience using Python, SQL, or equivalent tools and technologies

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working with LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation architectures, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and model lifecycle management

  • Experience using AI development tools such as Claude, Codex, or Google ADK

  • Experience building or scaling GTM systems for digital advertising, marketing technology, or other customer lifecycle programs

  • Experience designing systems that connect CRM platforms, cloud data warehouses, APIs, experimentation infrastructure, and cross-channel communications

  • Experience translating behavioral, contextual, and performance signals into personalization, targeting, or automated decisioning

  • Experience recruiting, coaching, and developing technically fluent teams of builders

jobDescription:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

Snap Research serves as an innovation engine for the company. Our projects range from solutions to hard technical problems that significantly enhance Snap’s existing products, to riskier explorations that can lead to fundamental paradigm shifts in the way people communicate and express themselves. The team consists of scientists and engineers who experiment with and invent new technology that has a lasting impact on Snap’s products. We also frequently publish our work at top conferences and journals in computer science and related fields.

We are looking for a Research Scientist to join our User Modeling and Personalization Research Team!  Our team’s mission is to invent new ways to model user behavior, and empower our business partners to build world-class user-centric ML systems which shape personalized experiences across Snap.  Our work spans the domains of generative and language models for information retrieval, efficient large-scale recommender systems, and representation learning for structured graph data. Together with you, we seek to redefine the state-of-the-art in technology to deliver our users customized experiences which delight them.

What you'll do:

  • Formulate and derive a research agenda in the user modeling and personalization domains, including generative modeling, recommendation systems, information retrieval, and efficiency

  • Partner with engineering teams to translate research to business impact for real-world ML applications used by millions of Snapchatters

  • Build scalable research prototypes and evaluate them in large-scale machine learning scenarios

  • Share your expertise with teammates and interns

  • Publish your findings at top conferences

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

  • Strong technical knowledge of machine learning, information retrieval, personalization, language and state-of-the-art deep learning literature

  • Demonstrated ability in defining, leading and executing challenging research projects

  • Strong computer science fundamentals, problem-solving and engineering skills (Python, PyTorch)

  • Pragmatic, hands-on approach to research with a drive to build working prototypes rather than solely rely on theoretical exploration

  • Proven ability to mentor interns, students and junior researchers
     

Minimum Qualifications:

  • PhD in computer science, machine learning, language technologies or related technical field such as statistics, mathematics, or equivalent years of experience

  • 5+ years of industry or postdoctoral experience

  • Track record of publications in top machine learning, information retrieval or language venues (e.g. ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, KDD, RecSys, SIGIR, WSDM, ACL, COLM, etc.)

  • Experience with distributed (multi-node and multi-GPU) ML model training, inference and experimentation

  • Experience applying language models in the context of generative search, ranking and/or personalization


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with large-scale machine learning problems in an academic or industrial research lab, or equivalent open-source experience

  • Experience with large-scale data processing, collection or synthesis using machine learning frameworks on Enterprise Cloud solutions like Google Cloud, AWS, and/or Azure

  • Familiarity with post-training, preference optimization, working with large-scale search or recommendation interaction data, and recommender systems

  • Demonstrated ability to transform cutting-edge research into tangible product improvements

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.


Snap’s Generative ML Platform team builds cutting-edge AI technologies that power creative, scalable experiences for hundreds of millions of Snapchatters worldwide. From multimodal LLMs and video generation to real-time AR, human understanding, and 3D content creation, we develop the full stack of generative AI, including foundational models, efficient infrastructure, and on-device and server-side inference. Our team creates intuitive tools, platforms, and agentic systems that empower creators, developers, and internal teams to bring ideas to life, while advancing personalized, human-centric experiences across mobile, web, and wearable devices like Spectacles.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join Snap Inc!

What you’ll do:

  • Develop innovative machine learning technology and products that serve millions of Snapchatters

  • Build cutting-edge augmented reality experiences using generative models

  • Deliver generative machine learning experiences on device

  • Partner with cross-functional Snap teams to explore and prototype new products

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • A proven passion for machine learning; you stay up-to-date with research and are excited about prototyping new ideas quickly

  • Familiarity with Neural Networks and Deep Learning and Generative Modeling

  • Deep understanding of mathematics and/or machine learning algorithms

  • Desire to solve open ambiguous problems

  • Desire to grow professionally, learn and help others

  • Ability to effectively collaborate with internal teams and external partners

  • Ability to work independently

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in technical field such as computer science, mathematics, statistics or equivalent years of experience

  • 8+ years of post-Bachelor’s machine learning or related experience; or a Master’s degree in a technical field + 7+ years of post-grad ML or related experience; or a PhD in a related technical field + 4+ years of post-grad ML or related experience

  • Experience with Computer Vision or Generative Modeling techniques

  • Experience working with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX, MLX, scikit-learn, or related frameworks

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in computer science or related field

  • Experience training large-scale diffusion models for images, videos or 3D

  • Knowledge of distillation, quantization and model compression techniques

  • Knowledge of GPU, CPU, or NPU  optimization techniques

  • Experience building and optimizing ML inference pipelines 

  • Experience working with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX, MLX, scikit-learn, or related frameworks

We're looking for a Compensation Business Partner to join Snap's Global Compensation team. In this role, you'll serve as a compensation partner to a portfolio of Engineering and Hardware / Revenue and G&A client groups, while also helping the broader team modernize how we work through smarter use of AI.

What You'll Do:

  • Serve as the compensation business partner for assigned Engineering and Hardware / Revenue and G&A client groups, advising HRBPs, recruiters, and leaders on pay decisions, offers, promotions, and job evaluations.

  • Exceptional analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for audiences ranging from managers to executives

  • Polished written, verbal, and presentation skills; comfortable building and delivering executive-ready slides and narratives

  • Familiarity with compensation norms and labor market trends outside the U.S.

  • Effective partner management skills, with experience navigating ambiguity across HRBPs, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and business leaders

  • Ability to use emerging technologies, including AI, responsibly to improve compensation workflows and team productivity.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, Finance, or another related field, or equivalent years of experience

  • 5+ years of compensation experience at a technology company

  • Experience serving as a compensation business partner to client groups and/or senior leaders

  • Hands-on experience with an HRIS platform (Workday strongly preferred) and market benchmarking tools (e.g., Radford, Pave, Compa)

The Marketing Science team at Snap helps advertisers get the highest possible ROI from Snap’s ads platform by using advanced measurement and analytics. We equip our Sales teams with what they need to be quantitatively driven, act as consultative partners to advertisers through training, tooling, and measurement best practices, and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Strategy, and Sales to ensure Snap’s ad products are effective, efficient, and customer‑centric.

We’re looking for a Principal Marketing Scientist to join Snap inc.!

What You’ll Do

  • Set and influence the measurement strategy for Snap’s third-party (3P) ecosystem, aligning solutions with business priorities, industry standards, and evolving advertiser needs

  • Build measurement fluency across Marketing Science, Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Partnerships, and other cross-functional teams; influence roadmap priorities and adoption without direct authority

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to senior executives at measurement partners and agencies, strengthening Snap’s reputation across Brand, Web, App, Attribution, Incrementality, and Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) solutions

  • Drive external thought leadership through white papers, conference presentations, industry committees, and narratives on measurement, ads efficacy, and Snap-specific analytics

  • Lead meta-analyses, performance benchmarking, and playbook development to scale learnings and performance proof points across markets, verticals, and advertisers

  • Establish operational excellence for third-party measurement, including solution evaluation, adoption, tracking, and governance

  • Contribute to quarterly partner business reviews, highlighting trends, progress against goals, and opportunities for innovation in measurement and analytics.

  • Use data and partner insights to identify innovation opportunities, make go/no-go recommendations, and guide strategic measurement decisions

  • Utilize AI tools to more efficiently develop scalable data solutions, while maintaining rigorous standards for accuracy and statistical integrity

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Deep expertise in digital advertising measurement, including Brand, Direct Response (DR), Web, App, Attribution, Incrementality, and MMM

  • Strong cross-functional and partner leadership skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders, external partners, and roadmaps without direct control

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, dashboarding, AI, and data visualization tools, with the ability to oversee technical work and contribute hands-on when needed

  • Strong knowledge of applied statistics, causal inference, time-series modeling, data mining, and measurement methodologies

  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to translate complex analytical and measurement concepts for executive audiences.

  • Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on problem solving across enablement, budgeting, partner management, measurement strategy, and individual-contributor initiatives

  • Adaptability in learning and applying evolving AI systems and tools to remain at the forefront of data-driven decision-making, insights generation, and industry best practices

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or business field or equivalent years of practical work experience

  • 10+ years of post-Bachelor’s advanced analytics and measurement experience; or Master’s degree in a quantitative or business field + 9 years of post-graduate advanced analytics and measurement experience; or PhD in a relevant field + 6 year of post-graduate advanced analytics and measurement experience

  • Experience in marketing science, product strategy, ads measurement or a related field within a technology, media agency, consulting firm, advertiser, or research company

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in business, mathematics, economics, engineering, or a related field

  • Extensive experience working with advertisers of varied sizes and verticals across both Brand and DR measurement

  • Direct experience at an advertising measurement company or within a related measurement-focused function

  • Demonstrated success building relationships with clients, agencies, measurement partners, and C-level stakeholders

  • Experience developing teams or leading peers through coaching, influence, and capability building

  • Expertise in partner ecosystem methodology and research, including evaluating solutions, making investment or go/no-go decisions, and using data to shape measurement strategy

  • Experience in analytics or measurement leadership roles

We are looking for an L6 Staff Technical Lead to define the strategy and technical direction for Snap’s Storage, Caching, and Identity infrastructure.

In this hands-on leadership role, you will drive high-impact, multi-quarter initiatives; design and operate highly available distributed systems across AWS and GCP; and improve reliability, performance, cost efficiency, and developer experience at scale. You will influence architecture across critical Storage, Caching, User, Friends, and Relationship services, partner broadly across Infrastructure and Product Engineering, mentor engineers, and turn ambiguous technical challenges into durable platforms and executable roadmaps.

This is an exciting opportunity to shape how Snap’s Storage & Caching Infrastructure evolves to meet the demands of an AI-first world. If you are passionate about building large-scale distributed systems and foundational infrastructure, we would love to hear from you.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the technical direction for Snap’s Service Infrastructure platform, defining multi-quarter and multi-year roadmaps across areas such as service mesh, compute, observability, and adjacent platform capabilities.

  • Design, build, and operate foundational backend infrastructure that powers critical services across Snap with a focus on reliability, scalability, performance, and operational excellence.

  • Act as a hands-on Staff-level tech lead, driving ambiguous and high-impact technical initiatives from concept through architecture, implementation, rollout, and iteration.

  • Partner closely with engineers and leaders across infrastructure and product teams to align on technical direction, priorities, trade-offs, and long-term platform investments.

  • Improve the developer and operator experience for teams building on Snap’s backend platform by creating durable systems, abstractions, and mechanisms that raise engineering velocity and quality at scale.

  • Drive best practices in service reliability, observability, incident response, system performance, and cost efficiency across mission-critical infrastructure.

  • Mentor and uplevel other engineers, provide technical leadership across team boundaries, and help resolve complex technical conflicts to move the organization forward.

  • Help shape how Snap’s infrastructure evolves for an AI-first future, including identifying opportunities where AI can improve platform quality, developer productivity, or operational workflows in a responsible and scalable way.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Deep experience designing, building, and operating backend services or distributed systems at significant scale.

  • Strong technical leadership skills, with the ability to set vision, ideate high-impact projects, and translate strategy into executable roadmaps.

  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives over multiple quarters while balancing architectural quality, reliability, and delivery velocity.

  • Strong foundation in system design, including APIs, service architecture, compute platforms, storage concepts, observability, and workflow orchestration.

  • Proven track record of owning highly available, mission-critical systems, including operational readiness, incident response, and systemic improvements.

  • Strong judgment in making technical trade-offs and prioritizing the right long-term platform investments for a large engineering organization.

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence engineers and leaders across Senior Manager- or Director-level organizations.

  • Ability to mentor, unblock, and elevate other engineers while creating structures and mechanisms that make teams more effective over time.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and driving clarity in technically complex problem spaces.

  • Familiarity with responsible use of emerging AI technologies to improve engineering quality, alignment, and innovation at scale.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 9+ years of software development experience; or a Master’s degree in a technical field and 8+ years of software development experience; or a PhD in a related technical field and 5+ years of software development experience.

  • Experience a technical lead, domain expert, or owner of complex technical initiatives.

  • Experience building and operating backend systems or distributed systems in production environments.

  • Experience leading architecture or platform direction beyond an individual team, with demonstrated influence across stakeholders and partner teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with service infrastructure domains such as service mesh, compute platforms, observability, or related backend platform systems.

  • Experience with large-scale microservices, cloud infrastructure, storage systems, or platform architecture.

  • Experience with Go, Java, Python, C++, or similar backend languages.

  • Experience with Kubernetes, containerized systems, developer platforms, or internal infrastructure tooling.

  • Experience driving long-term technical strategy for a platform or infrastructure area.

  • Track record of delivering large-scale, high-impact technical work across team boundaries.

  • Experience applying AI to infrastructure, developer tooling, platform quality, or engineering productivity is a plus.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.


We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join Snap Inc on our Feature Store team!

This tech lead will be responsible for the design of the team's systems and data pipelines, establishing clear abstractions and reusable components so the team builds on common foundations rather than duplicating work. You'll drive development of the core services and data flows — including how data is stored, retrieved and served for both high-throughput and low-latency use cases — while ensuring they meet correctness, performance, and reliability requirements. A central part of the role is enforcing engineering quality through validation, testing, monitoring, and observability and owning the operational health of these systems from cost efficiency to on-call and incident response. Throughout, you'll set technical direction, review designs and code, and mentor engineers, raising the bar on craftsmanship across the team.
 

What you’ll do: 

  • Serve features reliably for large-scale batch inference and low-latency online inference, maintaining consistency across serving paths and meeting latency and freshness requirements of production models.

  • Maintain features in a centralized, versioned feature registry, ensuring definitions are discoverable, well-documented and reusable across teams and models so common logic is defined once rather than duplicated.

  • Design and manage feature storage solutions for correctness, freshness and efficient retrieval, selecting appropriate storage patterns for training-scale reads and low-latency serving lookups.

  • Build scalable, distributed systems with attention to compute and storage efficiency, backed by monitoring, alerting, and sound operational practices that keep feature serving systems reliable and maintainable in production.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

  • Deep experience designing, building and operating backend services or distributed systems at significant scale.

  • Strong technical leadership skills, with the ability to set vision, ideate high-impact projects and translate strategy into executable roadmaps.

  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives over multiple quarters while balancing architectural quality, reliability and delivery velocity.

  • Strong foundation in system design, including APIs, service architecture, compute platforms, storage concepts, observability and workflow orchestration.

  • Proven track record of owning highly available, mission-critical systems, including operational readiness, incident response and systemic improvements.

  • Strong judgment in making technical trade-offs and prioritizing the right long-term platform investments for a large engineering organization.

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence engineers and leaders across Senior Manager- or Director-level organizations.

  • Ability to mentor, unblock and elevate other engineers while creating structures and mechanisms that make teams more effective over time.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and driving clarity in technically complex problem spaces.

  • Familiarity with responsible use of emerging AI technologies to improve engineering quality, alignment and innovation at scale.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

  • 9+ years of software development experience; or Master’s degree with 8+ years of experience; or PhD with 5+ years of experience

  • Experience as a technical lead, domain expert or owner of complex technical initiatives

  • Experience building large scale storage, backend or distributed systems 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Deep expertise in modern C++ (C++11/14/17), with experience in large-scale production codebases

  • Experience with C++, Go, Java, Python or similar backend languages. 

  • Experience with large-scale microservices, cloud infrastructure and/or platform architecture

  • Proficiency with performance optimization techniques

  • Experience building or scaling ML Infrastructure systems and/or real-time data pipelines

  • Strong CS fundamentals (algorithms and data structures) and problem-solving skills

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, iterative and highly collaborative environment

  • Knowledge of software design patterns and best practices

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.


Specs Inc. is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Snap Inc. dedicated to making computing more human. The company develops Specs, advanced eyewear that seamlessly integrates digital experiences into the physical world.


Specs feature see-through lenses that place digital objects directly into three-dimensional space, powered by Snap OS, a proprietary, context-aware operating system designed for natural interaction with your hands and voice.


Specs Inc. also provides Lens Studio, a full suite of advanced developer tools that powers immersive augmented reality experiences across Specs, Snapchat, and other services.


We’re looking for a RF Hardware Engineer to join the Spectacles team!


What you’ll do:

  • Design and/or develop highly integrated RF and wireless systems that contribute to exciting launches of hardware here at Spectacles
  • Collaborate closely with internal and external teams such as mechanical, software, industrial design teams, and suppliers
  • Create schematics that include not only RF components, but also high speed digital systems, power supplies, sensors, etc.
  • Perform, supervise, and/or review layout for PCB, flex, and rigid-flex designs
  • Develop test plans, perform RF validation and generate validation reports
  • Debug hardware issues, including baseband and RF circuits.
  • Design electrical and wireless prototypes for new product concepts
  • Author clear and comprehensive documentation

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong RF engineering fundamentals including RF system analysis and link budgets
  • Thorough understanding of RF PCB design, associated constraints, impedance matching, and/or filter tuning
  • Experience with hardware level board design including schematic capture and CAD layout
  • Ability to develop and execute test plans to validate circuits, components, and electrical systems
  • Demonstrated ability to use common RF and electrical test equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, and power supplies
  • Familiarity with tools like Cadence Allegro, OrCAD Capture, Advanced Design Systems, and/or Matlab
  • Understanding of RF behavior and fundamentals including impedance matching, noise figure, mixing, linearity, and smith charts
  • Working knowledge of wireless communication standards including WiFi, BT/BLE, GNSS, 4G LTE, 5G, etc 
  • Understanding of layout strategies that mitigate desense and/or EMI, enable signal integrity, and provide isolation
  • Experience designing systems that include high-speed digital interfaces such as MIPI CSI / DSI, PCIe, SDIO / eMMC, UFS, etc.
  • Proficiency with RF simulation/design tools (e.g., CST Microwave Studio, Keysight ADS, XFdtd, etc.)

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as electrical engineering or equivalent years of experience
  • Demonstrated experience designing integrated RF/electrical circuits and systems, RF system analysis, component and chipset selection
  • Ability to travel including domestic and international (up to 15%)
  • 10+ years relevant experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in Wireless, Electromagnetics, Electrical engineering or related field 
  • Ability to solder small discrete components such as 0402s, 0201s and 01005s
  • Experience designing and/or scoping integrated RF and electrical components within a single module

The Data Science and Insights team seeks to leverage our massive data sets into actionable insights that deliver business value. As truth seekers and truth tellers, we relay what the data says without bias, even when inconvenient or difficult. We aim to improve decision-making quality and speed across the organization to enable a deeper understanding of our customers and products. We focus on efficient and effective analytic execution, positioning ourselves as the go-to experts with deep knowledge and expertise, constantly striving for better, faster insights from data.

We’re looking for a Sr. Data Scientist to join Snap Inc.

What you’ll do:

  • Apply your expertise in quantitative analysis, data mining, and statistical modeling to deliver impactful, objective, and actionable data insights that enable informed business and product decisions

  • Drive informed and timely decision-making that improves and optimizes the way our products are created, executed, and adopted'

  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, product marketers, and designers

  • Think creatively, proactively, and futuristically to identify and size up new opportunities within Snap's long term roadmap for data-scientific contributions

  • Conduct machine learning or statistical analyses, and build pragmatic, scalable, and statistically rigorous solutions to deliver actionable insights, accurate predictions, and effective optimizations

  • Communicate best practices in quantitative analysis and develop cross-functional partnerships

  • Utilize AI tools to more efficiently develop scalable data solutions, while maintaining rigorous standards for accuracy and statistical integrity.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Expertise using data modeling skills to identify key product trends and new product opportunities

  • Ability to design implement, and track core metrics to analyze the performance of our products

  • Ability to create visuals, dashboards, and reports to effectively communicate your insights

  • Experience collaborating with engineers, product managers, and other cross-functional teams

  • Ability to initiate and drive projects to completion with minimal guidance

  • An understanding of Snapchat with great product sense and product understanding

  • Ability to communicate complex quantitative analysis in a clear, precise, and actionable manner

  • Adaptability in learning and applying evolving AI systems and tools to remain at the forefront of data-driven decision-making, insights generation, and industry best practices

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in a relevant technical field such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, engineering or related field or equivalent years of practical work experience

  • 5+ years of post-Bachelor’s quantitative analysis and data science experience ; or a Master’s degree in a technical field + 4+ years of post-grad quantitative analysis and data science experience; or a PhD in a related technical field + 1+ years of post-grad  quantitative analysis and data science experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience using SQL or similar big data querying languages

  • 5+ years of experience with programming language, such as Python or R

  • 5+ years of experience with applied statistical techniques, such as inferential methods, causal methods, A/B testing, or statistical modeling techniques

  • Advanced degree in applied mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, economics or related field

  • Experience in a product-focused role at a social media, online advertising, digital media and/or mobile technology company

  • Experience using machine learning and statistical analysis for building data-driven product solutions or performing methodological research.

jobTitle: Senior Sales Operations Associate - Revenue Tooling
jobDescription:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.


The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.


We’re searching for a dynamic Senior Sales Operations Associate to join Team Snap! As a member of our Revenue Tools & Data Intelligence team, you’ll take ownership of initiatives that improve seller efficiency through better tooling, stronger data quality, and scalable operational processes. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Sales Leadership, CRM Technology, Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams to clarify business needs, evaluate tradeoffs, implement solutions, drive adoption, and improve the systems that support our revenue organization.

What You’ll Do

  • Define process gaps, tooling needs, and data quality issues; evaluate tradeoffs, and translate them into clear operational or technical requirements and recommended solutions

  • Improve and strengthen CRM data quality through cleansing, structuring, enrichment, governance, account maintenance, and execution of account assignments aligned with business rules and evolving team needs

  • Manage and improve third-party tools that support our sales team, including evaluating needs through launch, and supporting adoption and effective utilization

  • Partner with CRM Technology, Product, Engineering, and other technical teams to prioritize, scope, test, launch, and drive adoption of tools and workflows for Sales and cross-functional partners

  • Use AI-enabled tools and workflows to prototype solutions, accelerate analysis, improve documentation, and make operational work more efficient

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Ability to operate effectively across systems, tooling, and data workflows in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce CRM, including data structure, business process support, and customization beyond basic out-of-the-box usage

  • Experience improving and strengthening data quality and operational rigor through process standardization, governance, and workflow optimization

  • Ability to define business requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and recommend scalable operational or technical solutions

  • Experience partnering with technical teams and cross functional partners to deliver automation, tooling improvements, or system enhancements through launch and adoption

  • Strong analytical skills, including comfort working with large datasets and tools such as SQL, Tableau, Looker, Google Sheets, or Excel.

  • Strong project management, communication, and prioritization skills; comfort resolving ambiguity and managing multiple work streams in a fast-paced environment

  • Ability to serve as a go-to resource on revenue tooling, CRM, and data workflows, and to coach teammates on processes and best practices

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Technical Program Management, CRM Administration, Data Operations, or a related field

  • Bachelor’s degree in a business, marketing, communications, computer science, engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large sales organizations in the tech, media, or digital advertising industry

  • Experience driving adoption of operational or tooling changes with sales teams and cross-functional partners

jobTitle: Manager, Environmental Health & Safety, Specs Operations
jobDescription:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

We're looking for an experienced Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Manager, to provide strategic leadership for EHS programs across Specs Operations. This role will establish and drive a unified EHS strategy, ensure regulatory compliance, strengthen risk management programs, and foster a world-class safety culture across manufacturing, R&D, engineering, and operational environments.

This position serves as the EHS leader for Specs Operations in EMEA, with responsibility for EHS strategy, governance, and program execution across the Abingdon (UK), Chandler (Arizona) and other EMEA Specs locations as business needs evolve.

The role may be based in either London or Abingdon, UK. The successful candidate will be expected to maintain a strong operational presence within the business through regular and significant time spent in Abingdon, partnering closely with site leadership, engineering, manufacturing, facilities, and workplace teams.

The role also requires occasional international travel to Chandler, Arizona and other Specs locations across Europe to support operational initiatives, audits, expansion projects, leadership engagement, and program implementation activities.

What you’ll do:

EHS Strategy & Leadership

  • Lead the development, governance, and continuous improvement of EHS standards, programs, and strategic initiatives across Specs Operations globally, ensuring consistency while enabling site specific operational requirements.
  • Establish annual EHS objectives, key results, and performance indicators for Abingdon, Chandler, and other assigned Specs locations.
  • Present EHS performance, emerging risks, compliance status, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership and executive stakeholders, enabling informed business and operational decisions.
  • Provide leadership and direction for EHS Specialists, including performance management, coaching, career development, and succession planning.
  • Influence organizational decision making by integrating EHS considerations into operational, engineering, and business planning processes.
  • Build a high performance safety culture focused on accountability, risk reduction, and continuous improvement.

Governance, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Own EHS management systems, ensuring alignment with ISO 14001, ISO 45001, HSG65 principles, and Snap corporate standards.
  • Provide strategic oversight of compliance with applicable UK, U.S., and local environmental, health, and safety regulations.
  • Establish governance processes for compliance, auditing, inspections, corrective actions, and management reviews.
  • Lead enterprise-level risk assessments for manufacturing, cleanroom, and R&D operations.
  • Ensure effective management of regulatory obligations, permits, compliance documentation, agency interactions, and external audits.

Manufacturing, R&D and High-Hazard Program Ownership

  • Own EHS programs supporting manufacturing, engineering, R&D, cleanroom, facilities, and operational functions.
  • Provide strategic oversight of hazardous materials, hazardous waste, chemical safety, machine safety, contractor safety, laser safety, industrial hygiene, and hazardous gas safety programs.
  • Establish governance and performance standards for hazardous gas systems, including toxic and hazardous gas storage, distribution, monitoring, and emergency response programs.
  • Partner with Engineering, Facilities, Manufacturing, Workplace Services, and Operations leaders to ensure EHS requirements are integrated into facility design, equipment procurement, commissioning, and operational changes.
  • Provide EHS leadership for capital projects, facility expansions, equipment installations, new technologies, and operational scale-up initiatives through proactive risk management and design review.

Organizational Capability & Culture

  • Develop EHS competency frameworks, training strategies, and leadership engagement programs for employees, contractors, and leaders.
  • Lead safety committees, emergency response teams, and cross-functional governance forums to strengthen accountability and operational excellence.
  • Promote the sharing of lessons learned, best practices, and standardized methodologies across locations.

Program Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish EHS maturity assessments and continuous improvement roadmaps.
  • Manage EHS budgets, resource planning, and annual objectives.
  • Utilize data analytics, leading indicators, and risk trends to identify opportunities for operational improvement and risk reduction.
  • Develop business cases and strategic recommendations for EHS investments, staffing, and growth initiatives.

Incident Management & Emergency Preparedness

  • Lead investigations of serious incidents, significant near misses, and high potential events across assigned Specs locations.
  • Ensure robust root cause analysis methodologies are applied and corrective actions are effectively implemented and sustained.
  • Oversee emergency preparedness and EHS business continuity programs across assigned Specs locations, ensuring organizational readiness for operational disruptions, emergency events, and EHS business continuity risks.
  • Provide strategic leadership during significant incidents and emergency events, coordinating with site leadership, Security, Workplace Services, and executive stakeholders to support response and recovery efforts.

Minimum Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health & Safety, Engineering, Occupational Health, Environmental Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of progressive Environmental Health & Safety experience.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience managing EHS professionals or leading multi-site EHS programs.
  • Expert knowledge of EHS management systems, regulatory compliance, risk management, and strategic program development in manufacturing, R&D, cleanroom, semiconductor, advanced technology, or hardware development environments.
  • Experience managing EHS programs within manufacturing, R&D, cleanroom, semiconductor, advanced technology, or hardware development environments.
  • Experience leading EHS programs across multiple locations, business units, or regulatory jurisdictions
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to communicate technical and regulatory risks to executive and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • NEBOSH Diploma (Level 6), CSP, CMIOSH, or equivalent advanced EHS qualification.
  • Experience leading EHS programs across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions.
  • Experience leading EHS governance programs within global hardware, manufacturing, semiconductor, or advanced technology organizations.
  • Demonstrated success building EHS organizations during periods of rapid growth, expansion, operational transformation, mergers, acquisitions, or facility growth initiatives.

We’re looking for an experienced Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Advisor to support the HSE program at our Abingdon, UK facility. This role partners with site leadership, engineering, operations, and the Global HSE team to help maintain compliance and drive continuous improvement in a technically complex manufacturing and laboratory environment. The role serves as a hands-on site HSE subject matter expert and trusted partner to the local team.

Work Schedule: On-site | Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm, with flexibility to work occasional nights/weekends and emergency response activities as required.

Reporting Line: This role reports to the HSE Manager.

What you’ll do:

HSE Program Delivery & Technical Guidance

  • Drive implementation and continual improvement of the site HSE management system.

  • Act as the primary HSE point of contact and senior subject matter expert for the Abingdon site, providing authoritative technical guidance to site leadership and cross-functional partners.

  • Translate global and regional HSE objectives into site-level programs, actions, and performance metrics.

  • Work collaboratively with site and global HSE teams to share best practices and improve performance in Abingdon.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with UK environmental and occupational health and safety legislation, including the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, COSHH, DSEAR, PUWER, Environmental Permitting Regulations, and the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order.

  • Maintain legal registers, regulatory applicability assessments, and site compliance documentation.

  • Lead site HSE audits, inspections, and regulatory interactions, including preparation, execution, and closure of findings.

  • Oversee risk assessment programs for manufacturing processes, laboratories, equipment, and new technology introductions, ensuring appropriate controls are defined and implemented.

  • Develop and monitor leading and lagging HSE performance indicators to proactively identify risk trends and drive continuous improvement.

  • Support the Management of Change (MOC) process for new equipment, process modifications, laboratory changes, and technology introductions.

  • Partner with engineering and operations teams to support safe installation, operation, and maintenance of toxic and hazardous gas systems, including gas cabinets, detection systems, and associated emergency controls in compliance with COSHH and DSEAR.

  • Ensure compliance with UK environmental legislation and permit requirements, maintaining environmental management programs for hazardous waste, air emissions, wastewater, spill prevention, and pollution prevention.

  • Conduct environmental risk assessments, audits, and regulatory interactions, ensuring environmental requirements are incorporated into new processes, equipment, and facility modifications.

Hazardous Materials & manufacturing Safety

  • Manage site hazardous materials, hazardous waste, and toxic and hazardous gas safety programs, including governance, procedures, and engineering control strategies.

  • Ensure effective management of toxic and hazardous gas systems, including gas cabinets, detection and alarm systems, ventilation controls, and emergency response readiness, in compliance with COSHH and DSEAR.

  • Provide HSE leadership for manufacturing, laboratory, and cleanroom safety programs, including machine safety, laser safety, hazardous gases, and contractor safety.

  • Partner with engineering, facilities, and vendors to support safe design, installation, commissioning, and modification of tools and equipment.

Training, Culture & Engagement

  • Develop, coordinate, and deliver regulatory-required and role-based HSE training programs.

  • Champion a proactive safety culture through visible leadership, engagement with employees and contractors, and accountability at all levels.

  • Provide technical leadership to site safety committees and working groups, ensuring effective governance and follow-through on actions.

  • Apply modern safety principles, including Human and Organizational Performance (HOP), to strengthen system resilience and organizational learning.

Incident Management & Emergency Response

  • Lead investigations of incidents, near-misses, and high-potential events using root cause analysis and ensuring robust corrective and preventive actions.

  • Serve as the HSE lead for  emergency response activities during site events, coordinating with site leadership and post-incident recovery efforts as needed.

  • Ensure site emergency preparedness programs, emergency response teams, drills, and equipment readiness are established and maintained..

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong knowledge of UK HSE regulatory requirements and practical application in manufacturing, laboratory, or high-hazard environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead site-level HSE programs and influence cross-functional partners.

  • Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities in complex technical environments.

  • Ability to provide technical leadership, mentoring, or supervision to HSE professionals.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage regulators, leadership, employees, and contractors.

  • Experience supporting the safe use and control of toxic and hazardous gases, including monitoring systems, emergency procedures, and compliance with DSEAR and COSHH requirements.

Minimum Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Health & Safety, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in Environmental Health & Safety.

  • NEBOSH Diploma (Level 6) or equivalent professional qualification.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience leading HSE programs in semiconductor manufacturing, cleanroom, laboratory, or advanced manufacturing environments.

  • Experience implementing and sustaining  HSG65 principles, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems.

  • Chartered status (CMIOSH) or working toward chartership.

The Audit Manager is responsible for leading complex, high-impact internal audit engagements that add value and strengthen organizational operations. This role provides independent, objective assurance and advisory services by evaluating the effectiveness of internal controls, risk management, governance processes, financial reporting, and operational efficiency.

Reporting to the Chief Audit Officer, the Audit Manager operates with significant independence, exercising sound judgment and leadership while overseeing audit activities and mentoring audit staff.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, manage, and deliver complex audit engagements from planning through reporting, ensuring quality, timeliness, and alignment with organizational priorities
  • Develop risk-based audit plans, including scope, objectives, methodologies, timelines, and resource allocation
  • Conduct and oversee risk assessments, process walkthroughs, and control evaluations to identify key risks and define audit strategies
  • Design and execute comprehensive audit programs and procedures aligned with audit objectives
  • Oversee audit fieldwork, including control testing, data analysis, and evaluation of financial and operational processes
  • Assess audit results, identify control deficiencies, and evaluate risk exposure
  • Develop practical, sustainable, and risk-based recommendations and effectively influence stakeholders to implement improvements
  • Prepare and review clear, concise, and well-supported audit reports and executive presentations for leadership and the Board Audit Committee
  • Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships across the organization; effectively manage conflict and drive alignment
  • Lead audit follow-up activities to ensure timely and effective remediation of audit findings
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and review of work performed by audit staff (if applicable)
  • Stay current on industry trends, regulatory changes, and best practices in internal auditing, risk management, and controls

The Enterprise AI Architect is responsible for defining and evolving ALSAC's enterprise architecture standards for Artificial Intelligence (AI), Agentic AI, and AI-enabled applications. The Enterprise AI Architect provides architecture guidance, develops reusable patterns and standards, and helps teams successfully move AI solutions from concept through production implementation. This role collaborates across stakeholders to evaluate technologies, establish best practices, and ensure AI investments support ALSAC's long-term technology strategy.

Essential Job Functions

  • Define enterprise architecture standards, reference architectures, and implementation patterns for AI, Agentic AI, and AI-enabled solutions.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather, analyze, communicate, and validate requirements impacting ALSAC's enterprise technology environment.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, systems integration, software engineering, or related technology disciplines.

  • Experience developing architecture standards, reference architectures, and technology governance practices.
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms, application integration, enterprise security, and modern software architecture patterns.

Job Description

At the intersection of generosity and healthcare innovation, the Executive Advisor, Transformational Gifts plays a critical leadership role in advancing our most ambitious philanthropic goals. This is not a traditional frontline fundraising role, although the Executive Advisor manages a portfolio of donors.  It is a strategic, highly collaborative position focused on activating relationships with ultra-wealth net worth individuals/families, empowering leaders and aligning donor passions with institutional vision at the $10M+ giving level. As a trusted partner to executive leadership, professional advisors and relationship managers at all levels, this individual will help cultivate, shape solicit and steward some of the most significant giving opportunities in our organization’s history. 

Essential Job Duties

1.    Portfolio management:  Responsible for driving revenue through the qualification, cultivation, solicitation, closing and stewardship of 10M+ gifts, meeting or exceeding established goals. 
2.    Transformational Gift Strategy: Partner with internal teams to design, refine, and drive strategies for engaging individuals, families and foundations with the capacity and intent to make transformational gifts ($10M+), ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and impact goals. Success in this role will be measured by progressive metrics – including influence on donor strategy, movement toward transformational investment, depth of engagement, activation of internal leaders and revenue targets – reflecting the complexity and long-term nature of transformational philanthropy. 

3.    Consulting and Capacity Building: Provide strategic internal consulting to relationship managers from across the organization - regardless of title or department – who are connected to transformational prospects. This includes preparation for donor conversations, gift strategy and development, long-term relationship building and solicitation. 

4.    Executive Engagement: Collaborate with the SVP – Transformational Giving, C-Suite executives, and clinical or operational leadership from the hospital on high-stakes donor cultivation steps as needed. Help prepare and coach them for pivotal donor meetings, events and stewardship activities. 

5.    High Value Volunteer Engagement: Serve in support of advisory boards and councils. Plan meaningful engagement opportunities for virtual and on campus experiences that deepen their connection to the mission and demonstrates impact. When possible, leverage their networks thoughtfully and strategically to identify and cultivate new transformational relationships, supporting peer to peer influence and expanding the pipeline of $10M+ prospects. 

6.    Narrative & Case Co-Creation: Work cross-functionally to co-create custom proposals and transformational investment opportunities that reflect the donor’s vision, values, and desired legacy – while advancing our mission in measurable, meaningful ways. 7.    Strategic Initiatives & Campaign Leadership: Play a key role in the development and execution of high-profile philanthropic initiatives, including milestone institutional anniversaries, enterprise-wide campaigns, and research-focused funding priorities. Collaborate across departments to shape compelling campaign strategies and donor experiences that align with transformational giving principles. Serve as a thought partner in designing customized approaches for complex, time-bound opportunities that inspire significant investment and long-term commitment. 

Job Requirements

  • 10+ years’ relevant work experience and proven experience in closing and/or advising on 8- and 9- figure philanthropic conversations, ideally in healthcare, higher education, or a complex mission-driven institution. 
  • Bachelor’s degree required, advanced degree preferred.
  • Natural coach and facilitator, able to build confidence and skill in others while honoring their authentic leadership style.
  • Ability to understand and translate a wide range of in-depth research initiatives and clinical care innovations into compelling, donor centered opportunities. 
  • Comfortable working in highly matrixed environments, influencing without formal authority. 
  • Exceptional emotional intelligence and ability to hold high-trust, high-impact conversations with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Involves extensive travel, willingness and flexibility to travel nationally, including evenings and weekends.

Job Description

As a Sr. Advisor Area Development at ALSAC, you manage a blended portfolio of leadership annual donors, corporate partners, high-value volunteers, event committees, and strategic fundraising initiatives throughout Southern California. The Sr. Advisor Area Development is responsible for driving revenue growth through donor cultivation, sponsorship engagement, volunteer leadership development, fundraising events, stewardship activities, and cross-functional collaboration in support of ALSAC's mission. This role supports key Southern California fundraising initiatives, including Evening of Hope and other high-value donor and volunteer engagement opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

1. Creative Visionary

In collaboration with area leadership, develop and execute iconic signature event experiences that transcend expectations, from intimate gatherings to grand galas. Provide strategic leadership for complex, high-revenue fundraising events, donor cultivation experiences, and volunteer-led initiatives. Drive recruitment, engagement, and stewardship of high-profile volunteer leaders, event committees, and corporate partners while ensuring fundraising goals are achieved.

2. Organizational Pro

Manage multiple fundraising initiatives and projects autonomously with exceptional attention to detail. Coordinate event planning, sponsorship development, volunteer management, donor engagement, and stewardship activities while balancing competing priorities and deadlines.

3. Cultivate Relationships with Purpose

Utilize your exceptional interpersonal and relationship development skills to recruit, engage, and steward corporate partners, individual donors, sponsors, committee members, and volunteer leaders. Through strategic communication, personal visits, fundraising activations, and cultivation opportunities, establish relationships that extend beyond transactions and foster long-term philanthropic investment.

4. Collaborate for Impact

Partner across enterprise functions, including Development, Marketing, Event Production, Data Strategy, Volunteer Engagement, Finance, and Philanthropic Advisory teams to execute fundraising strategies and ensure alignment with organizational goals and donor engagement best practices. Monitor KPIs, assess outcomes, and recommend strategic adjustments to maximize impact.

5. Empower Fundraising Initiatives

Leverage your fundraising expertise to inspire and empower volunteers, leadership committees, sponsors, and donors. Provide motivation, direction, training, and resources through personal visits, strategic communications, and engagement opportunities to help achieve fundraising and relationship development goals.

6. Strategize for Growth

Develop and implement innovative cultivation, solicitation, stewardship, and moves management strategies that strengthen engagement and philanthropic support among leadership annual, corporate, and major donor prospects. Identify opportunities to increase revenue growth and deepen stakeholder engagement.

7. Champion Donor Relationships

Manage a blended portfolio of 75-100 leadership annual donors, corporate partners, high-value volunteers, event committee members, and donor prospects. Build, maintain, and advance relationships through strategic cultivation, stewardship, sponsorship engagement, and revenue-generating opportunities designed to increase donor retention and philanthropic investment.

8. Collaboration

Collaborate closely with Development and Philanthropic Advisory teams to strengthen donor and volunteer relationship management strategies. Ensure alignment across stewardship, financial analysis, prospect management, and fundraising initiatives to maximize organizational impact and donor experience.

9. Data-Driven Impact

Utilize donor data, engagement insights, and fundraising analytics to inform strategic decision-making, stewardship plans, and portfolio management. Leverage data systems to create personalized donor experiences and optimize fundraising outcomes.

10. Elevate Our Presence

Represent ALSAC/St. Jude Children's Research Hospital in all interactions with donors, volunteers, sponsors, corporate partners, and community stakeholders. Serve as a trusted ambassador who advances the organization's mission and reinforces its commitment to excellence.

Qualifications and Experience

Strategic Fundraising Event Leadership

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, high-revenue fundraising events, including galas, golf tournaments, dinners, and volunteer-led initiatives generating $1M+ in annual revenue. Proven ability to oversee strategic planning, fundraising execution, sponsorship development, volunteer engagement, and revenue performance.

Compelling Communication

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly, build consensus, influence stakeholders, and inspire action among donors, volunteers, sponsors, and community leaders.

Relationship-Based Fundraising

  • Demonstrated success cultivating, soliciting, stewarding, and managing relationships with leadership annual donors, corporate partners, major donor prospects, and volunteer leaders. Proven ability to implement moves management strategies that drive donor engagement and revenue growth.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Project Management

  • Experience navigating multiple stakeholders and coordinating efforts across fundraising, marketing, volunteer engagement, event planning, production, finance, and other enterprise teams. Strong project management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and maintain momentum across multiple initiatives.

Experience in Philanthropy

  • Strong background in relationship-based fundraising, committee engagement, corporate partnerships, board development, strategic planning, and execution of premier fundraising events. Experience developing donor engagement strategies and volunteer leadership programs that drive fundraising success.

Senior Leadership Presence

  • Demonstrated leadership capability with a strategic mindset focused on revenue growth, volunteer leadership development, donor engagement, sponsorship expansion, and innovative fundraising solutions.

Corporate Sector Relationships

  • Ideally possess established relationships within the corporate sector and a proven ability to identify, cultivate, solicit, and steward corporate sponsors and donors.

High-Value Volunteer Leadership

  • Proven ability to recruit, inspire, engage, and steward influential volunteer leaders, executive committees, corporate partners, boards, and community stakeholders. Experience managing complex volunteer structures and committee-driven fundraising efforts.

  • Six or more years of relevant experience in fundraising, development, sales, business development, customer relationship management, or a related field. Bachelor's degree preferred. Travel 15%-20%, including nights, weekends, and periodic travel to Memphis, TN.
