In this role, you will serve as a trusted on-site resource for an automotive client, ensuring import transactions are accurate, compliant, and resolved efficiently. You will review customs documentation, classifications, valuations, trade programs, and regulatory requirements while partnering with brokers and internal teams to support smooth operations. Apply today to make an impact in a highly visible role at the center of global trade compliance.

This position follows a Thursday through Monday schedule. Work hours are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. CST (8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. PST) on Saturdays and Sundays and 1:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m. CST (11:30 a.m. – 8:30 p.m. PST) on Thursday, Friday, and Monday. Join us as an Associate Portfolio Executive and begin learning and building your customer portfolio as part of an accelerated training track, ensuring service delivery aligns with customer commitments. As a brand ambassador, you'll drive positive customer experiences while expanding your business portfolio. Upon completion of the training track, you will move into a Portfolio Executive role. The Associate Portfolio Executive position stands out as a premier opportunity, offering abundant resources and development support. For those committed to putting in the work, there's no better role for a long and successful career in this industry.

As an Associate Portfolio Executive, you’ll focus on re-engaging dormant accounts as well as cold calling new opportunities, without the need to prospect. This unique approach allows you to focus solely on relationship development and business expansion, setting us apart from competitors who spend more time finding leads than nurturing customer relationships.

What makes this role unique?

Our unparalleled support system allows you to effectively manage your portfolio with confidence. We provide robust technology that amplifies your capabilities and bandwidth, enabling management of large portfolios efficiently. Additionally, our emphasis on autonomy allows you the freedom to run your business with our extensive network and scalability.

We prioritize your growth.

Our strong onboarding program and commitment to personal development within the organization ensure you have the tools for success. The collaborative culture and managerial focus on your development propel your career forward.

Everyday life in this role is dynamic.

You have the opportunity to win daily with our established customer base. Moreover, we promote a supportive environment, ensuring a work-life balance where teams support each other, allowing everyone to enjoy PTO.

If you're driven, money-motivated, and passionate about relationship-building and problem-solving, apply now to be part of our team!

Customer Experience:

  • Drive the conversion of sales leads into active customers by establishing strong contacts, fostering relationships, and comprehensively understanding customer needs to achieve the highest possible conversation rate

  • Respond promptly to customer inquiries and exceptions while managing conflict diplomatically

  • Generate additional business within teammates' portfolios, exceeding monthly volume and revenue targets while expanding portfolio size

Process Efficiency:

In this role you will help to create demand, identify new wallet share opportunities, and sell creative solutions working with both network capacity and commercial teams. As the primary point of contact for Power Plus programs, you are additionally responsible for customer advocacy, driving continuous improvement, and delivering on our customer commitments both internally and externally. This role may be based in Eden Prairie, MN or Chicago, IL.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The duties and responsibilities of this position consist of, but are not limited to, the following:

Program Advocacy

Build credible and personalized relationships at multiple levels across functional departments within the customer supply chain.
    • Manage conflict and navigate difficult conversations with the customer, using tact and diplomacy
    • Apply critical thinking skills to effectively resolve problems and identify the best course of action 
  • Develops strong relationships within the CHR network while promoting the benefits of the Power+ program
    • Drive continuous improvement, and deliver on our customer commitments
    • Stay informed of changes within the customers’ business, industry, and sector; apply knowledge to identify new opportunities

Planning & Execution

  • Matches network freight to available capacity using truck postings, lane history search, etc.

Full-time positions starting Spring/Summer 2027

For more than a century, we’ve been doing what others cannot. As the global leader in Lean AI supply chains – which combines the power of expert people, our operating model and industry leading technology – we drive smarter decisions and stronger results. Here, we bring people and technology together so you can take on complex challenges and make a meaningful impact every day. 

At C.H. Robinson, we’ve reimagined our entry-level Account Manager role to create an accelerated pathway for high-potential new graduates. From day one, you’ll be immersed in high-impact, customer-facing work, leveraging data and innovation to shape supply chain solutions and growth strategies. As part of our 24-month Program, you’ll benefit from structured training, cross-functional rotations, and mentorship that prepare you to take ownership of customer accounts within your first year. By the end of the program, you’ll be confidently managing customer relationships with the skills, judgment, and commercial foundation needed to deliver measurable value for customers. 

Apply today and start building a career where your work makes a real impact. 

At C.H. Robinson, we believe that in-person collaboration is key to driving innovation and achieving success. In this role, you will work on-site with your peers four days a week, fostering creativity and producing impactful results through face-to-face interactions, with flexibility to work remotely one day a week. 

Duties and Responsibilities  

The duties and responsibilities of this position consist of, but are not limited to, the following: 

  • Develop broad supply chain expertise by learning industry fundamentals (modes, capacity, pricing, service, and customer operations) through structured training, mentorship, and real-time problem solving. 

  • Build and maintain trust-based relationships with a portfolio of customers by understanding what matters to their business and helping solve real supply chain challenges that affect their daily operations. 

  • Own shipment execution end to end, from planning through delivery, using digital and AI enabled insights to anticipate risk, inform decisions, and deliver reliable outcomes for customers. 

  • Leverage data analytics and technology to identify trends, uncover root causes, and turn insights into improvements in service, cost, and reliability. 

  • Participate in customer business reviews and planning sessions, working with experienced Account Managers, gradually taking on ownership identifying opportunities such as new lanes, service expansions, and value-added solutions. 

  • Collaborate with sales, pricing, operations, and capacity teams and rotate through key functional areas, building a strong internal network and a deep understanding of how decisions are made across the business. 

  • Embrace an ownership mindset in your work; proactively engage in improving processes, removing operational friction, and implementing best practices.  

  • Other duties or responsibilities as assigned according to the team and/or country specific requirements. 

Required Qualifications  

  • Bachelor’s degree completed or in progress, with graduation expected by summer 2027 

  • Experience using customer perspective to guide decisions and actions 

Preferred Qualifications:  

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment 

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making skills 

  • Enjoy solutions-driven work by leveraging appropriate tools to evaluate and make recommendations 

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with customers and work effectively across teams 

  • Proven leadership or team involvement in internships, projects, or student organizations demonstrating teamwork, influence, and problem-solving 

  • Values a diverse and inclusive work environment 

We value an environment where you can grow by challenging yourself, and are supported with the potential for internal promotion – within Sales, Global Forwarding, Operations, Account Management or other areas – so you can discover new interests, develop your strengths, and reach your life goals. So what are you waiting for? Click that apply button.  

We will review applications for this role on an ongoing basis and encourage all interested candidates to apply at their earliest convenience.

jobDescription:
C.H. Robinson is seeking a Transportation Security Operations Specialist to join our team.  In this role you will support the safe and secure transportation of high-value freight. You will oversee day-to-day security operations, coordinate security escorts, conduct shipment risk assessments, and apply security protocols to protect goods in transit. You will partner closely with internal teams and external security partners to maintain high standards of safety, risk management, and customer service.

This is a hybrid position based in our Downers Grove, IL location.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

The duties and responsibilities of this position consist of, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Protects the integrity of high-value products being shipped by consistently applying established security processes and protocols.
  • Liaises with local law enforcement, security contractors, and external partners to address security concerns and strengthen transport operations.
  • Continuously monitors high-value freight during transit using surveillance systems, GPS tracking, and other tools to detect and escalate irregularities timely.
  • Completes required data entry and confirms key Security Operations milestones, including departure, arrival, PODs, and related updates, using McLeod and other systems.
  • Ensures required paperwork, including temperature downloads, pictures, PODs, and other supporting documents, is uploaded to load documents and customer records to support billing completion.
  • Conducts shipment risk assessments to identify potential security threats and vulnerabilities along transportation routes.
  • Handles escalations related to suspicious activity involving customer freight.
  • Updates customer portals according to customer requirements.
  • Attends required training and staff meetings.
  • Maintains a safe working environment through accident prevention, equipment preservation, and safe working practices.
  • Maintains a positive and professional demeanor with customers, visitors, and co-workers.
  • Adheres to applicable policies and procedures.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

  • 1 year of security, compliance, and/or customer service experience.
  • 1 year of logistics experience.
  • Ability to multitask under pressure while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to understand and communicate drivers' temperature requirements, mileage, and hours of service during transit.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Teams.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain or related field.
  • Knowledge of TSA and GDP practices.
  • Clear and confident verbal and written communication skills.
  • Analytical approach to problem solving.
  • Ability to work independently in a team-oriented environment.
  • Experience with conflict resolution and escalated issue management.
  • Demonstrated emotional intelligence and professional judgment.
  • Advanced knowledge of the supply chain industry, including regulations and customer requirements.
  • Values a diverse and inclusive work environment.

jobDescription:
C.H. Robinson is looking for a Customs Specialist who will play a critical role in protecting compliance, minimizing risk, and ensuring the seamless movement of customer shipments through the customs clearance process. In this role, you will serve as a trusted customs expert, managing complex exceptions, government agency examinations, and high-impact shipment issues while delivering exceptional service and operational excellence. You will leverage your regulatory expertise and problem-solving skills to support accurate customs clearance, drive continuous improvement, and help optimize automated customs operations. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment where your expertise directly impacts customers and business performance, we encourage you to apply.

At C.H. Robinson, we’re firm believers in the power of in-person collaboration to fuel innovation and support training. In this role, you will engage with peers on-site 5 days a week, igniting creativity and driving impactful results. Upon successful completion of your training, you will then switch to 2 days a week in the office, working the rest of the time from home. This role strikes the perfect balance between teamwork and autonomy. 

This position follows a Saturday through Wednesday schedule. Work hours are 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Candidates must be available to work this schedule consistently.

Responsibilities:

The duties and responsibilities of this position consist of, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Review and validate customs entry data to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely cargo clearance
  • Resolve complex customs exceptions, including documentation gaps, classification issues, valuation discrepancies, and regulatory concerns
  • Manage government agency holds and customs examinations, including CBP, FDA, CPSC, VACIS, CET, and Tailgate inspections
  • Serve as a trusted customs compliance expert, interpreting regulations and applying them across daily operations and automated processes
  • Prioritize critical shipment issues to prevent delays and maintain exceptional service for customers
  • Partner with customs brokers, transportation providers, and internal teams to ensure seamless import clearance and delivery
  • Own and maintain customer-specific SOPs, HTS databases, and compliance requirements to support operational excellence
  • Investigate and resolve cargo damage claims, insurance matters, demurrage, detention disputes, and other high-impact shipment issues
  • Conduct quality reviews of customs entries and automated decisions to ensure compliance, accuracy, and process effectiveness
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying workflow enhancements, supporting automation initiatives, and helping optimize customs operations and exception management

Required Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Fluent in English and Spanish (written and verbal)
  • Minimum 2-3 years of entry-writing experience, international transportation or experience with AI Agents

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate or bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in related field
  • Experience supporting automation-enabled workflows or BPO-integrated operations
  • Familiarity with customs exams, government agency holds, or dangerous goods processes
  • Knowledge of ABI, AMS queries, or entry summary components
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite of programs
  • Prior experience in customer-facing operational support or escalation management
  • Knowledge of Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) and the supply chain
  • Excellent communication, prioritization, and multi-tasking skills
  • Excellent customer service skills and follow up to be utilized with customers and the network
  • Proven track record of dealing with customers and being client focused
  • Critical-thinking, flexibility, and problem-solving skills to adapt to ever-changing tasks and customer needs
  • Reputation for logical, methodical and expedient approach to problem resolution
  • High level of attention to detail
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and deadline-driven office environment
  • Values a diverse and inclusive work environment

Must comply with 19 CFR 111.53(e) requirements, including eligibility to work in a Customs Brokerage role. Candidates must be able to pass an initial and annual background check, as employment in this department requires written approval from U.S. Customs and Border Protection for individuals with felony convictions, unless prohibited by applicable state or local law.

The Trust & Safety (T&S) Team plays an important role in protecting our Snapchatters from content that violates our terms of service or Community Guidelines — while constantly embodying our values of Kind, Smart, and Creative. The T&S team helps create a safe platform experience so that all of our users around the world are empowered to enjoy their experience on our platform, every day. We take great pride in our work as digital first responders and hope you would consider joining us. 


We’re looking for a Lead to join our Trust & Safety Global Operations & Enablement team which works cross-functionally with our Policy, Legal, Product, and Engineering teams to keep Snapchatters safe on our platform.  While this role will serve as a key Lead within our Trust & Safety Global Operations team, as Snap’s regulatory footprint has expanded, this role includes supporting the implementation of legal and regulatory compliance matters, as well as policy. . This role requires a skilled and unflappable decision maker who has a passion for ideating and developing safety workflows in order to improve the experience for Snapchatters everywhere. 


You’ll become a subject matter authority in multiple domains by owning projects from beginning to finish and facilitating cross-team communication with our Global Safety Partners  to help keep Snapchatters safe. 


This is a people manager role, with a team that will be based in NY, though you should expect to lead and coordinate across timezones (e.g. London, NYC, LA) as part of a global, matrixed operating model. 


Due to the nature of Trust & Safety work, you should be willing and able to work with sensitive issues and content that may be considered offensive or disturbing. Our team has carefully devised measures and support in place to ensure wellness for all our team members.

What you’ll do:

  • Provide leadership and guidance for a growing team of T&S Specialists by becoming a subject matter expert in our workflows
  • Enhance our operational workflows by identifying focus areas and implementing improvements
  • Liaise with our global safety partners and further strengthen those relationships 
  • Use data to influence decisions and highlight emerging issues impacting users
  • Anticipate risks, manage escalations and balance business needs versus technical constraints
  • Handle time-sensitive inquiries from users or other key stakeholders, both internal and external, and drive an end to end resolution
  • Deliver key projects within the Safety roadmap, incorporating execution, training, data assessment and presentation of results to stakeholders
  • Regularly identify opportunities to enhance internal processes and improve efficiency, while driving longer-term scalable automated solutions
  • Closely follow industry trends to help develop Snap’s thought leadership and T&S operation
  • Be willing and able to work with sensitive issues and content that includes but is not limited to child exploitation, graphic violence, self-harm,and others, which may be considered offensive or disturbing 

Knowledge, skills, & abilities:

  • Proven leadership capacity with the ability to attract, motivate, develop and retain talent
  • Experience reviewing sensitive content with a meticulous attention to detail
  • A track record of identifying gaps and solutions, and implementing new processes – from a policy, operations, and/or tooling perspective
  • Strong analytical skills, including working with large data sets to solve business problems, and providing practical business insights via data visualization software (Advanced EXCEL, Looker, Tableau, etc.)
  • Prior experience interacting with regulatory bodies, NCMEC or law enforcement
  • Great judgment in complex situations and ability to problem-solve, both independently and with peers or management
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience working with product and engineering teams to launch tools and solutions that improve trust across a platform or product
  • Contribute to the development of Trust & Safety’s scalable enforcement guidance by collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Product, Operations, Trust, Legal, and Communications.

  • Proven ability for strategic and critical thinking, demonstrating strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of the big picture and the value of both perspectives.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and rapidly shifting scope — this role's boundaries move as the team's and Snap’s needs grow

  • A passion for Snapchat, online safety, and creativity!

jobDescription:

Snap Research serves as an innovation engine for the company. Our projects range from solutions to hard technical problems that significantly enhance Snap’s existing products, to riskier explorations that can lead to fundamental paradigm shifts in the way people communicate and express themselves. The team consists of scientists and engineers who experiment with and invent new technology that has a lasting impact on Snap’s products. We also frequently publish our work at top conferences and journals in computer science and related fields.

We are looking for a Research Scientist to join our User Modeling and Personalization Research Team!  Our team’s mission is to invent new ways to model user behavior, and empower our business partners to build world-class user-centric ML systems which shape personalized experiences across Snap.  Our work spans the domains of generative and language models for information retrieval, efficient large-scale recommender systems, and representation learning for structured graph data. Together with you, we seek to redefine the state-of-the-art in technology to deliver our users customized experiences which delight them.

What you'll do:

  • Formulate and derive a research agenda in the user modeling and personalization domains, including generative modeling, recommendation systems, information retrieval, and efficiency

  • Partner with engineering teams to translate research to business impact for real-world ML applications used by millions of Snapchatters

  • Build scalable research prototypes and evaluate them in large-scale machine learning scenarios

  • Share your expertise with teammates and interns

  • Publish your findings at top conferences

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

  • Strong technical knowledge of machine learning, information retrieval, personalization, language and state-of-the-art deep learning literature

  • Demonstrated ability in defining, leading and executing challenging research projects

  • Strong computer science fundamentals, problem-solving and engineering skills (Python, PyTorch)

  • Pragmatic, hands-on approach to research with a drive to build working prototypes rather than solely rely on theoretical exploration

  • Proven ability to mentor interns, students and junior researchers
     

Minimum Qualifications:

  • PhD in computer science, machine learning, language technologies or related technical field such as statistics, mathematics, or equivalent years of experience

  • 5+ years of industry or postdoctoral experience

  • Track record of publications in top machine learning, information retrieval or language venues (e.g. ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, KDD, RecSys, SIGIR, WSDM, ACL, COLM, etc.)

  • Experience with distributed (multi-node and multi-GPU) ML model training, inference and experimentation

  • Experience applying language models in the context of generative search, ranking and/or personalization


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with large-scale machine learning problems in an academic or industrial research lab, or equivalent open-source experience

  • Experience with large-scale data processing, collection or synthesis using machine learning frameworks on Enterprise Cloud solutions like Google Cloud, AWS, and/or Azure

  • Familiarity with post-training, preference optimization, working with large-scale search or recommendation interaction data, and recommender systems

  • Demonstrated ability to transform cutting-edge research into tangible product improvements

This position serves as the EHS leader for Specs Operations in EMEA, with responsibility for EHS strategy, governance, and program execution across the Abingdon (UK), Chandler (Arizona) and other EMEA Specs locations as business needs evolve.

The role may be based in either London or Abingdon, UK. The successful candidate will be expected to maintain a strong operational presence within the business through regular and significant time spent in Abingdon, partnering closely with site leadership, engineering, manufacturing, facilities, and workplace teams.

The role also requires occasional international travel to Chandler, Arizona and other Specs locations across Europe to support operational initiatives, audits, expansion projects, leadership engagement, and program implementation activities.

What you’ll do:

EHS Strategy & Leadership

  • Lead the development, governance, and continuous improvement of EHS standards, programs, and strategic initiatives across Specs Operations globally, ensuring consistency while enabling site specific operational requirements.
  • Establish annual EHS objectives, key results, and performance indicators for Abingdon, Chandler, and other assigned Specs locations.
  • Present EHS performance, emerging risks, compliance status, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership and executive stakeholders, enabling informed business and operational decisions.
  • Provide leadership and direction for EHS Specialists, including performance management, coaching, career development, and succession planning.
  • Influence organizational decision making by integrating EHS considerations into operational, engineering, and business planning processes.
  • Build a high performance safety culture focused on accountability, risk reduction, and continuous improvement.

Governance, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Own EHS management systems, ensuring alignment with ISO 14001, ISO 45001, HSG65 principles, and Snap corporate standards.
  • Provide strategic oversight of compliance with applicable UK, U.S., and local environmental, health, and safety regulations.
  • Establish governance processes for compliance, auditing, inspections, corrective actions, and management reviews.
  • Lead enterprise-level risk assessments for manufacturing, cleanroom, and R&D operations.
  • Ensure effective management of regulatory obligations, permits, compliance documentation, agency interactions, and external audits.

Manufacturing, R&D and High-Hazard Program Ownership

  • Own EHS programs supporting manufacturing, engineering, R&D, cleanroom, facilities, and operational functions.
  • Provide strategic oversight of hazardous materials, hazardous waste, chemical safety, machine safety, contractor safety, laser safety, industrial hygiene, and hazardous gas safety programs.
  • Establish governance and performance standards for hazardous gas systems, including toxic and hazardous gas storage, distribution, monitoring, and emergency response programs.
  • Partner with Engineering, Facilities, Manufacturing, Workplace Services, and Operations leaders to ensure EHS requirements are integrated into facility design, equipment procurement, commissioning, and operational changes.
  • Provide EHS leadership for capital projects, facility expansions, equipment installations, new technologies, and operational scale-up initiatives through proactive risk management and design review.

Organizational Capability & Culture

  • Develop EHS competency frameworks, training strategies, and leadership engagement programs for employees, contractors, and leaders.
  • Lead safety committees, emergency response teams, and cross-functional governance forums to strengthen accountability and operational excellence.
  • Promote the sharing of lessons learned, best practices, and standardized methodologies across locations.

Program Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish EHS maturity assessments and continuous improvement roadmaps.
  • Manage EHS budgets, resource planning, and annual objectives.
  • Utilize data analytics, leading indicators, and risk trends to identify opportunities for operational improvement and risk reduction.
  • Develop business cases and strategic recommendations for EHS investments, staffing, and growth initiatives.

Incident Management & Emergency Preparedness

  • Lead investigations of serious incidents, significant near misses, and high potential events across assigned Specs locations.
  • Ensure robust root cause analysis methodologies are applied and corrective actions are effectively implemented and sustained.
  • Oversee emergency preparedness and EHS business continuity programs across assigned Specs locations, ensuring organizational readiness for operational disruptions, emergency events, and EHS business continuity risks.

  • 10+ years of progressive Environmental Health & Safety experience.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience managing EHS professionals or leading multi-site EHS programs.
  • Expert knowledge of EHS management systems, regulatory compliance, risk management, and strategic program development in manufacturing, R&D, cleanroom, semiconductor, advanced technology, or hardware development environments.
  • Experience managing EHS programs within manufacturing, R&D, cleanroom, semiconductor, advanced technology, or hardware development environments.
  • Experience leading EHS programs across multiple locations, business units, or regulatory jurisdictions
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to communicate technical and regulatory risks to executive and non-technical audiences.

We’re looking for an experienced Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Advisor to support the HSE program at our Abingdon, UK facility. This role partners with site leadership, engineering, operations, and the Global HSE team to help maintain compliance and drive continuous improvement in a technically complex manufacturing and laboratory environment. The role serves as a hands-on site HSE subject matter expert and trusted partner to the local team.

Work Schedule: On-site | Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm, with flexibility to work occasional nights/weekends and emergency response activities as required.

Reporting Line: This role reports to the HSE Manager.

What you’ll do:

HSE Program Delivery & Technical Guidance

  • Drive implementation and continual improvement of the site HSE management system.

  • Act as the primary HSE point of contact and senior subject matter expert for the Abingdon site, providing authoritative technical guidance to site leadership and cross-functional partners.

  • Translate global and regional HSE objectives into site-level programs, actions, and performance metrics.

  • Work collaboratively with site and global HSE teams to share best practices and improve performance in Abingdon.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with UK environmental and occupational health and safety legislation, including the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, COSHH, DSEAR, PUWER, Environmental Permitting Regulations, and the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order.

  • Maintain legal registers, regulatory applicability assessments, and site compliance documentation.

  • Lead site HSE audits, inspections, and regulatory interactions, including preparation, execution, and closure of findings.

  • Oversee risk assessment programs for manufacturing processes, laboratories, equipment, and new technology introductions, ensuring appropriate controls are defined and implemented.

  • Develop and monitor leading and lagging HSE performance indicators to proactively identify risk trends and drive continuous improvement.

  • Support the Management of Change (MOC) process for new equipment, process modifications, laboratory changes, and technology introductions.

  • Partner with engineering and operations teams to support safe installation, operation, and maintenance of toxic and hazardous gas systems, including gas cabinets, detection systems, and associated emergency controls in compliance with COSHH and DSEAR.

  • Ensure compliance with UK environmental legislation and permit requirements, maintaining environmental management programs for hazardous waste, air emissions, wastewater, spill prevention, and pollution prevention.

  • Conduct environmental risk assessments, audits, and regulatory interactions, ensuring environmental requirements are incorporated into new processes, equipment, and facility modifications.

Hazardous Materials & manufacturing Safety

  • Manage site hazardous materials, hazardous waste, and toxic and hazardous gas safety programs, including governance, procedures, and engineering control strategies.

  • Ensure effective management of toxic and hazardous gas systems, including gas cabinets, detection and alarm systems, ventilation controls, and emergency response readiness, in compliance with COSHH and DSEAR.

  • Provide HSE leadership for manufacturing, laboratory, and cleanroom safety programs, including machine safety, laser safety, hazardous gases, and contractor safety.

  • Partner with engineering, facilities, and vendors to support safe design, installation, commissioning, and modification of tools and equipment.

Training, Culture & Engagement

  • Develop, coordinate, and deliver regulatory-required and role-based HSE training programs.

  • Champion a proactive safety culture through visible leadership, engagement with employees and contractors, and accountability at all levels.

  • Provide technical leadership to site safety committees and working groups, ensuring effective governance and follow-through on actions.

  • Apply modern safety principles, including Human and Organizational Performance (HOP), to strengthen system resilience and organizational learning.

Incident Management & Emergency Response

  • Lead investigations of incidents, near-misses, and high-potential events using root cause analysis and ensuring robust corrective and preventive actions.

  • Serve as the HSE lead for  emergency response activities during site events, coordinating with site leadership and post-incident recovery efforts as needed.

  • Ensure site emergency preparedness programs, emergency response teams, drills, and equipment readiness are established and maintained..

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong knowledge of UK HSE regulatory requirements and practical application in manufacturing, laboratory, or high-hazard environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead site-level HSE programs and influence cross-functional partners.

  • Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities in complex technical environments.

  • Ability to provide technical leadership, mentoring, or supervision to HSE professionals.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage regulators, leadership, employees, and contractors.

  • Experience supporting the safe use and control of toxic and hazardous gases, including monitoring systems, emergency procedures, and compliance with DSEAR and COSHH requirements.

Minimum Qualifications: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Health & Safety, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in Environmental Health & Safety.

  • NEBOSH Diploma (Level 6) or equivalent professional qualification.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience leading HSE programs in semiconductor manufacturing, cleanroom, laboratory, or advanced manufacturing environments.

  • Experience implementing and sustaining  HSG65 principles, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems.

  • Chartered status (CMIOSH) or working toward chartership.

Senior Forward Deployed Engineer

F5 Digital · Customer Experience Organization 

About the Role 

The F5 CX Organization builds and runs the enterprise systems behind GTM, Customer Success & Support, RevOps, and Platform Engineering. We are embedding AI into how those systems work, and into how we build them. 

We are hiring a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer: a hands-on senior individual contributor who moves from business problem to working prototype fast, then hardens what works into production. Your time splits across two mandates: maturing our enterprise applications with AI and automation, and making our own engineering and product teams measurably faster with AI across the SDLC. 

This is a greenfield build role, not a sustain-the-business role. You will set the technical patterns other engineers follow. 

What You'll Do 

AI for the SDLC & Internal Productivity 

  • Prototype and ship internal tools that raise team throughput: AI-assisted coding workflows, automated code review, test generation and QA automation, and AI drafting of PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria 
  • Go from idea to MVP in days. Scope it, build it, demo it, get real users on it, then decide to harden or kill 
  • Roll out and tune AI developer platforms (Claude Code, Gemini Enterprise, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) across engineering teams, including standards, prompt and context patterns, guardrails, and adoption 
  • Instrument what you build. Cycle time, review latency, defect escape rate, and hours saved, reported as outcomes rather than activity 

Enterprise Applications & Agentic Systems 

  • Design and deliver AI automation across business systems: GTM and RevOps copilots, support triage and resolution, quote-to-cash automation, and end-to-end process workflows 
  • Build production agentic systems with LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, or equivalent: multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, memory management, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and stateful workflow design 
  • Architect enterprise RAG over business and product data: ingestion and chunking strategy, vector store selection, hybrid search and reranking, embedding model management, and eval loops tied to business KPIs 
  • Establish prompt engineering as an engineering discipline: versioning, structured output contracts, regression test harnesses, and systematic evaluation 

Integrations & Platform Engineering 

  • Lead integration design across Salesforce (Flows, Apex, Agentforce/Einstein), Oracle applications, ServiceNow/Zendesk, MuleSoft/Workato, and internal APIs 
  • Build the reusable connector library and self-serve intake path so new use cases onboard without bespoke work every time 
  • Own CI/CD for AI workloads: automated eval gates, model and prompt versioning, deployment orchestration, and rollback strategy 
  • Keep production AI observable and reliable through monitoring, alerting, and data integrity practices (Datadog, Splunk, or equivalent) 

Technical Leadership & Responsible AI 

  • Define AI engineering standards for the CX organization: coding patterns, RAG design, eval practices, integration patterns, and documentation 
  • Mentor AI, automation, and prompt engineers through design reviews, pair engineering, and structured feedback 
  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture and governance review boards so systems meet security, privacy, and AI ethics requirements. Identify and mitigate model bias, and handle PII and prompt injection risk deliberately 
  • Present architectures, trade-offs, and ROI clearly to senior leadership and non-technical partners 

What You'll Bring 

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years hands-on with AI/ML systems, LLM application engineering, or enterprise intelligent automation 
  • Expert Python: production-quality code, REST API design, async patterns, and reusable framework design 
  • Production agentic AI and RAG systems you have shipped and operated, not demos. Fluency with retrieval strategy, eval design, and the failure modes of both 
  • Strong enterprise business systems background, with hands-on Salesforce (Flows, Apex, CPQ, and/or Agentforce/Einstein) and familiarity with Oracle application stacks 
  • Experience with enterprise integration platforms (MuleSoft, Workato, Boomi, or equivalent) across distributed SaaS ecosystems 
  • Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD (GitHub Actions or equivalent), secrets management, and least-privilege access 
  • Daily hands-on use of AI coding and productivity tooling in your own workflow 
  • Working knowledge of GTM, RevOps, and CX business processes, with the ability to turn a vague business ask into a scoped technical design 
  • A bias toward shipping: you prototype to learn, measure what you ship, and drive problems to resolution without waiting for permission 

Nice to Have 

  • Oracle and/or Salesforce development at enterprise scale; Architect-level certification 
  • LLM security: prompt injection defense, data leakage prevention, output filtering, PII handling in production pipelines 
  • ServiceNow or Zendesk AI for intelligent ITSM automation: auto-triage, severity classification, SLA routing 
  • AWS serverless and integration services (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS) 
  • HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or similar secrets tooling 
  • Experience in a platform engineering, shared services, or federated AI operating model

Position Summary 

This is the full-time conversion role for Data Analyst Interns who have successfully completed their internship in F5's Data Analyst Internship program and have earned their Bachelor's or Master's degree. This position marks your transition from internship to a permanent, full-time role within the F5 Digital organization, allowing you to build on the skills, relationships, and knowledge you've developed during your internship experience. 

 

As a Data Analyst on F5's Enterprise Data Management (EDM) team within the F5 Digital organization, you will continue to support how F5 defines, improves, and validates our critical enterprise data. You'll work alongside analysts and engineers within our Data and Insights team to analyze data issues, support operational needs in current-state systems, and contribute to activities tied to data rebuild/migration efforts. This role offers you the opportunity to deepen your expertise with real-world datasets, improve data quality, and apply what you've learned about how data is managed, structured, and used to support business decisions in a fast-paced, innovative environment. 

 

This position is based in Seattle, WA.

Eligibility & Who Should Apply 

This role is exclusively available to: 

  • Current or recent Data Analyst Interns in F5's internship program who have successfully completed their internship 

  • Individuals who have earned or are about to earn their Bachelor's or Master's degree from an accredited college or university in the US (graduating between December 2026 and August 2027) 

  • Those who have demonstrated strong performance, technical aptitude, and cultural fit during their internship 

Your Role & Responsibilities 

Building on your internship foundation, your typical day may involve: 

  • Taking on increased ownership of EDM Data Quality operations related to customer data (Organizations/Individuals), including investigation of complex issues and conducting ad hoc analysis with greater autonomy 

  • Contributing to the proactive quality management of customer data through profiling and analysis of third-party enrichment sources 

  • Analyzing and validating data involved in Salesforce customer records and Marketo-related requests (as applicable), using spreadsheets, reporting tools, and basic scripting 

  • Managing and analyzing Hardware Asset to Site/Party relationships (e.g., data supporting Renewals and Services motions), including identifying anomalies and leading cleanup efforts 

  • Building, automating, and improving data quality dashboards/scorecards or metric summaries (e.g., Tableau and spreadsheets), focused on clarity, repeatability, and business usefulness 

  • Leading or co-leading team meetings, status updates, and documentation; working on assigned tasks with increasing independence while continuing to collaborate across EDM stakeholders 

  • Mentoring new interns or junior team members as you grow in the role 

  • Following data governance, security, and privacy best practices 

  • Performing other related duties assigned 

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities 

  • Understanding of basic descriptive statistics and data distributions (e.g., counts, rates, trends, outliers) 

  • Solid understanding of data concepts (e.g., data quality, databases, schemas) 

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail; ability to follow data lineage and identify root causes of data issues 

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills (able to summarize findings for both technical and non-technical audiences) 

  • Ability to learn quickly and comfort tackling complex, cross-system problems with curiosity and initiative 

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deliver on deadlines in a collaborative environment 

  • Proficiency with spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets) required; Tableau experience is a plus 

  • Familiarity with SQL, Python, or R for analysis is preferred but not required 

  • Interest in enterprise data concepts (data domains, data quality, governance, master/reference data) 

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams 

  • Experience with F5's systems and business processes (gained during internship) 

Requirements / Qualifications 

  • Successfully completed a Summer 2026 internship with F5.  

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, or a related technical field graduating between December 2026 and September 2027.  

  • Must be able to start no later than September 30th, 2027.  

  • Must be able to work onsite in accordance with F5s policies; fully remote work options are not available.    

  • Strong performance and positive feedback from internship managers and mentors 

  • Willingness to remain based in or relocate to Seattle for this full-time role 

  • Valid work authorization in the United States 

 

Why You’ll Love F5   

  • Seamless Transition: Move from internship to full-time with continuity in your team, projects, and growth trajectory 

  • Professional Development: Continue developing your skills with ongoing training, mentorship, and access to advanced learning opportunities 

  • Meaningful Work: Contribute to real business impact and solve complex enterprise data challenges 

  • Collaborative Culture: Work alongside experienced analysts, engineers, and leaders in an inclusive, innovative environment 

  • Career Growth: Excel in your role and build a long-term career path with F5, including opportunities for advancement and specialization 

  • Inclusive Community: Be part of F5's diverse, people-first culture where individual contributions are valued

  • Work-life balance benefits including flexible work arrangements 

  • Hybrid work environment with periodic in-office collaboration in Seattle

Head of Business Operations - Technology Operations

The Business Operations role is a unique opportunity to work closely with the senior leadership team in shaping the rhythm of business, portfolio planning, and the operating mechanics that drive execution across enterprise technology operations. You will own the system by which work is prioritized, resourced, measured, and communicated, providing operational leverage across the CTOO portfolio and ensuring alignment with broader enterprise priorities.

What You'll Do

Operating Cadence & Strategic Planning

  • Design and lead the rhythm of the business across enterprise-wide technology operations — staff meetings, MBRs and QBRs, annual and quarterly planning cycles, and action tracking to closure.
  • Act as a key advisor to the CTOO in decision-making, managing priorities and portfolios to ensure alignment with strategic objectives.
  • Identify and prioritize strategic programs to improve delivery, efficiency, and risk posture across the CTOO Office.

Demand & Capacity Management

  • Operate a single intake path for inbound work requests; triage, size, prioritize, and route against available capacity.
  • Own workforce and capacity planning across headcount and contractor mix, including allocation across value streams and forecasting of supply against committed and pipeline demand.
  • Surface capacity constraints and trade-off recommendations to leadership before they become escalations.

Financial Management

  • Own the functional budget: forecast accuracy, OPEX and CAPEX tracking, and variance explanation in partnership with FP&A.
  • Support headcount planning, resource allocation, and cost transparency, ensuring the CTOO's priorities are met within financial constraints.

Strategic Sourcing & Vendor Management

  • Manage contract lifecycle, renewals, and rate cards; drive vendor performance reviews against agreed outcomes.
  • Identify spend consolidation and rationalization opportunities across overlapping vendors and tooling.

Performance Management

  • Define and maintain the KPI and OKR framework, scorecards, and dashboards for the function, including the data hygiene required to make them trustworthy.
  • Interpret operational and financial data to identify trends and inform decisions — insight and recommendation, not status reporting.

Portfolio & Program Oversight

  • Maintain an investment-level view of initiatives, including dependencies, risks, and benefit realization.
  • Roll up program status to leadership and enterprise governance forums with a single credible source of truth on schedule and confidence.

Process & Continuous Improvement

  • Standardize, document, and automate recurring processes; identify and retire low-value work.
  • Partner with teams to manage resistance and promote engagement during periods of change.

Executive Communications & Stakeholder Management

  • Prepare briefings, decision packages, and presentations for leadership meetings at all levels, up to and including the Board of Directors.
  • Partner with business unit leaders on demand intake, prioritization, and shared initiative planning.

Governance & Risk Interlock

  • Ensure policy adherence and reporting readiness across the function.
  • Coordinate with Enterprise Risk Management on risk reporting, remediation tracking, and governance forum inputs.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven experience in a business operations or strategy and operations leadership role, preferably in a fast-paced or high-growth technology environment.
  • Deep understanding of business operations, financial metrics, and performance drivers in a technology company, including budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
  • Demonstrated ownership of demand and capacity management mechanics — intake, prioritization, and allocation across competing priorities.
  • Strong analytical capability: able to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insight into operational decisions.
  • Executive communication skills — able to compress ambiguity into a one-page recommendation for senior leaders and stand behind it.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence without authority, including holding senior peers to commitments.
  • Experience handling sensitive and confidential information with discretion.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Information Technology, or a related field; MBA preferred.
  • 12+ years in a leadership or operational role, with a minimum of 5 years working closely with C-level executives in technology companies.
  • Direct experience supporting an information technology, cybersecurity, or technology infrastructure organization.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a multi-million dollar operating budget and vendor portfolio.
  • Proven track record driving cross-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to successful completion.
  • Experience operating in a global, matrixed enterprise environment.

Preferred

  • Working knowledge of cloud services commercial models — consumption-based pricing, reserved capacity, committed spend agreements, and cloud cost optimization (FinOps).
  • Familiarity with AI and LLM consumption economics, including token-based pricing models and cost-per-workload forecasting.

Position Summary 

The Technical Program Manager I (TPM I) is the entry point into the Technical Program Management profession at F5. This role is designed for early-career talent who demonstrate strong analytical thinking, collaboration skills, technical curiosity, and a passion for driving outcomes through influence rather than authority. The TPM I partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders to support the planning, coordination, and execution of technical initiatives. 

Working under the guidance of experienced Technical Program Managers, the TPM I develops foundational program management skills while learning how to navigate technical systems, manage risks and dependencies, facilitate cross-functional alignment, and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders. 

Successful TPM I employees progressively build the capabilities required to independently lead complex cross-functional programs and advance within the TPM profession. 

 

Primary Responsibilities 

  • Support the planning, execution, and delivery of technical programs and workstreams under the guidance of senior TPMs. 

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders to understand requirements, document scope, and coordinate delivery activities. 

  • Create and maintain project plans, schedules, status reports, action items, risk registers, dependency trackers, and other program documentation. 

  • Facilitate project meetings, Agile ceremonies, and cross-functional planning activities to ensure effective communication and alignment. 

  • Monitor program progress, identify risks and blockers, and escalate issues appropriately. 

  • Assist with resource planning, capacity forecasting, milestone tracking, and delivery reporting. 

  • Analyze program metrics and project data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring attention. 

  • Support stakeholder communications through presentations, dashboards, executive summaries, and status updates. 

  • Participate in continuous improvement efforts by identifying ways to improve delivery processes, transparency, and team effectiveness. 

  • Develop technical acumen by working closely with engineers and architects to understand system architecture, dependencies, integrations, and software delivery practices. 

  • Learn and apply TPM best practices, methodologies, tools, and frameworks across a variety of business and technology initiatives. 

  • Responsibly leverage AI and productivity tools to improve planning, documentation, reporting, analysis, and program execution. 

 

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities 

  • Experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and automate tasks  

  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills. 

  • Demonstrated problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities. 

  • Ability to work effectively across multiple teams and disciplines. 

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities. 

  • Ability to influence and build relationships without formal authority. 

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn technical concepts, systems, and business processes. 

  • Basic understanding of project or program management principles, including scope, schedule, risks, issues, and dependencies. 

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office products including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and Outlook. 

  • Ability to work effectively in Agile, hybrid, or traditional delivery environments. 

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to follow-through. 

 

Desired Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities 

  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and Scrum practices. 

  • Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar collaboration tools. 

  • Understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) concepts. 

  • Exposure to cloud technologies, SaaS products, cybersecurity, enterprise systems, data platforms, or infrastructure technologies. 

  • Experience leading team projects, student organizations, hackathons, or other collaborative initiatives. 

  • Interest in pursuing a career in Technical Program Management. 

 

Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Mathematics, or a related discipline. 

  • 0-2 years of professional experience. 

  • Prior internship, co-op, research, leadership, or project experience preferred. 

  • Demonstrated ability to work in collaborative, team-oriented environments. 

 

Career Progression 

The TPM I role represents the foundational development level within F5's Technical Program Management profession. 

Through coaching, mentorship, and progressively increasing ownership, TPM I employees build proficiency in: 

  • Program planning and execution 

  • Stakeholder management 

  • Risk and dependency management 

  • Agile delivery practices 

  • Technical and business acumen 

  • Executive communication 

  • Cross-functional leadership 

Successful performance and demonstrated readiness may lead to advancement into Technical Program Manager II (P2), where individuals assume greater ownership of programs and begin operating with increased independence.

The Sr SE Job Overview:  

The Sr Solutions Engineer (SE) is a sales and technical role with focus on customer/partners and is part of the sales organization. The SE’s primary responsibility is to support the sales team with technical skills and provide technical knowledge around F5 solutions to our customers. To be effective, an SE needs to have excellent technical skills and knowledge on both F5 products and the “eco-system” that we work in. Fear not, we do provide training and certification to keep abreast with these critical skills!

    

The high-level objective is to achieve the allocated sales target and selling relevant F5 solutions and products to target organizations in North America, in partnership with the Sales Director and Service Provider Team.

  

From our customer(s) perspective, the SE is a trusted adviser who proactively learns and understands their technical and business challenges and is able to propose effective solutions to mitigate their concerns/offer gainful solutions. The F5 SE not only presents the technical features but also business benefits in the Technical Value Proposition. We offer a suite of technologies for developing and delivering modern applications. Our solutions bridge the gap between NetOps and DevOps, with multi-cloud application services that span from code to customer.

Sounds interesting? Read on!

What you’ll do: 

  • Articulate the F5 product strategy, messaging and positioning F5’s value proposition and solutions for customer business objectives  

  • Provide technical expertise through sales presentations, solution designs, solution demonstrations, proof of concepts by various mediums – in-person/virtual presentations, white boards etc.  

  • Mentor and educate sales teams on value of F5 solutions and business drivers 

  • Determine viability of opportunity and map out organizational structure.  

  • Drive the sales process in partnership with the Account Manager, by identifying the Technical Decision Maker, getting their technical validation, support, and sponsorship.   

  • Consistently provide world-class customer service through the customer life cycle 

  • Work collaboratively with internal technical and sales resources, share best practices, updates, offer and seek expertise as the need arises in various opportunities. 

Your Technical Qualifications and Skills (any to many, the more the better!): 

  • Intelligent load balancing 

  • Application acceleration 

  • Application request routing 

  • Application Security principles/tools (Web Application Firewalls, L7 DoS Solutions, Bot Defense)

  • Web serving 

  • Dynamic content caching 

  • TLS/SSL and compression offload 

  • BS/BA degree in a relevant field (CS, EE, MIS) or equivalent experience 

  • Experience as a Sales Engineer solution selling across a multi-product portfolio

  • Experience in traffic management and load-balancing technologies, e.g., F5, Citrix, Riverbed, Kemp, or others

Responsibilities

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Software Delivery: Proven track record of designing, building, and delivering scalable enterprise software solutions using agile principles.

Job Description:

F5 is seeking a Senior Architect for Application Security to lead technical strategy and architecture across its entire security portfolio, including WAF, DDoS mitigation, AI Security, Bot Defense, API Security, TLS inspection, and identity-aware access. This role drives the evolution of F5’s security services across SaaS, hardware, and cloud-native platforms, ensuring they are integrated, scalable, and secure-by-design. As a senior technical leader, you will unify architectural direction, modernize legacy systems, and represent F5’s security vision in both internal strategy and external engagements. You will: 

  • Define the cross-portfolio application security architecture strategy, covering hardware, software, and cloud-native solutions, and align it to F5’s long-term business and technology vision.
  • Establish architectural principles, patterns, and roadmaps that guide how WAF, WAAP, API security, DDoS, identity, client-side protection, AI/ML-powered detection and response, and related capabilities are designed, integrated, and delivered.
  • Lead architectural modernization efforts to evolve monolithic or appliance-based capabilities into composable, API-driven services within a SaaS-native security control plane.
  • Influence the security posture and innovation roadmap across F5 Distributed Cloud Services, BIG-IP, NGINX, and future platform initiatives.
  • Champion architectural governance and threat modeling across teams to ensure scalability, observability, resiliency, and secure-by-default practices are institutionalized.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across product, engineering, SRE, and infrastructure teams to ensure seamless and secure user experiences across hybrid, multicloud, and edge deployments.
  • Mentor a community of senior architects and engineers, raising the bar for application security talent across the company.
  • Represent F5’s technical vision in customer briefings, industry forums, regulatory discussions, and analyst engagements, serving as a technical ambassador for application security innovation.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate architecture for WAAP services, distributed DDoS protection layers, advanced bot mitigation pipelines, client fingerprinting, fraud prevention engines, and access-aware enforcement controls.
  • Develop and evangelize reusable security frameworks and patterns across the product portfolio.
  • Collaborate with detection teams and data scientists to integrate machine learning, heuristics, and behavior analysis engines into runtime defense systems.
  • Define telemetry, feedback loops, and attack modeling infrastructure to continuously improve detection fidelity and response agility.
  • Work across organizational boundaries to ensure integration of security across the portfolio.

Job Description

The AI Inference Engineer plays a critical role in the AI lifecycle by bridging the gap between high-performance model development and optimized deployment environments. This position focuses on optimizing Large Language Models (LLMs) for inference, serving diverse environments—from GPU-rich data centers to resource-constrained edge devices—with a strong emphasis on maximizing throughput, minimizing latency, and maintaining model accuracy.  

This role is pivotal in advancing F5’s AI capabilities, ensuring enterprise-grade reliability by leveraging hardware acceleration, designing scalable infrastructure, and monitoring system performance. 

Key Responsibilities 

High-Performance AI Serving 

  • Build and maintain robust inference engines using tools like vLLM, TGI (Text Generation Inference), and NVIDIA Triton, ensuring high performance at scale.  

  • Handle deployment optimizations to deliver low-latency AI serving solutions for multiple business applications. 

Hardware Acceleration and Optimization 

  • Profile and optimize models for specialized hardware backends, including NVIDIA GPUs (CUDA/TensorRT), Apple Silicon (CoreML), and AI accelerators like TPUs and LPUs.  

  • Collaborate with hardware teams to maximize utilization and performance across various computational environments. 

Inference Orchestration and Scalability 

  • Design and implement auto-scaling architectures for online (real-time) and batch inference pipelines, leveraging Kubernetes for inference routing and orchestration.  

  • Ensure software solutions are optimized for peak performance during traffic spikes, maintaining reliability and scalability. 

Performance Monitoring and Observability 

  • Establish robust observability frameworks to monitor Time to First Token (TTFT), tokens per second, and memory bandwidth utilization against service-level agreements (SLAs).  

  • Build and execute performance and load testing suites to identify bottlenecks and ensure consistent reliability at scale. 

Technical Requirements 

Required Skills: 

  • Programming Languages: Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, Rust, or Golang specifically for high-performance AI workflows.  

  • Inference Tools: Proven hands-on experience with tools like vLLM, TensorRT, Llama.cpp, and Ollama for inference development and optimization.  

  • Infrastructure Expertise: Strong familiarity with infrastructure technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, and Azure.  

  • Hardware Optimization Expertise: Comprehensive understanding of GPU and AI hardware, including techniques for profiling and optimizing performance for accelerators like NVIDIA GPUs and TPUs. 

Preferred Experience: 

  • Prior experience deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) with advanced techniques like Speculative Decoding or PagedAttention.  

  • Contributions to open-source inference libraries or hardware-level kernel development (e.g., CUDA, Triton kernels).  

  • Background in MLOps or SRE roles focused on high-performance AI endpoints and reliability during demand surges.  

  • Proficiency in designing scalable solutions for high-throughput inference environments optimized for traffic bursts. 

Success Metrics (KPIs): 

  • Latency Reduction: Continuously improve inference latency metrics, ensuring minimal Time to First Token (TTFT) and maximum tokens per second.  

  • Cost Efficiency: Achieve lower "Cost per 1K Tokens" through better resource utilization and hardware optimization.  

  • Scalability: Maintain system stability and reliability during traffic spikes, ensuring performance consistency across environments.  

  • Throughput Maximization: Deploy models optimized for peak hardware usage and maximized process throughput. 

Why Join F5? 

F5 empowers you to push boundaries in AI optimization and high-performance engineering. Joining our team means:  

  • Collaborating with cutting-edge technologies and hardware solutions to support real-time AI applications.  

  • Advancing your career in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment focused on innovation, scalability, and problem-solving.  

  • Driving transformative projects that deliver real-time AI reliability to global customers while maintaining cost and efficiency standards.  

  • Working on advanced MLOps solutions that seamlessly scale enterprise AI systems and shape the future of intelligent deployment. 

What Success Looks Like: 

As an AI Inference Engineer at F5, success is measured by your ability to:  

  • Combine technical expertise and problem-solving skills to deliver low-latency, scalable, and high-performing AI prediction systems.  

  • Collaborate efficiently across cross-functional teams, participating in knowledge sharing and system refinement.  

  • Demonstrate initiative by driving optimizations across hardware, tools, and orchestration processes, balancing immediate solutions with long-term architectural goals.  

  • Translate complex AI and inference workflows into practical solutions that align with F5's strategic objectives.

Proactive Monitoring & Uptime Assurance

F5 Distributed Cloud is seeking a Security Engineer II to design, integrate, operate, and maintain robust security monitoring and auditing capabilities across our global platform. In this role, you will develop and support monitoring and audit solutions that provide the visibility, detection, and alerting needed to protect the platform and enable effective incident response and forensics. 

Key Responsibilities  

  • Partner with software architects, security engineers, operations/SRE teams, compliance experts, and business stakeholders to understand system boundaries and define what needs to be monitored and audited.

  • Integrate logging and monitoring pipelines with existing tools and platforms (e.g., SIEM, EDR, dashboards) and ensure data quality, coverage, and usability.  

  • Respond to alerts , tune alerts and thresholds to reduce noise while maintaining strong coverage for security and operational events.

  • Be Kind

About the Role 

F5 Distributed Cloud is building the next generation of secure, scalable, multi-cloud application services. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform Security team, where you'll design and build the foundational security services that protect our distributed cloud platform and the customers who rely on it. 

In this role, you'll work on mission-critical security domains—authentication, authorization, certificate, secret, and key management—at massive scale across a globally distributed Kubernetes-based platform. If you're passionate about building secure, reliable systems and want your work to directly safeguard a leading cloud platform, we'd love to talk to you. 

 

What You'll Do 

  • Design, develop, and operate highly available platform security services that form the trust foundation of F5 Distributed Cloud. 

  • Build and enhance core security capabilities across one or more domains: authentication, authorization, certificate management, secret management, and key management. 

  • Write high-quality, well-tested, production-grade code (primarily Golang) for distributed, performance-sensitive systems. 

  • Deploy and operate services on Kubernetes across multi-cloud and edge environments. 

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams—product, SRE, and other engineering groups—to deliver secure, scalable solutions. 

  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and threat modeling to uphold a high security and engineering bar. 

  • Contribute to compliance and audit readiness efforts (e.g., FedRAMP, PCI) for platform security services. 

  • Mentor junior engineers and help drive engineering best practices within the team. 

 

What You'll Bring (Must-Have) 

  • Be Kind 

  • 6+ years of professional software development experience in C++, Java, or Golang (Golang strongly preferred). 

  • Advanced knowledge of and hands-on experience with Linux. 

  • Advanced, hands-on experience with Kubernetes. 

  • Proven experience building platform security services in at least one of the following domains: authentication, authorization, certificate management, secret management, or key management. 

  • Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, system design, and writing secure, reliable code. 

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude, Codex, or similar). 

  • U.S. Citizenship Required: Due to FedRAMP compliance obligations, this role requires the candidate to be a U.S. citizen. 

 

Nice to Have 

  • Experience with public cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP. 

  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, Keycloak. 

  • Experience contributing to FedRAMP compliance initiatives. 

  • Experience with Integrating AI/ML or LLM capabilities into production (AI agents, RAG, ML-driven detection). 

  • AI security best practices (securing AI/ML pipelines, mitigating prompt injection / model misuse).

Job Summary

F5, Inc. is seeking an experienced and technically capable Senior Accountant to join our Corporate Accounting team in Seattle, WA. This role will primarily manage fixed asset accounting, lease accounting under ASC 842, internal-use software capitalization under ASC 350-40, and cloud computing arrangement implementation cost accounting under ASC 350-40 (as amended by ASU 2018-15). The role is highly cross-functional, partnering closely with Procurement, IT, Legal, Real Estate/Facilities, FP&A, Financial Reporting, A/P, and Tax to ensure the completeness, accuracy, and integrity of our long-lived asset and lease portfolios.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on technical accounting experience in the above domains, ideally proficient in Oracle EBS (including the Oracle Fixed Assets module), LeaseQuery or similar lease accounting software tool, and Coupa. A demonstrated interest in process automation and the application of AI tools to improve accounting workflows is imperative. The ideal candidate is a strong team player with the desire to contribute in a high-performing, collaborative environment, with excellent written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to effectively partner across teams and levels of the organization. This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented professional looking to make a meaningful impact at a leading multi-cloud application security company.

Key Responsibilities:

Accounting & Compliance

Accounting:

  • Oversee the full lifecycle of fixed assets and lease accounting, including capitalization, depreciation, reconciliations, journal entries, reporting, and compliance with U.S. GAAP and F5 policies.
  • Manage accounting processes for internal-use software and cloud computing arrangements (CCA), ensuring accurate cost evaluations, capitalization, amortization, and related disclosures.
  • Partner with Procurement, IT, FP&A, and other departments to evaluate expenditure requests, determine proper accounting treatment, and document supporting conclusions.
  • Serve as a resource for international accounting teams, collaborating on recurring and ad hoc efforts and reporting needs.
  • Own the accounting for your area, anchored in the monthly accounting close process, identify opportunities for standardization, efficiency, accuracy, and automation.
  • Proactively problem-solve and drive enhancements across departments as needed.

Compliance:

  • Collaborate with internal and external auditors to ensure a smooth and efficient audit process.
  • Implement and execute relevant internal controls to safeguard company assets and ensure the accuracy of financial records.

Qualifications:

Experience and Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or related field.
  • CPA designation or equivalent professional certification is preferred.
  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience in public companies or high-growth organizations.
  • Proven experience in managing the accounting close process, including internal reporting, fluctuation analysis, and execution of SOX internal controls in a dynamic environment.
  • Experience in working within financial ERP systems (Oracle, Coupa, etc.), reconciliation tools (Blackline), lease accounting tools (LeaseQuery), and AI and financial automation tools, strongly preferred.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Experienced in US GAAP and internal controls, lease accounting under ASC 842, and accounting for fixed assets.
  • Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills with proven ability to partner with other levels in the organization.
  • Strong sense of ownership and ability to apply judgment to keep projects moving and ensure the right decisions are reached with stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to proactively identify and escalate risks and issues to leadership.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team environment.
  • Possess a critical thinking mindset.
  • Experience within the technology industry is a plus.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

  • This is a hybrid role, located within F5’s Seattle-based headquarters.
  • Duties are performed in a normal office environment while sitting at a desk or computer table. 
  • Duties require the ability to utilize a computer, communicate over the telephone, and read printed material.
  • Duties may require being on call periodically or working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends).  
  • F5 is an equal opportunity employer and strongly supports diversity in the workplace.
