Job Description

As an Advisor - Area Development, you will be responsible for meeting or exceeding revenue goals by managing, recruiting, and expanding volunteer and donor efforts throughout the area. You will also maximize funds raised for ALSAC, while increasing the support for and awareness of St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital.

Responsibilities

  • Establish and activate high-profile national fundraising initiatives throughout the area, including St. Jude Dream Home campaigns, radiothons, and other signature programs. Recruit volunteers, sponsors, and community partners to implement national program best practices, ensure campaign compliance, and maximize revenue.

  • Attain and exceed financial and stewardship goals, as established by territory and area leadership.

  • Use interpersonal and sales skills to create and build relationships with volunteers and donors through primarily face-to-face interaction, to recruit new partners and grow existing relationships.

  • Use fundraising knowledge to provide support, motivation, direction, and resources for fundraising initiatives to volunteers and donors through various communication channels, including personal visits, written correspondence, and electronic communication.

  • Create and implement marketing and recruitment plans for events through research and knowledge of current market trends and community engagement opportunities within the assigned area. Build and maintain relationships with media partners and support promotional activities that increase awareness and fundraising results.

  • Develop and grow multiple high-value ($250,000+) revenue-producing events (including dinners, galas, golf tournaments, dream homes and walks) with growth rates and expense ratios assigned by territory and area leadership.

  • Prepare written correspondence before and after events and maintain accurate records of all event contacts and revenues through appropriate tools and systems.

  • Serve as a public-facing representative of St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital by engaging with media partners, sponsors, volunteers, donors, and community stakeholders to strengthen relationships and increase brand awareness.

  • Work in collaboration with the internal area and enterprise team, volunteers and other stakeholders to identify, cultivate and solicit Dream Home and Radiothon donors. Conduct prospect research on potential donors and develop sponsorship proposals.

Qualifications

  • Five (5) years of relevant experience in fundraising, development, customer service, or sales.  Bachelor's degree is preferred.

  • Demonstrated relationship management success and proven experience and success in peer-to-peer fundraising.

  • Ability to relate to donors and volunteers from diverse backgrounds and cultures.

  • Strong communication, organizational, interpersonal, and public speaking skills.

  • Demonstrated project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholder relationships in a fast-paced environment.

  • Demonstrated negotiating and listening skills.

  • Donor/customer-oriented with excellent writing, telephone, and organizational skills.

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite and fundraising software.

  • Demonstrates clear communication and the ability to influence others.

  • Ability to travel frequently within the Phoenix territory area by supporting events, volunteers, and partners in the assigned territory. Involves travel 15%-20%, including regular evening and weekend commitments during key campaign periods and fundraising events. Periodic visits to Memphis for enterprise, divisional, or donor events (on average 4-6 times annually) based on business needs.

  • Driver's License: A valid driver's license is required for this role.

This position is eligible for a hybrid schedule to include working from our Territory Office located at 645 East Missouri Avenue, Suite 255 Phoenix, AZ 85012.

Job Description

We are looking for a dynamic Sr. Strategist, Media Relations with 5-7 years of experience to lead and support our strategic media initiatives at ALSAC, the fundraising and awareness organization for St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital. This role is all about creating impactful press positioning, engaging messaging, and multichannel public relations opportunities to inspire support for St. Jude: Finding cures. Saving children.®

As a Sr. Strategist, you will independently cultivate valuable earned media opportunities on both regional and national levels. Your critical-thinking skills will advance our strategic communications goals and drive business objectives. You will be a key player, focused on delivering results for multiple initiatives, and committed to organization, communication, and creativity.

In this role, you will provide internal and external counsel on multi-platform media strategies, managing stakeholder expectations while staying composed and on task. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy working with diverse volunteers and supporters, including celebrities, influencers, and global brands, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning:

  • Develop and execute comprehensive media relations plans.
  • Support fundraising efforts and drive awareness of the lifesaving mission of St. Jude.
  • Organize press conferences and media events.
  • Identify media targets and develop media lists.
  • Analyze and report on earned media efforts.

Expert Writing:

  • Produce error-free content using AP Stylebook guidelines.
  • Create news releases, holding statements, executive remarks, PR plans, fact sheets, media briefs, messaging, talking points, and coverage recaps.

Media Relations:

  • Secure regional, niche, and national media coverage.
  • Conduct outreach to reporters and manage logistics for interviews.
  • Cultivate relationships with media to identify relevant storylines.
  • Respond strategically to media inquiries and critical incidents.
  • Support media training initiatives.

Reporting and Analysis:

  • Provide regular updates to Manager Media Relations and Sr. Director of Strategic Communications.
  • Monitor news coverage and stay informed on industry trends.
  • Share insights to foster a growth mindset within the team.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Work with PR agencies and external partners on campaign strategies.
  • Host media, celebrities, and influencers during events.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver quality results.

Agency/Vendor Management:

  • Manage relationships with PR agencies and media monitoring vendors to ensure alignment with strategic goals.
  • Oversee agency onboarding, deliverables, and provide feedback to optimize performance.
  • Coordinate with agencies on campaign planning, project execution, media outreach, and reporting.

Solutions Driven:

  • Embrace new approaches to holistic communications.
  • Maintain positive relationships and provide timely support.

Crisis Communication:

  • Support issues management and crisis communications.
  • Stay informed on news related to the organization and peer charities.

Other Responsibilities

Perform various job functions as assigned. Participate in ALSAC's Business Continuity Management Program.

Job Requirements

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, public relations, or a related field.
  • 5-7 years of experience in journalism, public relations, or marketing communications.
  • Experience in fundraising PR with a global reach is a plus.

Skills and Knowledge:

  • Proficient in journalism and public relations.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent command of English spelling, grammar, and usage.
  • Ability to understand and follow complex instructions.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office programs.
  • Strong news writing and editing skills.
  • Knowledge of photography, including taking and recognizing impactful photos.
  • Ability to build and maintain media relationships to secure coverage.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills.
  • Bilingual candidates are encouraged to apply.

Job Description

Provides oversight of all aspects of the ALSAC Safety Program and supports its seamless integration with the ALSAC Business Continuity Program. Provides support to the Advisor, Business Continuity & Safety, in planning, coordinating, and implementing business continuity, safety, and security initiatives and activities.

Responsibilities include supporting the development, implementation, and maintenance of key safety, security, and business continuity program components. This includes documenting, monitoring, and implementing routine hazard and security assessment initiatives for both the National Executive Office and regional offices; maintaining safety and business continuity program documentation; administering systems and databases that support program activities, including training and process improvement initiatives; and assisting with annual business continuity and safety plan maintenance activities.

Essential Job Functions

  • Maintains knowledge of safety, security, and business continuity planning methodologies, regulatory requirements, and management systems to provide guidance, support problem-solving efforts, and address operational and technical issues. Conducts employee training as needed.
  • Supports Safety and Business Continuity Department initiatives across a variety of functional areas. Builds and maintains positive working relationships with colleagues, employees, vendors, and local authorities. Performs work within a standard office environment with normal lighting and climate-controlled conditions.
  • Assists with the administration and maintenance of databases related to safety and security program activities, including user administration, content management, and user training. Prepares reports, procedures, and manuals that summarize and translate technical or complex information for diverse audiences.
  • Supports department metrics and reporting activities by collecting, assembling, and interpreting statistical data used for program monitoring, compliance, and performance measurement. Requires regular use of a personal computer and related systems.
  • Assists in drafting, updating, and maintaining safety, security, and business continuity documentation, including manuals, procedures, and program communications. Coordinates the preparation and distribution of updates as needed.
  • Maintains current knowledge of business continuity concepts and planning methodologies, as well as OSHA, NFPA, NLB, and other applicable safety and security regulations, industry best practices, and ALSAC policies. Advises the Business Continuity & Safety Advisor of regulatory changes and their potential impact on program operations. Assists in implementing required program modifications and coordinating updates with business continuity plans.
  • Schedules and coordinates Safety Warden, Safety Committee, and other departmental meetings in support of training, audits, exercises, and program activities. Manages multiple concurrent assignments while communicating clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing. Establishes and maintains effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Job Requirements

  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with internal and external stakeholders, both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to understand and interpret complex verbal and written instructions.
  • Knowledge of audit, assessment, quality monitoring, risk management, or compliance standards.
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively convey safety and security information to employees.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
  • Exceptional coordination, organization, and project management abilities.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the organization and with external contacts.
  • Proven success leading projects and teams.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Safety, Security Management, Criminal Justice, Emergency Management, or a related field preferred, along with 3-5 years of related experience, preferably managing or supporting a safety, security, or business continuity program.

Work Location

This position is onsite five (5) days per week at the ALSAC National Executive Office in Memphis, TN.

As a Digital Experimentation Strategist, you will serve as the organization's subject matter expert for digital experimentation and decision science. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end experimentation process, including identifying and sizing opportunities, helping teams define key decisions, selecting success metrics and testing methodologies, and translating results into actionable recommendations and future testing roadmaps. You will oversee the design, execution, and analysis of digital experiments aimed at optimizing donor and supporter engagement and conversion across digital channels and platforms. Essential Job Functions

  • Serve as the digital experimentation subject matter expert (SME) for the organization, leading decision science training, processes, and implementation.

  • Serve as the day-to-day lead of the experimentation tools and technology, partnering with Product to identify and champion new capabilities and enhancements, best practices and use cases in support of testing velocity and validity.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related field (Master’s degree preferred) and 5+ years of direct experience strategically supporting scaled testing, experimentation, and decision science within a sizeable organization with a track record of driving stronger decisioning to achieve key business outcomes; including 3+ years of proven experience in training and governing others in experimentation methodologies OR 8+ years of direct experience without a degree.

  • Experienced in weighing pragmatism against robust measurement to design and complete experiments (e.g., A/B/n test vs. pre-post analysis, learning agenda priorities).

  • Knowledge of user interface design processes and methodology, user-centered design principles and practices.

  • Experience with Agile methodology and use of Jira to organize work.

  • Great teammate and collaborator, with deep experience partnering with cross-functional team members who come to the table with different perspectives and have a consistent record of developing creative approaches to solving problems.

Provides high-level, thoughtful and strategic legal advice and counseling on technology matters as assigned by the Chief Legal Officer, Senior Vice President, or Senior Counsel, primarily in technology transactions.  Preferred candidates will have experience with and working knowledge of technology transactions for an organization that is on the cutting edge of technology and marketing, including drafting and revising: master services agreements; general terms and conditions agreements; terms of services (and other click-through terms); end user license agreements; information security standards provisions; statements of work for high-level technology implementations; data processing agreements and data privacy agreements; privacy policies, privacy notices; liability (including personally identifiable information and payment card industry data) provisions; artificial intelligence and machine learning agreements; cloud computing and SaaS agreements (including service level agreements); and infrastructure, platform and software as a service agreements (including service level agreements). 

Must have a willingness to learn and understand related ALSAC legal needs including, but not limited to, fundraising; state compliance issues and charitable registrations; gaming issues; raffle licenses; special event licenses; alcohol permits; business licenses; grant applications and compliance; insurance and risk management; property issues and disposition; special projects. The allocation of work and projects that this position will manage among these areas will be determined by the Chief Legal Officer, Senior Vice President, and/or Senior Counsel and may vary and will depend upon the needs of ALSAC. Identifies legal issues and works with internal departments to find solutions to legal challenges in a cooperative, efficient and effective manner. Represents ALSAC in dealing with other attorneys, vendors, entities, government officials, donors and other third-parties.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

1. Uses a high degree of concentration and analytical ability to provide legal advice and counsel on matters as assigned by the Chief Legal Officer Legal in areas of law including, but not limited to fundraising; state compliance issues and charitable registrations; gaming issues; raffle licenses; special event licenses; alcohol permits; business licenses; grant applications and compliance; insurance and risk management; property issues and disposition; government relations and legislative monitoring; reviewing and drafting contracts; HR and policy related matters; technology and marketing matters; research projects; and special projects, and other areas impacting ALSAC. Uses a demonstrated higher level knowledge and competency in one or more areas of the law.

2. Uses demonstrated ability to handle a higher-level issue from inception to completion skillfully; keeps supervisor appropriately informed and updated; understands which issues and decisions need to be elevated and which can be handled; and consistently handles these higher level issues appropriately. 3. Uses strong interpersonal skills, listening skills, negotiating skills and the ability to work with a variety of individuals within and outside the organization and find solutions to legal issues and challenges. Works as a strategic business partner with internal departments and to represent the organization to third parties well. Identifies legal issues and work with internal departments to find solutions to legal challenges in a cooperative, efficient and effective manner. Recognizes and considers enterprise-wide impact if issues and solutions. Develops policies relating to industry-specific issues and internal practices and action plans for solving issues and assists in implementation.

4. Must represent ALSAC and the Legal Department well and in a manner that allows for the successful and efficient resolution of matters and legal issues. Works with the Chief Legal Officer and other Senior Leadership, Legal, state officials, attorneys, entities, donors and third parties on matters of significance affecting ALSAC.

5. Responsible for ensuring prompt, timely and complete responses to information and research requests submitted to the Legal Department and assigned to Corporate Attorney III - Regulatory Affairs. Generates written communication as necessary to ensure that legal conclusions are documented appropriately and disseminated to those with a need to know. Requires use of a personal computer.

6. Maintains and develops expertise about laws, regulations, and court decisions affecting fundraising and other areas of law applicable to ALSAC.

7. Uses a relatively high degree of concentration and legal knowledge to assist the Chief Legal Officer, Executive Director, and /or Sr Director – Legal in legal, managerial and administrative matters arising out of the diversity of issues affecting the organization.

8. Use significant experience of practiced law; demonstrates a higher level of knowledge and competency in one or more areas of the law; Works independently to develop consistency, perform in-depth research and analysis.

9. Uses knowledge of law to handle issues from inception to completion skillfully and with minimal supervision; Keeps supervisor appropriately informed and updated; understands which issues and decisions need to be elevated and which can be handled; identifies nuances in issues presented and the enterprise-wide impact of his/her advice and proposed solutions; and consistently handles these higher level issues appropriately.

10. Works as a strategic business partner with internal departments and represents the organization to third parties well.

Job Requirements

  • Requires knowledge and the ability to handle highly technical legal matters independently and with the discernment needed to keep his or her supervisor appropriately informed and updated; understands which issues and decisions need to be elevated and which can be handled; and consistently handles these higher level issues appropriately. Ideal candidate would have experience working with regulatory agencies and/or oversight bodies and/or in-house for a large organization and be able to interpret relevant regulations and contractual provisions and/or litigation and contract experience would be preferred.
  • Requires a demonstrated ability to practice law in a variety of areas and the ability to work through issues internally and externally for the good of the organization.   • Speak and write in a clear and understandable manner; understands complex verbal and written instructions; excellent proofreading skills;

Job Description

The Manager, IT Supplier Management is responsible for leading ALSAC's Information Technology supplier management function, overseeing the strategy, governance, performance, and commercial management of technology suppliers across software, SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, telecommunications, consulting, and managed services.

This role serves as a key partner to IT leadership, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Information Security, and business stakeholders to ensure supplier relationships deliver measurable business value, support organizational priorities, mitigate risk, and optimize technology investments.

The Manager will lead both strategic and operational supplier management activities, including vendor selection, RFx processes, contract negotiations, renewals, performance management, supplier governance, spend optimization, and supplier relationship management. This leader will drive the continued maturity of ALSAC's IT supplier management practices while ensuring effective execution of day-to-day supplier operations.

This position is ideal for a collaborative leader who combines strong business acumen, negotiation expertise, relationship management skills, and technology industry knowledge to deliver exceptional supplier outcomes.

What You'll Do

Strategic Supplier Leadership

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve IT supplier management policies, standards, processes, and governance practices.
  • Drive supplier management maturity, operational efficiencies, and technology spend optimization initiatives.
  • Establish supplier performance measurement frameworks, scorecards, reporting, and supplier tiering models.
  • Evaluate market trends and supplier capabilities to support strategic technology decisions.

Vendor Relationship Management

  • Lead strategic relationships with technology suppliers, consulting partners, and service providers.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and hold suppliers accountable for contractual obligations, service levels, performance commitments, and business outcomes.
  • Manage supplier escalations, dispute resolution, and performance improvement initiatives.
  • Foster collaborative supplier partnerships while maintaining strong governance and accountability.

Contract, Sourcing & Commercial Management

  • Lead vendor evaluations, RFx activities, supplier selection processes, and contract negotiations.
  • Negotiate pricing, commercial terms, service-level agreements (SLAs), renewals, Statements of Work (SOWs), and other supplier agreements.
  • Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and Information Security to ensure contracts align with organizational requirements and mitigate risk.
  • Identify opportunities to consolidate suppliers, optimize licensing, and increase purchasing leverage.

Financial & Risk Management

  • Monitor supplier spend, budgeting inputs, forecasting activities, and invoice management processes.
  • Identify cost savings, cost avoidance, and value optimization opportunities across the technology portfolio.
  • Evaluate supplier financial viability, operational performance, and market conditions to proactively mitigate risk.
  • Maintain supplier risk, performance, and spend data to support business decision-making.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with IT leadership, Project Management Office, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Information Security, and business stakeholders.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on supplier strategy, contract management, sourcing approaches, and vendor governance.
  • Support technology initiatives by ensuring supplier engagements align with organizational objectives, policies, and standards.
  • Deliver training, guidance, and best practices related to supplier management across IT.

Team Leadership

  • Provide leadership, coaching, prioritization, and development for IT Supplier Management team members.
  • Oversee execution of supplier management services and operational processes.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, customer service, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree and 6 year's experience, including managerial experience.
  • Experience developing and managing IT supplier management policies, standards, governance frameworks, and operational processes.
  • Experience managing technology suppliers across software, SaaS, cloud, telecommunications, infrastructure, consulting, and managed services.
  • Demonstrated expertise in supplier relationship management, vendor performance management, and supplier governance.
  • Proven success leading complex technology contract negotiations and working directly with internal and external legal counsel.
  • Experience managing RFx processes, supplier evaluations, supplier selection, and contract lifecycle activities.
  • Experience establishing supplier performance metrics, scorecards, and executive reporting.
  • Strong financial acumen with experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, invoice review, spend analysis, and cost optimization.
  • Experience defining, negotiating, and enforcing service-level agreements (SLAs).
  • Strong analytical, organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.

Job Description

The Senior Resource Manager, Creative & Content is responsible for leading the planning, execution, production oversight, and resource management of projects developed by the Creative & Content team across multiple channels and mediums. This role serves as a strategic partner to creative leadership, supply chain, finance, and external vendors to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with organizational objectives.

The Senior Resource Manager drives operational excellence by optimizing workflows, managing vendor relationships, overseeing project budgets, and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and scalability across creative production processes.

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead planning, resource allocation, project execution, and production oversight for Creative & Content initiatives across print, digital, video, environmental, and emerging media channels.
  • Partner with Creative & Content leadership, Supply Chain, Finance, and internal business stakeholders to ensure efficient vendor selection, procurement, logistics, inventory management, and purchasing practices.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to achieve strategic goals and business objectives, proactively identifying risks, recommending solutions, and adjusting plans as needed.

  • Analyze resource demand, project capacity, budget trends, and production metrics to inform decision-making and support department planning.
  • Identify, recommend, and implement process improvements that enhance workflow efficiency, project visibility, stakeholder communication, and overall team effectiveness.

Creative Production & Resource Management

Vendor & Supply Chain Management

  • Proven experience managing vendors and agency partners, including contract administration, procurement processes, purchase orders, invoicing, quality assurance, and performance evaluation.
  • Knowledge of sourcing and RFP processes, including vendor selection and negotiation.

Project & Financial Management

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to balance multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Experience developing, managing, and reporting on project and production budgets.
  • Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and provide actionable recommendations.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority and build partnerships across all organizational levels.
  • Skilled at presenting complex information in a clear, concise, and actionable manner.

Process Improvement

  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate workflows, identify inefficiencies, and implement sustainable process improvements.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Speak and write in a clear and understandable manner for internal and external audiences.

Job Description

The Senior Specialist, Programs - Music & Audio supports the strategy, planning, execution, and growth of national fundraising programs and donor engagement experiences within the Music & Audio portfolio. This role plays a key part in expanding St. Jude's presence within the music industry and driving growth across all genres, with a particular focus on the Contemporary Christian Music (CCM) industry. The role helps create meaningful experiences that inspire artists, partners, donors, and supporters to advance the mission of St. Jude Children's Research Hospital.

Working closely with program leadership, Territory teams, artist management, radio ownership groups, syndicated shows, on-air personalities, industry partners, and cross-functional stakeholders, the Senior Specialist helps execute fundraising campaigns, artist engagement initiatives, donor cultivation opportunities, and partner training efforts. The role is responsible for managing assigned campaigns and events, cultivating strong partner relationships, supporting revenue-generating opportunities, coordinating logistics, and ensuring exceptional stakeholder experiences.

Key Responsibilities

Program Strategy & Execution

  • Support the achievement of fundraising and business objectives that strengthen and advance the mission of St. Jude.
  • Assist in the development, planning, and execution of assigned Music & Audio campaigns, events, and donor engagement experiences.
  • Contribute to growing music program strategy across genres with a focus on expanding engagement within the Contemporary Christian Music (CCM) community.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, calendars, and operational processes to ensure successful program execution.
  • Support the development and implementation of artist engagement protocols and donor cultivation strategies.
  • Support radio ownership groups, syndicated shows, on-air personalities, and an assigned radio territory by developing and strengthening relationships and implementing fundraising strategy.

Relationship & Account Management

  • Manage relationships for assigned fundraising campaigns, events, sponsors, partners, volunteers, and industry stakeholders.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for designated partnerships, ensuring timely communication, follow-up, and stewardship.
  • Support existing partnerships while identifying opportunities to expand engagement, fundraising impact, and mission awareness.
  • Collaborate with Territory teams and external partners to execute campaigns and fulfill partnership commitments.

Fundraising & Donor Engagement

  • Support fundraising initiatives and donor experiences across both live and virtual event environments.
  • Utilize relationship-based fundraising techniques to cultivate, engage, and steward participants, donors, and supporters.
  • Create meaningful mission-focused experiences that deepen donor connection and encourage long-term engagement.
  • Identify and recommend opportunities to enhance participant experiences through innovative in-person, digital, and virtual engagement strategies.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with internal departments and stakeholders to improve processes, enhance program delivery, and streamline campaign execution.
  • Implement communication strategies that promote alignment, awareness, and collaboration across teams and programs.
  • Develop and deliver training materials, presentations, mission-focused content, and stakeholder communications.
  • Support reporting, data analysis, and program evaluations to measure effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.

Innovation & Business Development

  • Support the exploration and implementation of new fundraising opportunities through partnerships, organic and paid social platforms, digital initiatives, sweepstakes, and other emerging audience engagement strategies.
  • Assist with testing and evaluating new concepts designed to increase participation, revenue, and supporter engagement.
  • Contribute ideas and recommendations that strengthen program growth, partner value, and overall fundraising outcomes.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in fundraising, event management, nonprofit programs, partnership development, marketing, entertainment, music industry relations, account management, or a related field.
  • Experience managing stakeholder relationships and coordinating events, campaigns, or partnership initiatives preferred.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Bilingual proficiency (English/Spanish) is a plus

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively engage internal and external audiences.
  • Strong relationship-building and customer service orientation.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a dynamic environment.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working collaboratively across cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and CRM/event management platforms preferred.
  • Passion for mission-driven work and creating meaningful donor and partner experiences.
  • Interest or experience within the music, entertainment, faith-based, or nonprofit sectors is highly desirable.

Travel Requirements

  • Ability to travel up to 50%, including evenings, weekends, and occasional holidays, as required to support events, artist engagements, and fundraising activities.

Job Description

Responsible for designing, developing, and implementing data models with Statistical and Machine learning expertise. Responsible for specifying, monitoring, gathering, analyzing, and reporting all metrics related to Product initiatives including revenue, reach, and engagement metrics such as conversion rates, web behavior, etc. for the entire digital Product portfolio. Responsible for Data Mining and Analysis from organization databases to drive optimization and improvement of product development, marketing techniques and business strategies.

To be successful in this role you must be able to work effectively in a fluid, fast-paced environment while maintaining good communication with management and team members and be able to mentor entry level analysts. Strong communications skills, including proven writing/editing ability a must.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

1.    Support the implementation and maintenance of Digital analytics tools (Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Tag Management System - DTM) for the new/existing applications.
2.    Work closely with business analysts to define implementation requirements, Functional/Tagging Specification Documents and maintain documentation through Adobe Analytics SDR (Solutions Design Reference).
3.    Implement Digital Analytics and Insights best practices across all Products. 
4.    Develop, customize, and troubleshoot events and tags in complex environments with the use of JavaScript, XML, HTML and CSS.
5.    Implement analytics tracking code and assist in quality assurance to ensure tagging functionality across all web properties.
6.    Design and develop data visualizations using data viz tools (Tableau, etc.), to communicate and demonstrate digital performance per established objectives and best practices.
7.    Coordinate with Product and digital marketing teams for appropriate definition of and ongoing analysis of metrics, including ensuring tagging and taxonomy are implemented correctly are being adhered to in order to meet analytic needs.
8.    Leads the way in establishing and supporting analytic standards, best practices, and testing strategies working cross-functionally with a variety of interactive subject matter experts and business stakeholders. Educates teams on web analytics best practices and toolsets through the development of training materials, standards documentation, and takes lead in the coordination/facilitation of regular training sessions with various analytics user groups.
9.    Identify methods to improve the digital analytics front-end implementation based on internal and external data
10.    Identify online data collection issues and work with development and product teams for resolution

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree and 6+ year's experience.
  • Requires experience with Adobe Analytics and Digital Data domain.
  • Requires experience analyzing and developing actionable insights for digital products and experiences.
  • Strong communication skills to translate data and insights into a performance data story that will inform strategy and optimization.
  • Proficiency with Excel or similar spreadsheet tools for analysis, validation, and reporting.
  • Self-motivated with strong intellectual curiosity; comfortable working with large data sets across multiple data sources;
  • Experience in website tagging and conversion path/journey tracking, as well as, building data queries in SQL as a plus.
  • Must have demonstrated experience using the tools to drive business decisions, as well as a deep understanding of the underlying technology (tagging structure, set-up, and functional capabilities).
  • Ability to develop experimental and analytic plans for data modeling processes, use of strong baselines, ability to accurately determine cause and effect relations.
  • Understanding of relevant statistical measures such as confidence intervals, significance of error measurements, development, and evaluation data sets, etc.
  • Track record of diving into data to discover hidden patterns and of conducting error/deviation analysis. Experience with statistical modelling / machine learning.
  • Foundational understanding of experimentation or A/B testing concepts, including hypotheses, success metrics, guardrails, and interpretation of results.
  • Working knowledge of digital analytics measurement concepts, including events, dimensions, conversion, engagement, segmentation, persistence, attribution, baselines, and trend analysis.
  • Working understanding of data layers and Adobe Launch or Tags, including the ability to read analytics requirements and support validation through browser developer tools. Advanced implementation coding is not required.
     

Location & Work Arrangement: This is a hybrid position based at ALSAC's National Executive Office (NEO) in Memphis, Tennessee. Team members are expected to work a combination of on-site and remote days in accordance with organizational hybrid work guidelines.

Job Description

As a Sr. Advisor Area Development at ALSAC, you manage a blended portfolio of leadership annual donors, corporate partners, high-value volunteers, event committees, and strategic fundraising initiatives throughout Southern California. The Sr. Advisor Area Development is responsible for driving revenue growth through donor cultivation, sponsorship engagement, volunteer leadership development, fundraising events, stewardship activities, and cross-functional collaboration in support of ALSAC's mission. This role supports key Southern California fundraising initiatives, including Evening of Hope and other high-value donor and volunteer engagement opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

1. Creative Visionary

In collaboration with area leadership, develop and execute iconic signature event experiences that transcend expectations, from intimate gatherings to grand galas. Provide strategic leadership for complex, high-revenue fundraising events, donor cultivation experiences, and volunteer-led initiatives. Drive recruitment, engagement, and stewardship of high-profile volunteer leaders, event committees, and corporate partners while ensuring fundraising goals are achieved.

2. Organizational Pro

Manage multiple fundraising initiatives and projects autonomously with exceptional attention to detail. Coordinate event planning, sponsorship development, volunteer management, donor engagement, and stewardship activities while balancing competing priorities and deadlines.

3. Cultivate Relationships with Purpose

Utilize your exceptional interpersonal and relationship development skills to recruit, engage, and steward corporate partners, individual donors, sponsors, committee members, and volunteer leaders. Through strategic communication, personal visits, fundraising activations, and cultivation opportunities, establish relationships that extend beyond transactions and foster long-term philanthropic investment.

4. Collaborate for Impact

Partner across enterprise functions, including Development, Marketing, Event Production, Data Strategy, Volunteer Engagement, Finance, and Philanthropic Advisory teams to execute fundraising strategies and ensure alignment with organizational goals and donor engagement best practices. Monitor KPIs, assess outcomes, and recommend strategic adjustments to maximize impact.

5. Empower Fundraising Initiatives

Leverage your fundraising expertise to inspire and empower volunteers, leadership committees, sponsors, and donors. Provide motivation, direction, training, and resources through personal visits, strategic communications, and engagement opportunities to help achieve fundraising and relationship development goals.

6. Strategize for Growth

Develop and implement innovative cultivation, solicitation, stewardship, and moves management strategies that strengthen engagement and philanthropic support among leadership annual, corporate, and major donor prospects. Identify opportunities to increase revenue growth and deepen stakeholder engagement.

7. Champion Donor Relationships

Manage a blended portfolio of 75-100 leadership annual donors, corporate partners, high-value volunteers, event committee members, and donor prospects. Build, maintain, and advance relationships through strategic cultivation, stewardship, sponsorship engagement, and revenue-generating opportunities designed to increase donor retention and philanthropic investment.

8. Collaboration

Collaborate closely with Development and Philanthropic Advisory teams to strengthen donor and volunteer relationship management strategies. Ensure alignment across stewardship, financial analysis, prospect management, and fundraising initiatives to maximize organizational impact and donor experience.

9. Data-Driven Impact

Utilize donor data, engagement insights, and fundraising analytics to inform strategic decision-making, stewardship plans, and portfolio management. Leverage data systems to create personalized donor experiences and optimize fundraising outcomes.

10. Elevate Our Presence

Represent ALSAC/St. Jude Children's Research Hospital in all interactions with donors, volunteers, sponsors, corporate partners, and community stakeholders. Serve as a trusted ambassador who advances the organization's mission and reinforces its commitment to excellence.

Qualifications and Experience

Strategic Fundraising Event Leadership

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, high-revenue fundraising events, including galas, golf tournaments, dinners, and volunteer-led initiatives generating $1M+ in annual revenue. Proven ability to oversee strategic planning, fundraising execution, sponsorship development, volunteer engagement, and revenue performance.

Compelling Communication

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly, build consensus, influence stakeholders, and inspire action among donors, volunteers, sponsors, and community leaders.

Relationship-Based Fundraising

  • Demonstrated success cultivating, soliciting, stewarding, and managing relationships with leadership annual donors, corporate partners, major donor prospects, and volunteer leaders. Proven ability to implement moves management strategies that drive donor engagement and revenue growth.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Project Management

  • Experience navigating multiple stakeholders and coordinating efforts across fundraising, marketing, volunteer engagement, event planning, production, finance, and other enterprise teams. Strong project management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and maintain momentum across multiple initiatives.

Experience in Philanthropy

  • Strong background in relationship-based fundraising, committee engagement, corporate partnerships, board development, strategic planning, and execution of premier fundraising events. Experience developing donor engagement strategies and volunteer leadership programs that drive fundraising success.

Senior Leadership Presence

  • Demonstrated leadership capability with a strategic mindset focused on revenue growth, volunteer leadership development, donor engagement, sponsorship expansion, and innovative fundraising solutions.

Corporate Sector Relationships

  • Ideally possess established relationships within the corporate sector and a proven ability to identify, cultivate, solicit, and steward corporate sponsors and donors.

High-Value Volunteer Leadership

  • Proven ability to recruit, inspire, engage, and steward influential volunteer leaders, executive committees, corporate partners, boards, and community stakeholders. Experience managing complex volunteer structures and committee-driven fundraising efforts.

Education and Travel

  • Six or more years of relevant experience in fundraising, development, sales, business development, customer relationship management, or a related field. Bachelor's degree preferred. Travel 15%-20%, including nights, weekends, and periodic travel to Memphis, TN.

Driver's License

  • A valid driver's license is required for this role.

The Principal Advisor serves as a strategic partner to the Senior Director, Marketing Business Center, and a trusted advisor to the Chief Marketing & Brand Officer and senior marketing leaders. Operating at the center of the organization’s most important priorities, this role helps shape and communicate the strategic direction of the Marketing Division while driving critical initiatives that advance organizational goals.

This position is responsible for translating complex business challenges, strategies, and data into clear, compelling narratives that inform decision-making, align stakeholders, and inspire action. A key aspect of the role is the ability to visualize strategy and create executive-level communications that bring ideas to life through impactful storytelling, business narrative development, and presentation design.

The Principal Advisor leads high-priority strategic projects on behalf of marketing leadership, provides thought partnership on emerging opportunities, and business challenges, and supports enterprise-level planning and execution. The role also serves as a steward of marketing intelligence, synthesizing industry trends, organizational insights, and competitive perspectives into actionable recommendations that strengthen strategic decision-making. Examples of projects include helping manage our Digital Innovation Advisory Council (DIAC) and leading the bi-monthly Marketing Review with the CEO and key executive leaders and developing Board-level communication and presentations.

In addition, the Principal Advisor helps advance the capabilities of the marketing organization by supporting leadership communications, strategic planning processes, and educational initiatives that build marketing/communications/creative acumen, strengthen organizational alignment, and elevate the effectiveness of the division.

  • 8-10 years of experience in the user-experience, marketing, and communications realm driving projects in a cross-functional environment including 3-5 years in a leadership position involving strategic project planning, management, and cost control. Bachelor's Degree preferred.

Job Description

At the intersection of generosity and healthcare innovation, the Executive Advisor, Transformational Gifts plays a critical leadership role in advancing our most ambitious philanthropic goals. This is not a traditional frontline fundraising role, although the Executive Advisor manages a portfolio of donors.  It is a strategic, highly collaborative position focused on activating relationships with ultra-wealth net worth individuals/families, empowering leaders and aligning donor passions with institutional vision at the $10M+ giving level. As a trusted partner to executive leadership, professional advisors and relationship managers at all levels, this individual will help cultivate, shape solicit and steward some of the most significant giving opportunities in our organization’s history. 

Essential Job Duties

1.    Portfolio management:  Responsible for driving revenue through the qualification, cultivation, solicitation, closing and stewardship of 10M+ gifts, meeting or exceeding established goals. 
2.    Transformational Gift Strategy: Partner with internal teams to design, refine, and drive strategies for engaging individuals, families and foundations with the capacity and intent to make transformational gifts ($10M+), ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and impact goals. Success in this role will be measured by progressive metrics – including influence on donor strategy, movement toward transformational investment, depth of engagement, activation of internal leaders and revenue targets – reflecting the complexity and long-term nature of transformational philanthropy. 

3.    Consulting and Capacity Building: Provide strategic internal consulting to relationship managers from across the organization - regardless of title or department – who are connected to transformational prospects. This includes preparation for donor conversations, gift strategy and development, long-term relationship building and solicitation. 

4.    Executive Engagement: Collaborate with the SVP – Transformational Giving, C-Suite executives, and clinical or operational leadership from the hospital on high-stakes donor cultivation steps as needed. Help prepare and coach them for pivotal donor meetings, events and stewardship activities. 

5.    High Value Volunteer Engagement: Serve in support of advisory boards and councils. Plan meaningful engagement opportunities for virtual and on campus experiences that deepen their connection to the mission and demonstrates impact. When possible, leverage their networks thoughtfully and strategically to identify and cultivate new transformational relationships, supporting peer to peer influence and expanding the pipeline of $10M+ prospects. 

6.    Narrative & Case Co-Creation: Work cross-functionally to co-create custom proposals and transformational investment opportunities that reflect the donor’s vision, values, and desired legacy – while advancing our mission in measurable, meaningful ways. 7.    Strategic Initiatives & Campaign Leadership: Play a key role in the development and execution of high-profile philanthropic initiatives, including milestone institutional anniversaries, enterprise-wide campaigns, and research-focused funding priorities. Collaborate across departments to shape compelling campaign strategies and donor experiences that align with transformational giving principles. Serve as a thought partner in designing customized approaches for complex, time-bound opportunities that inspire significant investment and long-term commitment. 

Job Requirements

  • 10+ years’ relevant work experience and proven experience in closing and/or advising on 8- and 9- figure philanthropic conversations, ideally in healthcare, higher education, or a complex mission-driven institution. 
  • Bachelor’s degree required, advanced degree preferred.
  • Natural coach and facilitator, able to build confidence and skill in others while honoring their authentic leadership style.
  • Ability to understand and translate a wide range of in-depth research initiatives and clinical care innovations into compelling, donor centered opportunities. 
  • Comfortable working in highly matrixed environments, influencing without formal authority. 
  • Exceptional emotional intelligence and ability to hold high-trust, high-impact conversations with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Involves extensive travel, willingness and flexibility to travel nationally, including evenings and weekends.

Job Description:

Parsons is looking for a sharp Senior DevSecOps Engineer to join our growing team in Boulder, CO!


In this fully onsite role, you will be a hands-on technical leader for a small, fast-moving program team supporting a classified space portfolio. You will drive DevSecOps practices across multiple projects, architect secure-by-design solutions, and build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure that meet stringent mission and security requirements. This role is ideal for a self-starter who is comfortable leading, coding, automating, and collaborating across engineering, cybersecurity, and operations teams.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Lead DevSecOps initiatives across multiple enclaves and projects, serving as a primary technical point of contact for secure software and infrastructure delivery
  • Architect, implement, and maintain secure cloud and on-prem environments using Infrastructure as Code toolsets such as Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or Pulumi
  • Design, build, and operate automated CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins) with integrated security controls including SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, and secret management
  • Implement, harden, and manage containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes (including RKE2, OpenShift, or Rancher), leveraging Helm, Kustomize, and umbrella charts to deploy and manage complex, multi-service systems
  • Provide expert Linux systems administration on Red Hat Enterprise Linux , including troubleshooting issues across storage, operating systems, applications, and networks in classified or mission-critical environments
  • Integrate security into the SDLC by enforcing secure coding practices, performing code and pipeline reviews, and mentoring developers on DevSecOps and application security principles (including OWASP Top 10)
  • Establish and maintain observability capabilities (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting) to support reliability, incident response, and performance monitoring for mission systems
  • Identify, prioritize, and drive remediation of vulnerabilities across applications, containers, hosts, and infrastructure, in alignment with NIST  controls and DoD DevSecOps guidance
  • Implement and maintain DAST and SAST tools in coordination with ISSOs, system security engineers, and development teams to support RMF Assessment and Authorization (A&A) efforts and continuous monitoring
  • Utilize and manage binary registries (e.g., Artifactory, Harbor, Docker Registry, Nexus) and package repositories in secure environments, ensuring compliance with program policies and security baselines
  • Support and enhance compliance- and policy-as-code solutions (e.g., OPA, Conftest, Checkov) to enforce security baselines, configuration standards, and deployment guardrails across Kubernetes, cloud, and IaC artifacts
  • Collaborate with systems engineering, cybersecurity, operations, and vendor teams to ensure software and infrastructure designs meet security, performance, availability, and accreditation requirements
  • Support and contribute to program documentation and security artifacts, including architecture and deployment documentation, security plans, DevSecOps process documentation, and material for technical reviews and readiness events
  • Work with Product Owners and Scrum Masters to translate security and DevSecOps requirements into actionable user stories and tasks; support Agile ceremonies and iterative delivery of secure capabilities
  • Drive continuous improvement in automation, tooling, and processes to increase deployment frequency, reduce change failure rates, and strengthen the overall security posture of the program

What Required Skills You’ll Bring:

  • Active DoD Secret clearance, with ability and willingness to obtain/maintain TS/SCI
  • 10+ years of experience, with additional education, training, and certifications able to count towards total years of experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree, or additional years of experience in lieu of a degree
  • Professional software/DevSecOps experience in mission-critical defense, space, or aerospace environments; familiarity with DoD DevSecOps, Agile, NIST controls, and OWASP Top 10
  • Strong Linux (RHEL) administration and scripting skills (Bash, Python)(Bash, Python), including system hardening, automation, and troubleshooting across storage, OS, application, and network layers
  • Proficiency in at least one major programming language (e.g., Java, C#, Python, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript) and associated frameworks, plus Git-based workflows and collaboration tools
  • Hands-on experience with containers and orchestration (Kubernetes with RKE2, OpenShift, or Rancher) and managing binary/container registries (Artifactory, Docker Registry, Harbor, Nexus)
  • Expertise in DevOps/DevSecOps practices: CI/CD pipeline design and operation, integrating security controls (SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning, secret management), and secure SDLC implementation
  • Advanced Infrastructure as Code and cloud skills: Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, Pulumi; building and managing AWS/Azure/GCP environments with monitoring/observability
  • Experience with policy-as-code and compliance-as-code solutions (e.g., OPA, Conftest, Checkov)​

What Desired Skills You Might Bring:

  • Prior experience supporting classified space or defense programs
  • Familiarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools and methods
  • Experience with systems engineering processes, including requirements analysis, design, integration, verification, and validation
  • Experience with configuration management and maintaining traceability between software baselines, infrastructure code, and DevSecOps artifacts
  • Experience with test automation and GitLab CI/CD or similar CI/CD platforms
  • Experience supporting AI/ML application infrastructure and associated data pipelines in secure environments
  • Experience with virtualized hosts and platforms (e.g., VMware)
  • Basic network understanding and diagnostics, including TCP/IP, routing, firewalls, and VPNs
  • Experience writing or contributing to acquisition and program documents such as architecture/design volumes, IMP/IMS, RFP responses, and technical proposals
  • Relevant certifications, such as: Cloud: AWS/Azure/GCP Architect or DevOps Engineer, DevOps/DevSecOps: Kubernetes (CKA/CKS), CI/CD tooling certifications, Security: CISSP, CCSP, CSSLP, Security+, or equivalent

An active Secret security clearance is required for this position.​

Job Description:

The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) awarded the Technical Support Services Contract 5 (T5) to Parsons in April 2023. Parsons is the prime contractor. This $1.8+ billion contract has a 4-year base period with two 3-year options. The statement of work includes a variety of activities that support the FAA’s Capital Investment Plan (CIP) and certain reimbursable programs, the FAA NextGen Program, national security programs and aviation safety. Specifically, work includes site selection and engineering, construction, environmental and fire/life safety, equipment installation and testing, drafting, contract surveillance, and other technical services as required. Work is performed across the nation in each of the FAA’s nine regions as well as the Aeronautical Center in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, and the Technical Center in Atlantic City, New Jersey and in several U.S. territories. An average staff of 500 with a peak staff over 650 supports this contract, in addition to those subcontractors who perform construction work.


The SCA – Engineering Technician serves as an experienced field technician supporting the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) under the TSSC-5 contract. This position performs installation, modification, testing, troubleshooting, repair, and preventive maintenance on a variety of electronic systems and equipment that support the National Airspace System (NAS).

The Engineering Technician works under limited supervision, following established procedures, technical documentation, and FAA directives. The technician may work independently on routine or moderately complex tasks and supports senior technicians or engineers on more complex systems and activities.

Perform installation, relocation, and removal of electronic systems and equipment, which may include:

  • Navigation aids (NAVAIDS)

  • Communications systems (VHF/UHF, data/voice)

  • Surveillance and support systems

  • Associated power, grounding, and control equipment

Troubleshoot and repair systems to the unit, board, or module level as assigned:

  • Use standard test equipment (digital multimeters, signal generators, oscilloscopes, etc.)

  • Follow step-by-step troubleshooting guides, fault isolation procedures, and technical manuals

  • Escalate complex or recurring issues to crew lead, FAA counterparts, and project management.

Read and work from:

  • Schematics, wiring diagrams, and interconnect drawings

  • Equipment manuals, technical orders, and job plans

  • FAA orders, work instructions, and site-specific procedures

Assist in field installations and site work under TSSC‑5:

  • Support pre-installation checks and site preparation

  • Install racks, cabinets, and equipment per drawings and installation standards

  • Route, terminate, label, and test cables (coax, fiber, copper) under guidance

  • Assist with system power-up, basic alignment, and functional testing

Use and care for test and measurement equipment:

  • Configure and operate standard electronic test instruments

  • Perform basic measurements, alignments, and performance checks

  • Maintain proper calibration and handle equipment in accordance with procedure

Document work activities in accordance with contract and FAA requirements:

  • Complete maintenance logs, service tickets, and test forms

  • Record parts used, corrective actions taken, and test results

  • Provide redline/as-built information to senior technicians or engineers

Follow all safety, security, and quality practices:

  • Comply with FAA and Parsons safety policies, OSHA regulations, and site Risk Management Plans

  • Adhere to physical and information security requirements at FAA facilities

  • Follow configuration control and quality assurance procedures

  • Collaborate effectively with senior technicians, engineers, project managers, and FAA representatives to support project objectives.

What Required Skills You'll Bring:

  • High school diploma is required.

  • May require repetitive movement such as lifting up to 50 lbs., bending, and standing.

  • Basic Microsoft suite and Internet, and E-mail.

  • Must be able to meet customer security requirements. A background check by federal authorities will be performed.

  • Must be able to travel up to 100% within the USA.

  • Five plus years of working knowledge of:

    • Basic analog and digital electronics

    • Fundamentals of RF and communications equipment

    • Use of standard electronic test equipment (DMMs, basic scopes, signal generators)

  • Ability to:

    • Read and interpret basic schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation

    • Follow written and verbal instructions and standard procedures

    • Work safely in field, shop, and facility environment

Security Clearance Requirement:

None

Job Description:

Tier 1 Systems Administrator - Tuesday-Saturday & Holidays

 

Parsons is looking for a sharp Tier 1 Systems Administrator to join our growing team!

 

If you are in the early stages of your IT career and want an environment that will foster technical growth and exposure to new technologies in a collaborative team culture, we have an exciting opportunity for you located in beautiful Boulder, Colorado. The TAP Lab is the U.S. Space Force’s premier Remote Sensing application development laboratory, with an extensive computer and network infrastructure and physical facilities that provide a complete computing environment, at multiple levels of data classification .https://boulderlab.org/

 

Work Shift: 

  • Tuesday – Friday 6 AM – 2 PM Mountain Time
  • Saturday – 9 AM – 5 PM Mountain Time
  • Required to work Federal Holidays with OT (if this does not fall within your normal work schedule) Mountain Time

 

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Provide Onsite Tier I systems, hardware, network, application, and storage administration support in a primarily Red Hat environment with Active Directory.
  • Monitor system for anomalies or issues requiring attention or escalation.
  • Perform initial troubleshooting of system issues.
  • Augment current Tier 1 support by facilitating vendor onboarding, account creation, password resets, and software updates.
  • Provide IT and Audio-Visual support for classified and unclassified lab events, demonstrations, meetings, and symposiums.
  • Responsible for the maintenance, configuration, and reliable operation of computer systems, network servers, and virtualization-based hardware and software.
  • Implement technical hardware and software solution to meet system requirements.
  • Generate, review, and analyze manual and automated cyber reports.
  • Assist in system and equipment installation, verification, and check-out.

 

What Required Skills You’ll Bring:

  • Active Secret DoD Security Clearance with ability to obtain and/or maintain a TS/SCI
  • 0+ years of experience
  • Bachelors degree, with additional years of experience able to count in lieu of a degree. Additional flexibility pending Customer approval.
  • Current Security+ Certification or equivalent IAT Level II or III certification
  • Experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux and the Microsoft Windows operating systems administration.
  • Experience with administration and troubleshooting of virtualized and bare metal platforms (Virtual Machines, Containers, Other).
  • Experience with Windows Active Directory domains and Windows server administration.
  • Familiar with VMware vSphere/ESXi.
  • Experience with adding, removing, and updating Red Hat RPMs.
  • Understanding of network fundamentals (IP, Ethernet).
  • Experience with virtualized operating system concepts and administration.
  • Working knowledge of security assessment/compliance products (HBSS, ACAS, OpenSCAP, ePO, SCC).
  • Must be able to work in a production/operational environment.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and customer service skills.

 

What Desired Skills You Might Bring:

  • Two or Four year Degree in IT discipline preferred.
  • Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA)
  • Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate Certification (MCSA)
  • Experience with audio/visual systems.
  • Experience with KVMoIP systems.
  • Experience with working with a Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tool to monitor system alerts (Elastic preferred).
  • Working knowledge of the following technologies or equivalent: Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Kickstart, DHCP, Ansible, SDN, RPM.
  • Previous experience working on network devices.
  • Working knowledge of automation tools (Chef, Puppet, Ansible, Other)
  • Experience within an Agile framework environment.
  • Working knowledge of security assessment/compliance products (HBSS, ACAS, OpenSCAP, ePO, SCC, STIGs, STIG Viewer).
  • Experience with system automation and configuration management.
  • Familiarity with network administration of routers, switches, and firewalls.
  • Experience with JIRA, DI2E, and Confluence.
  • Working knowledge of complete hardware stack: rack, power, compute (CPU and GPU), storage (NAS, SAN, Scale-out, and Object), network (switches, routers, load balancers, and firewalls), workstation, and display.
  • Intermediate knowledge of RHEL administration (RHEL 8 and above).
  • Management of virtualization, cloud, and container technology (VMware workstation/vSphere/vCenter/ESXi, AWS EC2/S3/Glacier, Docker/Kubernetes/OpenShift).
  • Fluent in one or more of the following scripting areas: Shell, Python or Perl.  

Security Clearance Requirement:

An active Secret security clearance is required for this position.​

Job Description:

This position involves protecting controlled areas, enforcing security regulations, and responding effectively to emergency situations.

Job Description:

At Parsons, great work starts with great people. We’re looking for an energetic, collaborative, and people-first Proposal Operations Manager to support our Critical Infrastructure business across the U.S. Central region.


This is a player-coach leadership role for someone who loves developing talent, building strong partnerships, and staying close to the work. You’ll lead, grow, and empower a team of proposal professionals while supporting strategic pursuits and helping teams create bold, compelling deliverables that set Parsons apart. You’ll collaborate with capture managers, business development professionals, operations leaders, technical subject matter experts, and creative teams. By bringing people together, building momentum, and strengthening what works, you’ll help teams envision—and deliver—what’s next.


If you’re energized by collaboration, eager to roll up your sleeves, and motivated to help teams raise the bar, you’ll fit right in.


What You'll Be Doing:


People Leadership

  • Lead and inspire a team that creates compliant, responsive, and compelling AEC proposals and related deliverables.
  • Set your team up for success with clear direction, thoughtful coaching, the right resources, and plenty of support.
  • Build a people-first culture where communication, collaboration, innovation, accountability, and growth are part of the everyday experience.
  • Create opportunities for team members to share knowledge, learn from one another, build new skills, and grow their careers.
  • Mentor staff at all levels by supporting professional goal-setting and development, conducting performance reviews, and making appropriate recommendations regarding advancement, changes in status, or corrective action.
  • Attract top talent to support the growth of the proposal operations team through thoughtful hiring, onboarding, and retention.
  • Recognize great work, celebrate the wins, and keep the team connected, engaged, and motivated.

Partnership and Resourcing

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with capture, business development, operations, and other internal partners.
  • Get to know stakeholders’ priorities and help shape the strategies, solutions, and deliverables that give Parsons a competitive edge.
  • Bring your perspective to business development, market, and regional meetings, including pipeline reviews, strategy sessions, and WinStrats.
  • Assess pursuit needs, build thoughtful proposal budgets, and connect the right people and resources to the right opportunities.
  • Allocate and assign team resources across proposal and business development efforts based on priorities, level of effort, complexity, schedule, and other requirements.
  • Evaluate schedules and workloads to balance assignments, support a healthy work-life balance, and maintain accurate proposal assignment and forecasting logs.
  • Strengthen collaboration across the business unit and regions and look for ways to share and scale what’s working.
  • Bring a can-do mindset to every challenge—find common ground, move good ideas forward, and keep the work moving.

Pursuit Excellence

  • Guide high-priority pursuits, from pre-positioning and strategy through proposals, presentations, and final deliverables.
  • Champion the implementation of Parsons’ Winning Process and Business Acquisition Process across the business segment to strengthen pursuit strategies and improve win outcomes.
  • Bring energy, insight, and fresh ideas to kickoffs, strategy sessions, storyboarding workshops, color reviews, and lessons-learned sessions.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor and proposal expert on major pursuits.
  • Turn lessons learned into smarter processes, targeted training, repeatable best practices, and stronger future wins.

What Required Skills You'll Bring:

  • Strong leadership, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to bring out the best in people and keep raising the bar.
  • A solid understanding of the AEC industry and experience leading complex, high-visibility pursuits.
  • Demonstrated organizational, planning, and time-management skills; you can juggle a lot at once, troubleshoot on the fly, calmly de-escalate tense moments, step in to lead when needed, and make solid decisions under pressure.
  • A talent for building trusted relationships with capture leaders, operations, technical teams, and executives while keeping everyone aligned.


What Desired Skills You'll Bring:

  • Four-year degree in a relevant field (or equivalent). We value what you know and how you apply it.
  • Around 10 years of progressive proposal management experience, including 3–5 years leading people. You’ve grown your career by growing others.
  • Professional credentials such as APMP (any level), PMP, or Shipley training/certification is a plus and shows you take your craft seriously and invest in it.
  • A driver of change and builder of buy-in; big thinker with an ever-evolving vision for the future; process builder and follower, but knowns when to adapt, improve, and pivot.

Security Clearance Requirement:

None
