jobDescription:
Are you passionate about delivering complex technical solutions that help organizations combat financial crime and meet evolving regulatory requirements?

Do you enjoy partnering with customers to design, implement, and optimize secure, cloud-native compliance platforms in enterprise environments?

About the Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at 

https://risk.lexisnexis.com/

About our Team

Applies in-depth knowledge of functional/business area and/or specific applications to identify, customize and implement appropriate applications/solutions (e.g., H. R information systems,. Enterprise. Resource. Planning systems, manufacturing/supply chain) for external clients. Analyzes client needs and participates in design of business process requirements. Translates business requirements into off-the-shelf and customization specifications. Tests, documents and trains client personnel on functional/business applications software. Experienced practitioner. Works independently. Requires in-depth knowledge and experience. Solves complex problems. Contributes to process improvements. Uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external business issues to improve products or services. Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience.

About the Role

As a Senior Consultant, you will lead the technical implementation, configuration, and optimization of LexisNexis® Firco™ Continuity solutions for enterprise clients in regulated industries. You will be responsible to assist clients during the full lifecycle of the deployments, from solution design to solution deployment, advanced troubleshooting, security, and compliance integration. This role requires a blend of hands-on technical expertise, client-facing consulting skills, and a deep understanding of financial crime compliance and cloud-native architectures.

Responsibilities

Deployment & Configuration:

  • Lead the end-to-end deployment of Firco™ Continuity Cloud Native solutions, including infrastructure preparation, installation, configuration, and validation.
  • Configure and optimize Kubernetes clusters, persistent storage, container registries, and networking (Ingress, Service Mesh, etc.).
  • Integrate and secure connections to RDBMS, IBM MQ, and web servers as required by client architecture.
  • Implement and document best practices for high availability, resiliency, and disaster recovery.
  • Manage environment variables and configuration files for complex, multi-component deployments.
  • Automate deployment and upgrade processes using scripts, Helm charts, and CI/CD pipelines.

Database Management:

  • Create, migrate, and maintain Oracle and SQL Server databases, including schema upgrades and plugin table management.
  • Configure advanced database features such as connection pooling, isolation levels, and case-insensitive search.
  • Implement secure authentication (Kerberos, encrypted credentials) and manage database access for multiple components.

Messaging & Integration:

  • Set up and configure IBM MQ, Kafka, and other messaging systems for reliable, secure communication between components.
  • Integrate DAPR sidecar for pub/sub messaging, state management, and secret storage.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to message delivery, event processing, and distributed transactions.

Security & Compliance:

  • Implement and manage SSL/TLS, mTLS, and certificate-based authentication for all endpoints.
  • Configure and maintain OAuth2, SAML, and LDAP authentication for user and API access.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and client-specific regulatory requirements.
  • Manage user provisioning, roles, and permissions using APIs and identity providers.

Monitoring & Troubleshooting:

  • Set up and monitor health checks, logging, and alerting all components.
  • Diagnoses and resolve issues related to application performance, connectivity, and data integrity.
  • Provide advanced troubleshooting support for DAPR, JVM, and containerized environments.
  • Document and share best practices for issue resolution and system optimization.

Client Engagement & Support:

  • Collaborate with client teams, project managers, and product support to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Provide training, knowledge transfer, and ongoing support to client administrators and users.
  • Stay current with evolving compliance, security, and financial messaging standards.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • Minimum 5 years of technical implementation experience, ideally in enterprise, banking, or financial services environments.

Operating Systems:

  • Proficient in Unix (Linux Redhat, AIX, Solaris) and Windows Server environments.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), including multi-node cluster setup, namespace management, and persistent storage configuration
  • Familiarity with clock synchronization and port management for multi-instance deployments.

Databases:

  • Strong knowledge of RDBMS and SQL, including Oracle, DB2, and MS SQL Server.
  • Experience with database schema creation, migration, and advanced configuration (tablespaces, collation, isolation levels, connection pooling)
  • Ability to run and troubleshoot vendor-specific scripts for schema upgrades and plugin tables.
  • Understanding of database security, Kerberos authentication, and encrypted credentials.

Middleware and Messaging:

  • Hands-on experience with IBM MQ (queueing system), including secure configuration, channel management, and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with event brokers (Kafka, Azure Service Bus, GCP Pub/Sub) and pub/sub architectures, including DAPR sidecar integration for distributed messaging.

Web Servers:

  • Configuration and administration of at least one of: WebSphere, WebLogic, Apache Tomcat (including embedded Tomcat in Java applications).
  • Experience with SSL/TLS, mTLS, and certificate management for secure HTTP endpoints.

About the Business

About our Team 

Our team is responsible for the pricing benchmarks, market intelligence and analysis that underpin commercial decision-making across the global petrochemicals industry. We work closely with producers, traders, distributors, converters and brand owners to deliver transparent, independent insight into chemical markets. By combining market expertise, industry engagement and robust price assessment methodologies, we help customers navigate risk, identify opportunity and understand evolving market dynamics. 

About the Role

This senior role puts you at the heart of Europe’s polyethylene and polypropylene markets, leading ICIS’ editorial strategy, benchmarks and market intelligence. You will build trusted industry relationships, interpret market-moving developments and deliver authoritative insight and analysis that helps customers make informed commercial decisions. As a key voice for European polyolefins coverage, you will help maintain trusted pricing benchmarks and contribute to the future direction of market intelligence and product development.

Responsibilities

  • Lead ICIS’ European polyolefins coverage, owning the quality, credibility and impact of our polyethylene and polypropylene market intelligence and pricing.
  • Act as the market authority for European polyolefins, maintaining deep insight into supply, demand, trade flows, pricing dynamics and emerging market trends.
  • Own industry-leading price benchmarks, exercising independent judgement to assess market value and ensure transparent, trusted and robust pricing.
  • Deliver high-impact analysis and insight that helps customers understand market developments, manage risk and make informed commercial decisions.
  • Build and develop senior industry relationships across producers, traders, distributors, converters and brand owners.
  • Drive thought leadership, identifying the themes, risks and opportunities that matter most to customers.
  • Represent ICIS externally at conferences, customer meetings, webinars and industry events, acting as a recognised voice in the market.
  • Shape the future of ICIS’ polyolefins offering, helping evolve benchmarks, develop new areas of coverage and influence product strategy and innovation.

Requirements

  • Deep expertise in polyolefins, polymers or petrochemical markets, with a strong understanding of pricing, trade flows and commercial market dynamics.
  • Strong commercial judgement and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex information and draw clear, defensible conclusions.
  • Experience of working with pricing mechanisms, benchmarks or market intelligence and an understanding of their role in commercial decision-making.
  • Proven ability to build credibility and strong relationships with senior industry stakeholders and customers.
  • Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex market developments into clear, actionable insight.
  • Confidence representing an organisation externally and acting as a trusted voice in industry forums, customer meetings and events.
  • A proactive, curious and accountable mindset, with the drive to understand markets in depth and identify emerging opportunities and risks.
  • High levels of professionalism, integrity and independence, with the presence and credibility expected of a recognised market authority.

Overview

The Technical Engineer serves as a senior production support and reliability engineering professional responsible for ensuring the availability, stability, performance, and operational excellence of critical business applications and platforms.

 

This role combines strong troubleshooting expertise with modern Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), observability, automation, cloud operations, and incident management practices. The Technical Engineer partners with Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Product, and Vendor teams to proactively identify operational risks, improve system resilience, accelerate incident resolution, and continuously enhance customer and employee experiences.

 

The ideal candidate possesses deep technical knowledge of application support, distributed systems, cloud technologies, monitoring platforms, automation tools, and modern operational practices. They are passionate about eliminating repetitive work through automation and leveraging AI-powered tools to improve operational efficiency and support outcomes.

 

Primary Responsibilities

Production Support & Incident Management

  • Serve as a technical escalation point for critical production incidents, outages, and service degradation events.
  • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis efforts across applications, integrations, infrastructure, cloud services, APIs, and supporting technologies.
  • Coordinate incident response activities involving application teams, infrastructure teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
  • Restore service quickly while ensuring long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented.
  • Participate in major incident management processes and post-incident reviews.

 

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)

  • Apply Site Reliability Engineering principles to improve platform reliability, scalability, resilience, and operational efficiency.
  • Define and support Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and operational performance metrics.
  • Drive reduction of operational toil through automation and process improvement.
  • Support production readiness reviews and operational acceptance processes.
  • Participate in disaster recovery, resiliency, failover, and business continuity testing.

 

Troubleshooting & Problem Management

  • Analyze complex system behavior using logs, metrics, traces, performance data, and monitoring tools.
  • Perform deep technical investigations across application, infrastructure, data, network, and cloud environments.
  • Identify recurring issues, trends, and systemic problems to reduce future incidents.
  • Lead root cause analysis (RCA) activities and implement preventive solutions.
  • Develop technical recommendations that improve system stability, performance, and reliability.

 

Observability & Monitoring

  • Design, implement, and optimize monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability solutions.
  • Develop dashboards and health indicators providing visibility into application and platform performance.
  • Partner with engineering teams to improve observability through instrumentation, distributed tracing, synthetic monitoring, and telemetry collection.
  • Continuously refine alerting strategies to reduce false positives and alert fatigue.
  • Establish operational health metrics and reliability reporting.

 

Automation & Scripting

  • Develop and maintain automation solutions that improve operational efficiency and service reliability.
  • Create scripts, tools, and workflows to automate diagnostics, health checks, remediation activities, and routine support tasks.
  • Leverage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation frameworks where appropriate.
  • Drive continuous improvement through operational automation and self-healing capabilities.
  • Partner with engineering teams to integrate automation into deployment and operational workflows.

Desired Scripting Technologies:

  • PowerShell
  • Python
  • Bash/Shell
  • SQL
  • REST APIs
  • Workflow automation platforms

 

AI-Assisted Operations & Innovation

  • Leverage AI and Generative AI tools to improve incident analysis, troubleshooting, knowledge management, and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize AI-powered operational insights to identify patterns, anomalies, and emerging risks.
  • Contribute to development of intelligent support capabilities including chatbots, operational copilots, automated RCA generation, and knowledge recommendations.
  • Evaluate opportunities to improve production support through AI-enabled automation and predictive analytics.
  • Promote responsible AI practices aligned with enterprise governance and security requirements.

 

Support Playbooks & Knowledge Management

  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve support runbooks, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and recovery playbooks.
  • Ensure support documentation remains accurate, actionable, and aligned with production environments.
  • Establish standardized operational processes supporting incident response and service recovery.
  • Capture lessons learned from incidents and incorporate improvements into support practices.
  • Build and maintain operational knowledge repositories to improve support consistency and reduce resolution times.

 

Cloud Operations

  • Support cloud-hosted and hybrid application environments, including Azure-based platforms and services.
  • Assist engineering teams in implementing resilient and observable cloud architectures.
  • Monitor cloud resource health, performance, utilization, and operational readiness.
  • Support cloud deployments, platform upgrades, and operational change activities.
  • Partner with cloud engineering teams on modernization and reliability initiatives.

 

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Partner closely with Engineering, Product, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, QA, and Vendor teams.
  • Review operational readiness of new systems and platform enhancements.
  • Mentor junior support engineers and provide technical guidance during incident response activities.
  • Promote operational excellence, reliability engineering principles, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert within assigned technology domains.

 

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Ensure production support activities comply with enterprise risk, security, regulatory, and audit requirements.
  • Identify operational risks and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Support implementation of internal controls and operational governance standards.
  • Participate in audit, compliance, and regulatory review activities as required.

 

Education & Experience Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience supporting enterprise applications, platforms, or infrastructure in production environments.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex application, infrastructure, integration, or cloud-related issues.
  • Strong knowledge of incident management, production support processes, and operational best practices.
  • Experience with monitoring, observability, logging, and alerting platforms.
  • Experience with scripting and automation technologies.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

 

Preferred Qualifications

Reliability Engineering & Operations

  • Experience with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices.
  • Experience defining and managing SLIs, SLOs, and operational metrics.
  • Experience supporting distributed systems, APIs, microservices, and cloud-native applications.
  • Experience performing production readiness reviews and operational assessments.

Observability & Monitoring

Experience with platforms such as:

  • Dynatrace
  • Splunk
  • Datadog
  • Azure Monitor
  • Grafana
  • Prometheus
  • OpenTelemetry
  • AppDynamics

Cloud Technologies

  • Experience supporting Azure cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with Azure App Services, AKS, Functions, Storage, Event Hub, Service Bus, and monitoring services.
  • Understanding of cloud security and operational best practices.

Automation & Scripting

  • Advanced PowerShell scripting.
  • Python development and automation.
  • REST API integration.
  • Infrastructure as Code concepts.
  • CI/CD tools and deployment pipelines.

AI & Modern Operations

  • Experience using Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI services, Microsoft Foundry, or similar AI-enabled platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted troubleshooting and operational analytics.
  • Experience implementing AI-enabled support workflows or knowledge management solutions.
  • Understanding of intelligent automation and operational copilots.

 

What Great Looks Like

A successful Production Reliability Engineer:

  • Resolves complex incidents quickly and effectively.
  • Proactively identifies and eliminates recurring production issues.
  • Uses automation and scripting to eliminate manual support work.
  • Builds comprehensive support playbooks and operational runbooks.
  • Leverages AI to accelerate troubleshooting and operational insights.
  • Establishes strong observability and monitoring capabilities.
  • Partners effectively with engineering teams to improve reliability.
  • Drives a culture of operational excellence through SRE principles.
  • Continuously improves customer experience through system stability, resilience, and performance.

jobDescription:

Overview:

A member of the Commercial Credit team that partners with senior team members supporting the duties of underwriting and the on going monitoring of a portfolio of credit relationships. Responsible for performing supporting analysis, identifying risk issues, and completing sections of credit analysis, as needed, to assess the creditworthiness of commercial clients.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Facilitate the credit needs of customers by underwriting new requests and material modifications from deal screen through approval and for the life of the loan. This analysis may include recommending adding or removing conditions.
  • Manage the ongoing credit risk of existing loan portfolios through continuous credit monitoring (CCM) activities enabling the timely identification of emerging credit risk so that appropriate actions can be taken to manage the risk, minimize losses and assign an accurate risk rating. A CCM program includes but is not limited to annual reviews, interim update memos, a covenant monitoring program, problem loan management, early warning indicators, and other forms of credit surveillance.
  • Review all pertinent credit and financial information, including but not limited to financial statements, tax returns, due diligence reports, credit bureaus, appraisals, internal credit information, industry research and peer data. Determine the need for more thorough investigation or additional information.
  • Analyze financial information and related materials and complete the credit analyses for the Bank’s commercial transactions. Written analyses to include an independent credit quality assessment with well-supported risk rating, identification of and description of credit risks and mitigants, industry concerns, market trends, financial trends, and other pertinent credit issues of respective deals.
  • Make appropriate structure recommendations based on an analysis and evaluation of scenarios including the company's case, bank's base case and a downside case.
  • As part of managing the ongoing credit risk of existing portfolios, identify suspicious activity and activity that may be contrary to customer's interest.
  • Partner proactively with relationship managers (RM) and be intimately involved throughout the deal process, from deal screen through approval and for the life of the loan to maintain timely and accurate risk ratings for a portfolio of commercial credits. Spread financial statements and prepare financial / projection models designed to sensitize various conditions impacting the proposed transaction.
  • Prepare cash flow, collateral schedules, covenant sensitivity calculations, financial models, and guarantor statement analysis as appropriate.
  • Attend client/prospect calls with RMs to gain a thorough understanding of the client/prospect and their business to effectively analyze and underwrite the proposed transaction. Based on underwriting parameters, recommend the risk rating.
  • Prepare summary, present facts, and offers opinions concerning credit-worthiness.
  • Present analysis or address questions during credit request discussions or committee presentations.
  • Ensure credit policy compliance by verifying adherence of underwriting to the Commercial Credit Policy and commenting on any risk associated with non-compliance.
  • Understand and adhere to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management.

  • Complete other related duties as assigned.

Scope of Responsibilities:

Commercial Credit is responsible for the credit delivery of the Bank's commercial clients throughout the credit lifecycle. Credit assessments range from initial analyses of new relationships to the Bank to material modifications or restructurings of long-term relationships and ongoing monitoring through the life of the loan. Commercial Credit is also responsible for ensuring the accurate completion of the Bank's risk rating scorecards and financial statement spreads. The work completed in this capacity is used to make credit decisions for new or renewed or amended credit transactions.

The position interacts with commercial banking relationship managers throughout the bank’s footprint and industry verticals as well as other internal personnel on credit approvals.

Works independently with limited supervision.

C.H. Robinson is seeking a Compliance Analyst to strengthen import compliance, protect our clients’ supply chains, and keep critical automotive operations moving across the United States and Canada. In this role, you will serve as a trusted on-site resource for an automotive client, ensuring import transactions are accurate, compliant, and resolved efficiently. You will review customs documentation, classifications, valuations, trade programs, and regulatory requirements while partnering with brokers and internal teams to support smooth operations. Apply today to make an impact in a highly visible role at the center of global trade compliance.

This position follows a Thursday through Monday schedule. Work hours are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. CST (8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. PST) on Saturdays and Sundays and 1:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m. CST (11:30 a.m. – 8:30 p.m. PST) on Thursday, Friday, and Monday. Candidates must be available to work this schedule consistently.

Responsibilities:

  • Support on-site automotive client operations and serve as a trusted resource for North American import compliance
  • Manage daily trade compliance activities in accordance with U.S. and Canadian import regulations, client procedures, and company policies
  • Review commercial documentation, purchase orders, and customs entry data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance
  • Partner with designated customs brokers to support import operations, customs clearance, and timely issue resolution
  • Validate Right to Make Entry documentation, HTS classifications, customs valuation, and Country of Origin determinations
  • Assess AD/CVD applicability, Free Trade Agreement eligibility, Partner Government Agency requirements, and other import requirements
  • Review compliance with U.S. trade remedies and special tariff programs, including Sections 301, 232, and 122
  • Coordinate post-entry corrections and collaborate with internal teams, customs brokers, and external partners to resolve compliance issues
  • Support audits, compliance reviews, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen accountability and operational excellence

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in custom/import compliance or related field
  • Provide evening and weekend coverage when required to support client and business operations

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Extensive Knowledge of U.S. Customs entry and import operation processes and partner government agency regulations
  • Strong communication, prioritization, and multi-tasking skills
  • Proven critical-thinking and problem-solving skills to adapt to ever-changing tasks and customer needs
  • High level of attention to detail
  • Ability to work and communicate across the branch network
  • Licensed Custom Broker (LCB) or similar
  • Values a diverse and inclusive work environment

jobDescription:
This full-time role starts spring/summer 2027.

Join us as an Associate Portfolio Executive and begin learning and building your customer portfolio as part of an accelerated training track, ensuring service delivery aligns with customer commitments. As a brand ambassador, you'll drive positive customer experiences while expanding your business portfolio. Upon completion of the training track, you will move into a Portfolio Executive role. The Associate Portfolio Executive position stands out as a premier opportunity, offering abundant resources and development support. For those committed to putting in the work, there's no better role for a long and successful career in this industry.

As an Associate Portfolio Executive, you’ll focus on re-engaging dormant accounts as well as cold calling new opportunities, without the need to prospect. This unique approach allows you to focus solely on relationship development and business expansion, setting us apart from competitors who spend more time finding leads than nurturing customer relationships.

What makes this role unique?

Our unparalleled support system allows you to effectively manage your portfolio with confidence. We provide robust technology that amplifies your capabilities and bandwidth, enabling management of large portfolios efficiently. Additionally, our emphasis on autonomy allows you the freedom to run your business with our extensive network and scalability.

We prioritize your growth.

Our strong onboarding program and commitment to personal development within the organization ensure you have the tools for success. The collaborative culture and managerial focus on your development propel your career forward.

Everyday life in this role is dynamic.

You have the opportunity to win daily with our established customer base. Moreover, we promote a supportive environment, ensuring a work-life balance where teams support each other, allowing everyone to enjoy PTO.

If you're driven, money-motivated, and passionate about relationship-building and problem-solving, apply now to be part of our team!

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Customer Experience:

  • Drive the conversion of sales leads into active customers by establishing strong contacts, fostering relationships, and comprehensively understanding customer needs to achieve the highest possible conversation rate

  • Proactively engage with customers, carrier, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring the attainment of customer needs and growth targets

  • Respond promptly to customer inquiries and exceptions while managing conflict diplomatically

  • Identify automation opportunities to streamline processes, enhance operational efficiency, and ensure high-quality execution by promptly identifying and resolving operational issues

  • Reconnect with dormant customers, fostering relationships and stimulating demand

  • Execute pricing strategy through applying effective negotiation skills, market acumen, and knowledge of customer buying habits

  • Maintain a sense of urgency in addressing both your teammates' customers and your own developing portfolio of customers

Service Delivery & Business Development

  • Generate additional business within teammates' portfolios, exceeding monthly volume and revenue targets while expanding portfolio size

  • Drive demand by engaging customers, fostering relationships, and capitalizing on business prospects

  • Identify growth potential within accounts, transitioning transactional engagements into committed partnerships

  • Stay updated on customer, industry, and market changes to pinpoint growth opportunities

  • Execute various customer-facing operational tasks like quoting, load building, shipment activation, and handling order-level service escalations

Process Efficiency:

  • Adopt and apply new tools, technology, and processes to improve overall workflow

  • Utilize data and reporting to identify service improvement opportunities and expand wallet share

  • Partner with internal resources to ensure account processes and SOPs are complete and adhered to

  • Maintain a minimum portfolio size of existing customers by volume and revenue

  • Participate in daily or weekly team stand-ups to foster communication and alignment

  • Use technology to manage order statuses and initiates corrective measures during exceptions

  • Leverage Navisphere 2.0, with demonstrated ability to create customer and supplier logins and support adoption

  • Assist in the development of any SOPs required to manage customers' business effectively

Required Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED.

  • Minimum 6 months Customer Engagement Experience internal or external

  • Ability to travel up to 10%

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university.

  • Attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving.

  • Demonstrated negotiation, collaboration, and influencing skills.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite of Programs.

  • Values a diverse and inclusive work environment.

At C.H. Robinson we're firm believers in the power of in-person collaboration to fuel innovation and propel success. In this role you will engage with peers in-office four days a week, igniting creativity and driving impactful results. With the flexibility for remote work one day a week, this role strikes the perfect balance between teamwork and autonomy.

We value an environment where you can grow by challenging yourself and are supported with the potential for internal promotion – within Sales, Global Forwarding, Operations, Account Management or other areas – so you can discover new interests, develop your strengths, and reach your life goals. jobDescription:
C.H. Robinson is seeking a Fleet Planner – Power Plus to join our team. You will be accountable for day-to-day planning and aligning consistent capacity to customer commitments. This includes, but is not limited to, driver and trailer optimization to maximize revenue, driver satisfaction, and customer service. In this role you will help to create demand, identify new wallet share opportunities, and sell creative solutions working with both network capacity and commercial teams. As the primary point of contact for Power Plus programs, you are additionally responsible for customer advocacy, driving continuous improvement, and delivering on our customer commitments both internally and externally. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure an optimal customer/carrier experience.

This role may be based in Eden Prairie, MN or Chicago, IL.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The duties and responsibilities of this position consist of, but are not limited to, the following:

Program Advocacy

  • Serves as the day-to-day customer resource, delivering a positive customer experience through proactive communication, timely responses and applying the appropriate sense of urgency as situations dictate. Build credible and personalized relationships at multiple levels across functional departments within the customer supply chain.
    • Manage conflict and navigate difficult conversations with the customer, using tact and diplomacy
    • Apply critical thinking skills to effectively resolve problems and identify the best course of action 
  • Develops strong relationships within the CHR network while promoting the benefits of the Power+ program
    • Drive continuous improvement, and deliver on our customer commitments
    • Stay informed of changes within the customers’ business, industry, and sector; apply knowledge to identify new opportunities
  • Consistently pursues personal development opportunities to expand understanding of CHR’s modes, services, and technology
  • Accountable to adopt and apply new tools and processes that improve overall workflow

Planning & Execution

  • Responsible for day-to-day optimization of fleets and coordinating and planning aligned customer freight for Power+ carriers.
  • Contribute to region goals by pre-planning carriers, leveraging analytical reporting and commercial relationships to ensure KPI’s, revenue, and goals are met
  • Ensure capacity meets specific load requirements by aligning multi-leg movements on Power+ Fleet
  • Matches network freight to available capacity using truck postings, lane history search, etc.
  • Responsible for entering and managing program plans vs actual results
  • Secure and manage dedicated freight consisting of closed loop routes, corridors, one-way shipments and drop trailers
  • Ensures quality expectations are met on all executed shipments.
    • Accept/Reject customer and carrier tenders
    • Schedule Appointments according to capacity needs
    • Ensure accuracy of load data
    • Proactive review of financial results, volume, and service performance.
    • Responds timely to all customer and carrier requests
    • Responsible for returning and injecting trailers when needed
    • Red Tag/Put trailers on hold that need service, GPS replacement, or need to be returned
    • Trailer Pool management for aligned trailer yards
    • Identify and communicate trailer issues to Power+ maintenance

Carrier Management

  • Assist with regular business review internally and externally
  • Onboard carriers into the Power+ program, define expectations and timelines, and set plans for execution
  • Focus on developing dedicated capacity to ensure we have supply ready to service growing volume across our dedicated network
  • Develops an understanding of carrier’s business, goals, preferences, capabilities, equipment, and expertise to maximize the relationship, capacity utilization and carrier satisfaction

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

  • High School diploma or GED
  • Minimum 2 years of previous transportation, planning, or account management experience
  • Ability to travel up to 10% (domestically and internationally)

Preferred:

C.H. Robinson is seeking a Transportation Security Operations Specialist to join our team.  In this role you will support the safe and secure transportation of high-value freight. You will oversee day-to-day security operations, coordinate security escorts, conduct shipment risk assessments, and apply security protocols to protect goods in transit. You will partner closely with internal teams and external security partners to maintain high standards of safety, risk management, and customer service.

This is a hybrid position based in our Downers Grove, IL location.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

The duties and responsibilities of this position consist of, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Protects the integrity of high-value products being shipped by consistently applying established security processes and protocols.
  • Liaises with local law enforcement, security contractors, and external partners to address security concerns and strengthen transport operations.
  • Continuously monitors high-value freight during transit using surveillance systems, GPS tracking, and other tools to detect and escalate irregularities timely.
  • Completes required data entry and confirms key Security Operations milestones, including departure, arrival, PODs, and related updates, using McLeod and other systems.
  • Ensures required paperwork, including temperature downloads, pictures, PODs, and other supporting documents, is uploaded to load documents and customer records to support billing completion.
  • Conducts shipment risk assessments to identify potential security threats and vulnerabilities along transportation routes.
  • Handles escalations related to suspicious activity involving customer freight.
  • Updates customer portals according to customer requirements.
  • Attends required training and staff meetings.
  • Maintains a safe working environment through accident prevention, equipment preservation, and safe working practices.
  • Maintains a positive and professional demeanor with customers, visitors, and co-workers.
  • Adheres to applicable policies and procedures.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

  • 1 year of security, compliance, and/or customer service experience.
  • 1 year of logistics experience.
  • Ability to multitask under pressure while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to understand and communicate drivers' temperature requirements, mileage, and hours of service during transit.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Teams.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain or related field.
  • Knowledge of TSA and GDP practices.
  • Clear and confident verbal and written communication skills.
  • Analytical approach to problem solving.
  • Ability to work independently in a team-oriented environment.
  • Experience with conflict resolution and escalated issue management.
  • Demonstrated emotional intelligence and professional judgment.
  • Advanced knowledge of the supply chain industry, including regulations and customer requirements.
  • Values a diverse and inclusive work environment.

Do you enjoy creating new relationships? Are you a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment? If so, our Capacity Portfolio Representative position might be the perfect fit for you!

 

As a Capacity Portfolio Representative, you’ll blend inside sales, account management, and operations to grow and manage a portfolio of carriers. Your mission will be to deliver exceptional service by collaborating with trucking company owners, dispatchers, and drivers, ensuring the right truck is matched with the right shipment at the perfect time and price.

 

If you’re driven by creating connections, solving challenges, and exceeding customer expectations, this role is for you. You’ll sharpen your sales skills and move fast to meet customers' supply chain challenges and business needs. The relationships you develop with carriers will fuel their success—and your own!

 

So, what can we do for you?

We believe that when you achieve, we succeed. Our commitment to your success starts on day one with a dynamic and comprehensive onboarding program designed to jumpstart your knowledge of the industry and C.H. Robinson’s systems and processes. You’ll benefit from top-tier training, continuous development, and a supportive team culture that empowers you to excel.

 

Let’s talk money…

We offer our Capacity Portfolio Representatives a competitive base salary, with opportunities to earn monthly bonuses based on stellar performance. Your drive and results will directly shape your financial success.

 

Flexibility for your wellbeing

At C.H. Robinson we're firm believers in the power of in-person collaboration to fuel innovation and propel success. In this role you will engage with peers in-office four days a week, igniting creativity and driving impactful results. With the flexibility for remote work one day a week, this role strikes the perfect balance between teamwork and autonomy.

 

On your next adventure, you’ll…

  • Establish and maintain carrier relationships through lead generation, cold calling, and referrals
  • Learn about carriers’ business goals, preferences, and capabilities to maximize relationships and satisfaction
  • Monitor account activity, identify inactive or underutilized accounts, and take action to reactivate them
  • Leverage technology such as automated booking products, C.H. Robinson’s carrier website, and mobile apps to enhance carrier satisfaction and efficiency

  • Analyze freight market trends, seasonality, and supply-demand factors to make informed pricing decisions
  • Use capacity analysis and internal costing tools to guide your buying and negotiating strategies
  • Proactively post, negotiate, and secure available capacity to meet customer needs

  • Provide outstanding service by addressing carrier issues promptly and implementing effective solutions
  • Regularly review and act on carrier feedback to improve service
  • Identify and recommend the best payment solutions for each carrier based on their needs

Execute Process Efficiency

  • Collaborate with internal teams on shipment updates, problem resolution, and operational execution
  • Maintain accurate transit load visibility and reinforce on-time pickup and delivery expectations
  • Identify root causes of issues and implement solutions to enhance performance

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent

 

Even better if you:

  • Value a diverse and inclusive work environment
  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university

  • Can persuade, motivate, influence, and negotiate with others
  • Display strong decision-making, multi-tasking, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Enjoy solutions driven work by leveraging appropriate tools to evaluate and make recommendations

In this role, you will serve as a trusted customs expert, managing complex exceptions, government agency examinations, and high-impact shipment issues while delivering exceptional service and operational excellence. You will leverage your regulatory expertise and problem-solving skills to support accurate customs clearance, drive continuous improvement, and help optimize automated customs operations. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment where your expertise directly impacts customers and business performance, we encourage you to apply.

At C.H. Robinson, we’re firm believers in the power of in-person collaboration to fuel innovation and support training. In this role, you will engage with peers on-site 5 days a week, igniting creativity and driving impactful results. Upon successful completion of your training, you will then switch to 2 days a week in the office, working the rest of the time from home. This role strikes the perfect balance between teamwork and autonomy. 

This position follows a Saturday through Wednesday schedule. Work hours are 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Candidates must be available to work this schedule consistently.

Responsibilities:

The duties and responsibilities of this position consist of, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Review and validate customs entry data to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely cargo clearance

  • Resolve complex customs exceptions, including documentation gaps, classification issues, valuation discrepancies, and regulatory concerns

  • Manage government agency holds and customs examinations, including CBP, FDA, CPSC, VACIS, CET, and Tailgate inspections

  • Serve as a trusted customs compliance expert, interpreting regulations and applying them across daily operations and automated processes

  • Prioritize critical shipment issues to prevent delays and maintain exceptional service for customers

  • Partner with customs brokers, transportation providers, and internal teams to ensure seamless import clearance and delivery

  • Own and maintain customer-specific SOPs, HTS databases, and compliance requirements to support operational excellence

  • Investigate and resolve cargo damage claims, insurance matters, demurrage, detention disputes, and other high-impact shipment issues

  • Conduct quality reviews of customs entries and automated decisions to ensure compliance, accuracy, and process effectiveness

  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying workflow enhancements, supporting automation initiatives, and helping optimize customs operations and exception management

Required Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED

  • Fluent in English and Spanish (written and verbal)

  • Minimum 2-3 years of entry-writing experience, international transportation or experience with AI Agents

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate or bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in related field

  • Experience supporting automation-enabled workflows or BPO-integrated operations

  • Familiarity with customs exams, government agency holds, or dangerous goods processes

  • Knowledge of ABI, AMS queries, or entry summary components

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite of programs

  • Prior experience in customer-facing operational support or escalation management

  • Knowledge of Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) and the supply chain

  • Excellent communication, prioritization, and multi-tasking skills

  • Excellent customer service skills and follow up to be utilized with customers and the network

  • Proven track record of dealing with customers and being client focused

  • Critical-thinking, flexibility, and problem-solving skills to adapt to ever-changing tasks and customer needs

  • Reputation for logical, methodical and expedient approach to problem resolution

  • High level of attention to detail

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and deadline-driven office environment

  • Values a diverse and inclusive work environment

Must comply with 19 CFR 111.53(e) requirements, including eligibility to work in a Customs Brokerage role. Candidates must be able to pass an initial and annual background check, as employment in this department requires written approval from U.S. Customs and Border Protection for individuals with felony convictions, unless prohibited by applicable state or local law.

About the Role:


The Distribution Specialist is responsible for supporting the operational execution and day-to-day management of strategic distribution partners across North America. Primary Responsibilities:

Distribution Operations & Program Execution

  • Manage day-to-day operational engagement with distribution partners.
  • Ensure compliance with channel programs, policies, and contractual obligations.
  • Coordinate resolution of quotes, orders, pricing updates, renewals, reporting, and other operational issues.
  • Support execution of channel programs, promotions, rebates, MDF, and new partner initiatives.

Performance Management & Analytics

  • Produce and maintain weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reports.

  • Monitor SLA performance, operational metrics, and compliance to identify areas for improvement.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Enablement

  • Collaborate with Channel Sales, Finance, Marketing, Sales Operations, and Partner Programs teams.
  • Act as a liaison between distributors, partners, and internal stakeholders to drive issue resolution and business execution.
  • Support forecasting, business planning, operational reviews, and partner enablement activities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

  • Experience working with Ingram Micro, TD SYNNEX, or similar distribution partners.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce (SFDC) and reporting tools.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Position Summary 

We are seeking an Entry-Level Network Engineer to support enterprise-scale infrastructure in a global production environment. This role provides hands-on experience in monitoring, troubleshooting, and automating network services supporting enterprise platforms within the F5 Digital organization. 

You will collaborate with senior engineers within our Infrastructure team and contribute to operational excellence, reliability, and performance optimization initiatives. This position is ideal for recent graduates or early-career professionals seeking to develop expertise in network operations and engineering. 

This role is Seattle, WA-based and offers a hybrid working environment.  

Key Responsibilities 

  • Support and maintain enterprise network infrastructure (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers)

  • Support configuration management and change control processes

Required Qualifications

  • Familiarity with automation tools (Ansible, Terraform) and/or Python scripting language 

  • Basic knowledge of cybersecurity practices, network administration, and troubleshooting methodologies 

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-driven environment 

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail 

  • Willingness to learn and adapt in a dynamic technical environment 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Interest in emerging AI technologies for network management 

  • CompTIA Network+ or equivalent certification 

  • Experience with network monitoring and performance management tools 

  • Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments

Position Summary 

The Technical Program Manager I (TPM I) is the entry point into the Technical Program Management profession at F5. This role is designed for early-career talent who demonstrate strong analytical thinking, collaboration skills, technical curiosity, and a passion for driving outcomes through influence rather than authority. The TPM I partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders to support the planning, coordination, and execution of technical initiatives. 

Working under the guidance of experienced Technical Program Managers, the TPM I develops foundational program management skills while learning how to navigate technical systems, manage risks and dependencies, facilitate cross-functional alignment, and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders. 

Successful TPM I employees progressively build the capabilities required to independently lead complex cross-functional programs and advance within the TPM profession. 

 

Primary Responsibilities 

  • Support the planning, execution, and delivery of technical programs and workstreams under the guidance of senior TPMs. 

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and business stakeholders to understand requirements, document scope, and coordinate delivery activities. 

  • Create and maintain project plans, schedules, status reports, action items, risk registers, dependency trackers, and other program documentation. 

  • Facilitate project meetings, Agile ceremonies, and cross-functional planning activities to ensure effective communication and alignment. 

  • Monitor program progress, identify risks and blockers, and escalate issues appropriately. 

  • Assist with resource planning, capacity forecasting, milestone tracking, and delivery reporting. 

  • Analyze program metrics and project data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring attention. 

  • Support stakeholder communications through presentations, dashboards, executive summaries, and status updates. 

  • Participate in continuous improvement efforts by identifying ways to improve delivery processes, transparency, and team effectiveness. 

  • Develop technical acumen by working closely with engineers and architects to understand system architecture, dependencies, integrations, and software delivery practices. 

  • Learn and apply TPM best practices, methodologies, tools, and frameworks across a variety of business and technology initiatives. 

  • Responsibly leverage AI and productivity tools to improve planning, documentation, reporting, analysis, and program execution. 

 

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities 

  • Experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and automate tasks  

  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills. 

  • Demonstrated problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities. 

  • Ability to work effectively across multiple teams and disciplines. 

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities. 

  • Ability to influence and build relationships without formal authority. 

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn technical concepts, systems, and business processes. 

  • Basic understanding of project or program management principles, including scope, schedule, risks, issues, and dependencies. 

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Office products including PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and Outlook. 

  • Ability to work effectively in Agile, hybrid, or traditional delivery environments. 

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to follow-through. 

 

Desired Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities 

  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and Scrum practices. 

  • Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Smartsheet, or similar collaboration tools. 

  • Understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) concepts. 

  • Exposure to cloud technologies, SaaS products, cybersecurity, enterprise systems, data platforms, or infrastructure technologies. 

  • Experience leading team projects, student organizations, hackathons, or other collaborative initiatives. 

  • Interest in pursuing a career in Technical Program Management. 

 

Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Mathematics, or a related discipline. 

  • 0-2 years of professional experience. 

  • Prior internship, co-op, research, leadership, or project experience preferred. 

  • Demonstrated ability to work in collaborative, team-oriented environments. 

 

Career Progression 

The TPM I role represents the foundational development level within F5's Technical Program Management profession. 

Through coaching, mentorship, and progressively increasing ownership, TPM I employees build proficiency in: 

  • Program planning and execution 

  • Stakeholder management 

  • Risk and dependency management 

  • Agile delivery practices 

  • Technical and business acumen 

  • Executive communication 

  • Cross-functional leadership 

Successful performance and demonstrated readiness may lead to advancement into Technical Program Manager II (P2), where individuals assume greater ownership of programs and begin operating with increased independence.

Senior Forward Deployed Engineer

F5 Digital · Customer Experience Organization 

About the Role 

The F5 CX Organization builds and runs the enterprise systems behind GTM, Customer Success & Support, RevOps, and Platform Engineering. We are embedding AI into how those systems work, and into how we build them. 

We are hiring a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer: a hands-on senior individual contributor who moves from business problem to working prototype fast, then hardens what works into production. Your time splits across two mandates: maturing our enterprise applications with AI and automation, and making our own engineering and product teams measurably faster with AI across the SDLC. 

This is a greenfield build role, not a sustain-the-business role. You will set the technical patterns other engineers follow. 

What You'll Do 

AI for the SDLC & Internal Productivity 

  • Prototype and ship internal tools that raise team throughput: AI-assisted coding workflows, automated code review, test generation and QA automation, and AI drafting of PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria 
  • Go from idea to MVP in days. Scope it, build it, demo it, get real users on it, then decide to harden or kill 
  • Roll out and tune AI developer platforms (Claude Code, Gemini Enterprise, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) across engineering teams, including standards, prompt and context patterns, guardrails, and adoption 
  • Instrument what you build. Cycle time, review latency, defect escape rate, and hours saved, reported as outcomes rather than activity 

Enterprise Applications & Agentic Systems 

  • Design and deliver AI automation across business systems: GTM and RevOps copilots, support triage and resolution, quote-to-cash automation, and end-to-end process workflows 
  • Build production agentic systems with LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, or equivalent: multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, memory management, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and stateful workflow design 
  • Architect enterprise RAG over business and product data: ingestion and chunking strategy, vector store selection, hybrid search and reranking, embedding model management, and eval loops tied to business KPIs 
  • Establish prompt engineering as an engineering discipline: versioning, structured output contracts, regression test harnesses, and systematic evaluation 

Integrations & Platform Engineering 

  • Lead integration design across Salesforce (Flows, Apex, Agentforce/Einstein), Oracle applications, ServiceNow/Zendesk, MuleSoft/Workato, and internal APIs 
  • Build the reusable connector library and self-serve intake path so new use cases onboard without bespoke work every time 
  • Own CI/CD for AI workloads: automated eval gates, model and prompt versioning, deployment orchestration, and rollback strategy 
  • Keep production AI observable and reliable through monitoring, alerting, and data integrity practices (Datadog, Splunk, or equivalent) 

Technical Leadership & Responsible AI 

  • Define AI engineering standards for the CX organization: coding patterns, RAG design, eval practices, integration patterns, and documentation 
  • Mentor AI, automation, and prompt engineers through design reviews, pair engineering, and structured feedback 
  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture and governance review boards so systems meet security, privacy, and AI ethics requirements. Identify and mitigate model bias, and handle PII and prompt injection risk deliberately 
  • Present architectures, trade-offs, and ROI clearly to senior leadership and non-technical partners 

What You'll Bring 

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years hands-on with AI/ML systems, LLM application engineering, or enterprise intelligent automation 
  • Expert Python: production-quality code, REST API design, async patterns, and reusable framework design 
  • Production agentic AI and RAG systems you have shipped and operated, not demos. Fluency with retrieval strategy, eval design, and the failure modes of both 
  • Strong enterprise business systems background, with hands-on Salesforce (Flows, Apex, CPQ, and/or Agentforce/Einstein) and familiarity with Oracle application stacks 
  • Experience with enterprise integration platforms (MuleSoft, Workato, Boomi, or equivalent) across distributed SaaS ecosystems 
  • Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD (GitHub Actions or equivalent), secrets management, and least-privilege access 
  • Daily hands-on use of AI coding and productivity tooling in your own workflow 
  • Working knowledge of GTM, RevOps, and CX business processes, with the ability to turn a vague business ask into a scoped technical design 
  • A bias toward shipping: you prototype to learn, measure what you ship, and drive problems to resolution without waiting for permission 

Nice to Have 

  • Oracle and/or Salesforce development at enterprise scale; Architect-level certification 
  • LLM security: prompt injection defense, data leakage prevention, output filtering, PII handling in production pipelines 
  • ServiceNow or Zendesk AI for intelligent ITSM automation: auto-triage, severity classification, SLA routing 
  • AWS serverless and integration services (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS) 
  • HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or similar secrets tooling 
  • Experience in a platform engineering, shared services, or federated AI operating model

Position Summary 

This is the full-time conversion role for Data Analyst Interns who have successfully completed their internship in F5's Data Analyst Internship program and have earned their Bachelor's or Master's degree. This position marks your transition from internship to a permanent, full-time role within the F5 Digital organization, allowing you to build on the skills, relationships, and knowledge you've developed during your internship experience. 

 

As a Data Analyst on F5's Enterprise Data Management (EDM) team within the F5 Digital organization, you will continue to support how F5 defines, improves, and validates our critical enterprise data. You'll work alongside analysts and engineers within our Data and Insights team to analyze data issues, support operational needs in current-state systems, and contribute to activities tied to data rebuild/migration efforts. This role offers you the opportunity to deepen your expertise with real-world datasets, improve data quality, and apply what you've learned about how data is managed, structured, and used to support business decisions in a fast-paced, innovative environment. 

 

This position is based in Seattle, WA.

Eligibility & Who Should Apply 

This role is exclusively available to: 

  • Current or recent Data Analyst Interns in F5's internship program who have successfully completed their internship 

  • Individuals who have earned or are about to earn their Bachelor's or Master's degree from an accredited college or university in the US (graduating between December 2026 and August 2027) 

  • Those who have demonstrated strong performance, technical aptitude, and cultural fit during their internship 

Your Role & Responsibilities 

Building on your internship foundation, your typical day may involve: 

  • Taking on increased ownership of EDM Data Quality operations related to customer data (Organizations/Individuals), including investigation of complex issues and conducting ad hoc analysis with greater autonomy 

  • Contributing to the proactive quality management of customer data through profiling and analysis of third-party enrichment sources 

  • Analyzing and validating data involved in Salesforce customer records and Marketo-related requests (as applicable), using spreadsheets, reporting tools, and basic scripting 

  • Managing and analyzing Hardware Asset to Site/Party relationships (e.g., data supporting Renewals and Services motions), including identifying anomalies and leading cleanup efforts 

  • Building, automating, and improving data quality dashboards/scorecards or metric summaries (e.g., Tableau and spreadsheets), focused on clarity, repeatability, and business usefulness 

  • Leading or co-leading team meetings, status updates, and documentation; working on assigned tasks with increasing independence while continuing to collaborate across EDM stakeholders 

  • Mentoring new interns or junior team members as you grow in the role 

  • Following data governance, security, and privacy best practices 

  • Performing other related duties assigned 

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities 

  • Understanding of basic descriptive statistics and data distributions (e.g., counts, rates, trends, outliers) 

  • Solid understanding of data concepts (e.g., data quality, databases, schemas) 

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail; ability to follow data lineage and identify root causes of data issues 

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills (able to summarize findings for both technical and non-technical audiences) 

  • Ability to learn quickly and comfort tackling complex, cross-system problems with curiosity and initiative 

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deliver on deadlines in a collaborative environment 

  • Proficiency with spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets) required; Tableau experience is a plus 

  • Familiarity with SQL, Python, or R for analysis is preferred but not required 

  • Interest in enterprise data concepts (data domains, data quality, governance, master/reference data) 

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams 

  • Experience with F5's systems and business processes (gained during internship) 

Requirements / Qualifications 

  • Successfully completed a Summer 2026 internship with F5.  

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, or a related technical field graduating between December 2026 and September 2027.  

  • Must be able to start no later than September 30th, 2027.  

  • Must be able to work onsite in accordance with F5s policies; fully remote work options are not available.    

  • Strong performance and positive feedback from internship managers and mentors 

  • Willingness to remain based in or relocate to Seattle for this full-time role 

  • Valid work authorization in the United States

Position Summary:   

This position is responsible for increasing revenue in region/territory/district through identifying, recruiting and developing opportunity generating partnerships with partners. In addition this position is focused on driving the partners to operate as an extension of F5's direct sales team through effective sales and technical training, demand generation marketing efforts and mutual business planning. 

 

Primary Responsibilities:   

  • Responsible for upholding F5’s Business Code of Ethics and for promptly reporting violations of the Code or other company policies. 
  • Sales Training – Ensure that partner is able to effectively position and sell F5 solutions. Work with the F5 sales team to drive partner sales training opportunities; ensuring partners have the tools to identify opportunities, sell F5 solutions, and fully understand F5’s UNITY Partner program.  
  • Pipeline Growth and Management – Identify, in conjunction with partners, new sales opportunities. Ensure partners, F5 sales reps and management are working together in the sales process, lead generation, registering opportunities, accurately forecast bookings and tracking to required bookings goals established by the partner’s UNITY Partner tier.  
  • Relationship Management – Develop strong top to bottom relationships throughout the partner organization (Management, sales teams, technical teams and marketing) ensuring partner compliance with the F5’s UNITY Partner Program and fostering a well-developed relationship between F5/partner sales and technical teams. 
  • Excel at Conflict Management - Excellent conflict management skills, with ability to be fair and firm with F5 team and partners.  Examples are: Deal registration, support contracts, and partner tier requirements. 
  • Marketing & Demand Generation – Leverage F5 marketing funds to drive demand generation activities that generate the highest possible ROI.  Manage channel marketing funds to ensure event and partner success.  
  • Account Mapping – Drive regular cadence of account mapping sessions with partners and the F5 sales team focused on driving net-new accounts and new opportunities in existing accounts. 
  • Business Planning – Work with partners to develop and execute a strategic business plan focused on driving new accounts, new opportunities, sales and technical competency and incremental bookings growth. Collaborate with Strategic Partner Managers to develop and execute business plans for our national strategic partners in territory where appropriate.  The partner business plans are the basis for QBRs and need to be updated quarterly. 
  • Special Projects & Reporting - Work on strategic initiatives as established by channel management and reporting business issues/opportunities as requested by channel and/or executive management. 
  • Build relationships with strategic eco-system business partners in the field (examples:  VMware, Microsoft, Oracle, Cisco). 
  • Recruit and develop new partner relationship to drive whitespace penetration, access to new vertical and technology markets. 
  • Create and execute awareness and training programs for the F5 sales force to highlight partners, educate on the UNITY Partner program, and actively participate in district QBRs. 
  • In North America, a Sr CAM can support a territory plus one or more small to midsize strategic partner accounts. Responsible for geographic territory and a Strategic Partner Account that has headquarters within that region. Acts as a lead on planning and programs for that Strategic Partner. 
  • Advanced Business Acumen - Well developed understanding of business, and strategy.  Takes initiative on new programs and innovation to further business goals.

F5’s People & Culture (P&C) organization is looking for a People Analytics Solutions Consultant to join the People Analytics team. Reporting to the Sr. Director of People Analytics, you will be the most senior technical product owner on the team, mentoring other analysts and setting the standard for how we manage and deliver people data to the organization. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the design, product management, and enablement of data and analytics products including Visier, Snowflake, and Tableau. As the analytics product owner, you will work with key partners to enable data integrations, design data governance and data sharing principles, and develop key data definitions. You will also be responsible for designing and building best-in-class visualizations, delivering training, guidance, and support to P&C users, and driving the overall adoption and user experience of our analytics products across the organization. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of employee and recruiting data, processes, and analytics; have previous experience implementing Visier and HR analytics tools and a passion for enabling users to maximize the value of workforce data. 

 
What’s in it for you? You will have a chance to influence our entire data product strategy, from the rawest data to final product delivery, help develop insights that matter, and be part of a great team that puts innovation and curiosity at the center of everything we do. 

  

Responsibilities 

 

  • Act as the central product owner for the entire People Analytics portfolio (Visier, Snowflake, Tableau, PowerBI), driving the strategic roadmap, hands-on implementation (including data mapping, UAT, and optimization), and governance model from end to end 

  • Lead the architecture of our people data layer, partnering with IT to build and manage a secure data zone in Snowflake, and writing complex SQL to ensure data is integrated, transformed, and audit-ready with the highest levels of accuracy, consistency, and timeliness 

  • Establish and enforce a comprehensive data governance and security framework for all people data, ensuring data quality, clear data definitions, and compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) 

  • Design, build, and maintain a portfolio of best-in-class analytics products, from enterprise-wide dashboards in Visier and Tableau to custom analyses that solve critical business problems 

  • Act as a key consultant and partner to business and P&C leaders, owning the stakeholder relationship to understand their needs, improve the user experience, and collaboratively find solutions 

  • Champion a culture of data-driven decision-making by leading all user training, enablement, and support programs, ensuring users can effectively interpret and apply data insights 

  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert on people analytics technology, continuously evaluating market trends and recommending innovations to our analytics stack 

 

Required Skills & Qualifications 

 

  • 5+ years of demonstrated experience in a people analytics role (e.g., People Analytics Consultant, HR Solutions/Product Manager, People Data Analyst/Engineer) 

  • Proven, hands-on expertise across the analytics stack, including authoring complex SQL, building data models in Snowflake, designing production dashboards in Tableau and/or PowerBI, and managing data integration pipelines (ETL) 

  • Deep experience with end-to-end Visier product ownership, including platform implementation, administration, governance, and advanced analysis/dashboard creation 

  • Strong functional knowledge of HR data and processes, and familiarity with Workday data structures 

  • Practical understanding of employee data governance, security models, and compliance protocols for managing PII and SPI (Sensitive Personal Information) 

  • Excellent consulting and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to translate complex business needs into technical requirements and communicate data stories effectively 

  • Strong project management and user enablement experience, with a track record of leading cross-functional data projects and successfully training users of all technical levels 

 

Preferred Skills & Qualifications 

 

  • Hands-on experience applying advanced statistical techniques, predictive modeling, or machine learning (Python, R) to solve complex people analytics challenges 

  • Experience managing an analytics product backlog using Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira, Asana) 

  • Professional certifications in our core technologies (e.g., Visier, Snowflake, Tableau) or in project management (PMP) 

  • Master’s or PhD in a quantitative or HR-related field such as I/O Psychology, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or Statistics
