jobTitle: Business Systems Analyst VII - Metrics and Analytics
jobDescription:
The Business Systems Analyst VI – Enterprise Technology Metrics, Analytics & Governance will lead the definition, governance, standardization, adoption, and communication of enterprise technology performance metrics across Agile, SDLC, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Risk, Financial, and Workforce domains.

This role serves as the business owner for the Technology Metrics Framework, establishing metric definitions, business rules, calculation logic, thresholds, systems of record, reporting standards, governance routines, and executive reporting requirements.

The role functions as the primary translator between leadership reporting needs and technical implementation teams by defining what should be measured, why it matters, how it is calculated, who owns the data, and how insights should drive decision-making and continuous improvement.

Primary Focus

Enterprise technology metric strategy, governance, and standardization.

Definition of technology KPIs, KRIs, executive scorecards, and performance reporting frameworks.

Ownership of Tech ART Playbook metrics, Agile Operations metrics, SDLC metrics, and leadership reporting requirements.

Development of metric business rules, calculation logic, health thresholds, and systems-of-record standards.

Executive communications, training, adoption, and metric interpretation guidance.

Continuous improvement of measurement practices across Technology.

Key Responsibilities

Define, document, and govern enterprise technology metrics spanning Reliability, Delivery, Productivity, Quality, Risk, Financial, Talent, Agile Operations, and SDLC performance domains.

Establish enterprise standards for metric definitions, data ownership, business rules, thresholds, calculation methodologies, and reporting expectations.

Serve as the business owner for Technology leadership reporting capabilities, including Tech ART Playbooks, Agile Operations dashboards, SDLC scorecards, executive routines, and performance reviews.

Define systems of record across Jira, ServiceNow, Zephyr, GitLab, Power BI, SharePoint, Workday, Financial systems, and other enterprise platforms.

Develop metric catalogs that document purpose, calculation logic, filters, assumptions, limitations, data lineage, intended audience, expected actions, and escalation guidance.

Define measurement frameworks for Reliability, Stability, Change Success Rates, Incident Management, Service Levels, Delivery Predictability, Flow Metrics, Engineering Productivity, Quality, DORA Metrics, Financial Health, Workforce Health, and Agile maturity.

Establish governance and quality controls to ensure metric consistency, comparability, and executive confidence across all technology organizations.

Partner with leadership teams to define monthly, quarterly, and operational reporting routines that replace manual data collection with repeatable and trusted reporting processes.

Develop executive-ready narratives that explain trends, risks, performance drivers, improvement opportunities, and recommended actions.

Evaluate metric effectiveness and continuously refine KPIs to align with evolving organizational objectives.

Facilitate cross-functional working sessions to align stakeholders on metric definitions, reporting standards, and interpretation guidance.

Create training materials, communications, job aids, playbooks, and adoption strategies supporting enterprise rollout to Technology leadership audiences.

Support Agile Operations metric maturation and expand standardized metrics across Teams, ARTs, Domains, and Executive reporting layers.

Define future-state measurement capabilities including flow metrics, outcome metrics, SDLC compliance indicators, value-stream analytics, platform engineering metrics, and developer productivity insights.

Partner with the Lead Engineer to translate reporting requirements into actionable technical specifications, data requirements, and implementation roadmaps.

Required Qualifications

Combined minimum of 10 years'  higher education and/or operational/business analytics/systems development experience

Experience as a Senior Business Systems Analyst, Metrics Analyst, Reporting Analyst, Process Analyst, Governance Lead, Product Owner, or similar role.

Deep experience defining KPIs, KRIs, scorecards, dashboards, business rules, and performance measurement frameworks.

Strong understanding of Agile delivery, SDLC processes, engineering practices, software development metrics, and operational reporting.

Experience developing executive reporting, governance frameworks, and organizational performance measurement strategies.

Ability to translate complex business goals into measurable outcomes and actionable reporting requirements.

Strong facilitation, communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.

Experience documenting data definitions, metric standards, reporting requirements, and governance practices.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Jira, ServiceNow, GitLab, Zephyr, Power BI, SQL, Confluence, SharePoint, Snowflake, or enterprise analytics platforms.

Experience supporting Agile transformations, SDLC governance, technology operating models, or enterprise reporting programs.

Knowledge of DORA metrics, Flow Metrics, Value Stream Management, Agile metrics, software engineering effectiveness, and technology governance practices.

Experience within banking, financial services, technology governance, risk management, or enterprise transformation organizations.

Certifications such as CBAP, PMI-PBA, SAFe, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, Agile, Data Analytics, or business architecture certifications.

POSITION SUMMARY: 

We are seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support F5’s Product Organization, with a focus on our subscription-based businesses. As part of F5 Finance, you will join a small, highly influential team dedicated to F5’s overall success. In this role, you will partner with Engineering, Infrastructure Operations, and Product Management to support forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis. You will own complex financial models related to cloud hosting expenses, data center expansion and run rates, and resource planning.

There are great opportunities in this role to have a significant impact on the business and develop new skills. This position is well‑suited for someone who thrives in a fast‑moving environment, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and brings strong analytical and communication skills to cross‑functional work.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

  • Communicate and partner with business functions to support their strategy and goals
  • Perform detailed variance analysis for Product Management and Engineering teams, communicating results to leaders in both Finance and Product.
  • Lead financial discussions during monthly reviews, quarterly Business Metric Reviews, and fiscal planning with senior leaders.
  • Work within F5's internal budgeting system to track and update rolling forecasts and headcount with high attention to detail.
  • Generate financial impact analysis for strategic investments and enhance reporting of budgets by workstream, with a focus on automation and scalability.
     

TECHNICAL SKILLS & CORE COMPETENCIES: 

  • Advanced business and data analysis skills including building reports and complex models in excel to measure business performance (PowerBI/Tableau is a bonus).
  • Ability to communicate and lead meetings with senior management.
  • Innovative mindset; interest in improving processes and leveraging finance tools
  • Strong organizational skills to effectively support multiple initiatives across business units.
  • Ability to draw concise, well supported recommendations based on detailed analysis of the given issue
  • Understanding of GAAP accounting to support project budgets.
     

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:   

  • BA/BS degree (or higher) in Finance/IS, Accounting, Business Analytics or related field
  • 6+ years work experience

Principal Global Sales Enablement Partner

Sales Enablement | Global Sales Enablement

Role Overview

F5 is seeking a Principal Sales Enablement Partner to own and scale global sales readiness across new hire onboarding, sales methodology adoption, facilitator readiness, manager reinforcement, and measurable field execution. This role translates F5’s go-to-market priorities into practical enablement programs that help sellers qualify complex enterprise opportunities, engage customers effectively, and apply methodology consistently across theaters.

This is a Principal-level individual contributor role for an experienced sales enablement architect and methodology leader. The successful candidate will combine enterprise sales experience, sales methodology expertise, strong facilitation capability, curriculum design judgment, program ownership, and cross-functional influence. The role requires someone who can lead strategic readiness motions while also building practical tools, learning experiences, and reinforcement mechanisms that managers and sellers can use in the field.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the global sales methodology enablement motion, including MEDDPICC curriculum, facilitator guides, certification paths, practical application workshops, adoption reporting, and continuous improvement.

  • Lead the strategy, design, and ongoing evolution of sales onboarding programs, including pre-boarding, Sales Acceleration Workshop, Sales Professional curriculum, and role-based readiness pathways.

  • Translate F5’s sales strategy, platform narrative, methodology expectations, and customer-facing priorities into scalable enablement programs and rep-ready learning experiences.

  • Design and maintain manager reinforcement frameworks, coaching assets, validation checklists, inspection tools, and post-program reinforcement motions that support sustained behavior change.

  • Coach, certify, and support global facilitators and regional enablement partners to ensure consistent methodology delivery and learner experience across theaters.

  • Partner with sales leadership, product marketing, field enablement, theater leaders, and enablement operations to align readiness priorities, launch plans, and stakeholder expectations.

  • Develop practical application exercises, customer scenarios, role plays, deal inspection activities, and field-ready tools that help sellers apply methodology to active opportunities.

  • Measure program effectiveness using completion, confidence, NPS, manager validation, adoption indicators, and behavior-change metrics; use insights to improve program design and execution.

  • Maintain governance for methodology content, facilitator readiness, curriculum refresh cycles, certification expectations, and global consistency.

  • Serve as a senior enablement advisor to sales and enablement leaders on methodology adoption, onboarding effectiveness, readiness gaps, and field execution risks.​

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise sales, sales enablement, revenue enablement, sales training, sales operations, or a related go-to-market role.

  • 5+ years of experience designing, leading, or scaling sales enablement programs for enterprise B2B sales organizations.

  • Demonstrated expertise with MEDDPICC, MEDDICC, Challenger, Command of the Message, or comparable enterprise sales methodologies.

  • Experience building sales onboarding, certification, reinforcement, or methodology adoption programs across distributed or global sales teams.

  • Strong facilitation and executive communication skills, with the ability to engage sellers, managers, senior sales leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Experience developing curriculum, facilitator guides, coaching tools, practical application activities, and field-ready enablement assets.

  • Ability to use data, feedback, and adoption signals to assess enablement effectiveness and guide continuous improvement.

  • Proven ability to influence without direct authority and drive alignment across sales, marketing, product, operations, and enablement stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience as an enterprise seller, sales leader, or sales methodology practitioner in complex technology sales.

  • Experience supporting cybersecurity, cloud, SaaS, application delivery, infrastructure, or enterprise technology sales organizations.

  • Experience with enablement platforms, learning systems, content management platforms, CRM-based inspection processes, and sales productivity tools.

  • Familiarity with adult learning principles, instructional design practices, Kirkpatrick evaluation, Bloom’s Taxonomy, and behavior-based reinforcement models.

  • Experience implementing manager-led reinforcement, deal coaching, opportunity inspection, or post-training adoption motions.

  • Experience working in a global matrixed organization with regional sales teams, channel teams, product marketing, and field enablement stakeholders.

Success Measures

  • Improved consistency and quality of MEDDPICC and sales methodology delivery across theaters.

  • Reduced onboarding variability and stronger linkage between Sales Acceleration Workshop, pre-boarding, methodology application, and manager reinforcement.

  • Increased facilitator readiness and adoption of standardized global delivery materials.

  • Clearer manager engagement in post-program reinforcement, coaching, and validation.

  • Improved visibility into methodology adoption through completion, confidence, manager validation, and behavior-change indicators.

  • Sustained curriculum freshness, practical relevance, and alignment to F5’s evolving go-to-market priorities.
